rites.name: Seresium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy into a clenched fist, leaps skyward, and strikes the ground so hard that the soil erupts upward around them.

rites.name: Sonellus
rites.text: A simple craft where a practitioner presses both palms to the bare soil and coaxes the nearby ground to rise into a crude barrier. Several practitioners together can raise a rough blockade that briefly holds back heavy blows, and the method is easy enough to learn in moments.

rites.name: Maularanum
rites.text: A craft that draws the surrounding earth and stone together into tall spikes that rise from several directions at once. The spikes converge on a foe, making it hard to dodge the attack.

rites.name: Nisanum
rites.text: A practitioner slams a palm into the earth, raising a line of heavy boulders that surge forward and crash into a chosen foe.

rites.name: Sontum
rites.text: A practitioner draws up soil or rock from the earth and shapes it into jagged spikes that rise to pierce an enemy. The spikes fail against anything denser than themselves, and a lone spike can serve as a crude blade.

rites.name: Contum
rites.text: Practitioners join their strength to raise a solid stone cube that first splits into four pieces, sealing whoever stands within. Two halves then slide together with a rolling force meant to crush the captured foes.

rites.name: Telirniasia
rites.text: A fighter lifts four great boulders into the air and spins them like throwing blades. They are then flung at the foe with crushing force.

rites.name: Amaurnum
rites.text: A bearer slams both palms against the earth, and a swarm of loose stones rises to hurl itself at a chosen foe. Paired with bound cords, the stones can also pin the target in place.

rites.name: Miallanum
rites.text: A practitioner claps their hands together and then summons two massive boulders that hurl an opponent backward. It is a craft that bends earth itself into a blunt weapon.

rites.name: Rialostanum
rites.text: A practitioner raises a few pillars of stone from the ground to pierce a foe. The pillars rise through any barrier that lies between them and their mark.

rites.name: Serostialor
rites.text: A practitioner draws loose sand and crumbled rock into a clenched hand and shapes them into a hard stone mallet or shield. The stone is tough enough to hold against a crushing blow from a heavily strengthened fist.

rites.name: Laulia
rites.text: A practitioner breathes out clay and soil, shaping it into several copies of themselves. Unlike ordinary duplicates, these copies crumble into fragments when struck hard instead of vanishing.

rites.name: Rianisum
rites.text: A shaper first bends the ground into a flowing wave, then forms a huge stone spike from it that is driven through a foe.

rites.name: Sauleontes
rites.text: A wielder reads the surrounding ground and, using great bodily force, tears free a massive stone column and hurls it at a foe. Charges may also be pressed into the stone before it is flung.

rites.name: Shishora
rites.text: Shishora is the concept of resonance within Ukaraeno, the note that first held the world's roots together during the Singing. It is less a being than a standing pattern, felt wherever matter agrees to hum in step.

rites.name: Amontastor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes earth into something resembling a precious gem. Its flawed crystal holds little worth, so few bother to create it, and it can be sensed by those who track energy.

rites.name: Morillium
rites.text: A practitioner wraps himself in a shield of drifting grit while a huge sandy limb erupts from an opening to strike an enemy. The technique combines a protective barrier with a sudden, crushing blow.

rites.name: Oreontiarus
rites.text: A set of buried clay charges that a clay beast scatters beneath the ground. They detonate on their own when someone unaware steps on them.

rites.name: Teleornum
rites.text: A practitioner raises a ring of tall earthen walls from the ground to form a circular arena. The enclosed land is stripped to bare soil, and the walls vanish in smoke if broken, though the scarred ground remains.

rites.name: Vantiastium
rites.text: A bearer shapes their inner energy to raise several small columns of loose grit from the earth beneath a foe. The columns lift the enemy into the air.

rites.name: Telaulastor
rites.text: A practitioner plants a pair of bladed tools into the earth, then sends a charge upward so that a bolt descends and scorches everything nearby.

rites.name: Rianes
rites.text: A summoned giant insect hurls thick golden syrup at a foe, sealing them in a sticky amber shell that holds them fast and stops all movement.

rites.name: Telaurnium
rites.text: A practitioner raises a hand toward the high stones and splits the rock formations apart. The broken masses tumble down onto foes below and crush them.

rites.name: Coreostus
rites.text: A fiery craft in which a wielder raises a burning hill that bursts apart, flinging glowing stone outward in a blossom-like spray. Its molten flow can dissolve whatever stands in its way.

rites.name: Teleoles
rites.text: A practitioner reshapes the ground beneath a foe into a churning current of mud that knocks them over and drags them along. The same flow can also carry a second, heavier earthen strike.

rites.name: Seollium
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the ground beneath their feet with an open palm, causing the earth to ripple outward like rolling water. The gesture is said to draw heavily on inner vital energy.

rites.name: Lonum
rites.text: A bearer raises a field of standing shards that strike a foe, then forms a massive stone fist to pummel them. The strike ends with a column of grit that crushes the target.

rites.name: Ralleonum
rites.text: A practitioner turns the earth around a foe into a thick, endless bog that drags the victim down until only the neck remains above it. The clinging muck holds the captive fast and makes escape very hard.

rites.name: Lesor
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the earth and raises a stone guardian that claps its massive palms together, trapping a foe between them and crushing the target.

rites.name: Vialus
rites.text: A caster summons a gathering of small crawling creatures from the surrounding ground and air. They wrap around a foe inside a compact shell that then collapses inward.

rites.name: Orollasor
rites.text: A fighter takes on a massive beast form, rears up high, and then crashes down with full weight onto a foe. The move is a devastating technique of close combat.

rites.name: Ameosentes
rites.text: A practiced craft lets its user blend into surrounding soil and stone, slipping through the ground unseen. The user moves freely beneath the earth without being detected.

rites.name: Coreonor
rites.text: A practitioner sweeps a folded wind-vane and releases a vast streaming column of searing fire that rushes toward a chosen mark.

rites.name: Rilum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers the surrounding soil and draws it up around a foe, sealing them inside at different depths. The captive is held fast and cannot move.

rites.name: Seraustium
rites.text: A snare that wakes when a caster's energy touches it, pulling nearby wet earth into shaped hunting beasts. The beasts reassemble after every blow, buying the caster time to slip away, though laying the snare takes a long while and can let pursuers close in.

rites.name: Tistium
rites.text: A fighter strikes the earth with a clenched fist, causing a blast that heaves the ground upward and throws off the footing of nearby foes.

rites.name: Ceontes
rites.text: A basic craft that reshapes the ground and its stone, drawing on a practitioner's inner energy. It is often channeled through a particular coiled hand gesture.

rites.name: Valaunasor
rites.text: A practitioner lets their body dissolve into wet earth and shapes it at will. The earth can stretch into a long reaching limb, rise into a shielding wall for a companion, or fling a spray of clods in every direction.

rites.name: Orauntes
rites.text: A bodily craft in which a warrior wraps their chitinous shape in crackling current and hurls themselves into an adversary. The strike is delivered while the user takes on a many-legged form.

rites.name: Naustonium
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent upward, then turns sharply and cuts the throat with a blade of focused inner energy. The move is a lethal close-range technique.

rites.name: Amisium
rites.text: A practitioner summons a swarm-born double and both charge forward together to tackle a foe. The collision is forceful enough to hurl the target far away.

rites.name: Sialia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a duplicate of themselves from honeycomb wax. When the duplicate takes enough harm, it melts away into a puddle of wax.

rites.name: Carostia
rites.text: A practiced technique lets the wielder stir up a sliding wave of loose soil that rushes toward a chosen foe at great speed.

rites.name: Nelium
rites.text: A caster presses a palm to the earth and raises a spiky mass of stone from below, hurling a foe skyward. It is a combat technique for launching an enemy into the air.

rites.name: Vaurneria
rites.text: A practitioner sends a rolling wave of loose grains toward a rival while standing within their own sand realm. The technique strikes from the hidden dimension.

rites.name: Sauntus
rites.text: A practitioner wields the ground itself, drawing nearby stones together into massive earthen jaws that snap shut on foes and crush them whole.

rites.name: Tinus
rites.text: Three young fighters each raise a sphere bearing a blasting charge and rush forward together. They stumble in turn, letting their spheres roll onto the enemy, where they burst.

rites.name: Naullum Ternollor
rites.text: A practitioner merges with a nearby stone to gather its bulk, then hurls that fused mass forward as a heavy armored assault. It is a borrowed craft that replaces the body's own reserves with raw earth.

rites.name: Vaustiarnus
rites.text: A grinding ritual that traps a foe in a binding case of crushed rock. The case slowly tightens around its captive until the victim is crushed to death.

rites.name: Rinor
rites.text: A beast spins through the air while releasing a spray that stains a wide area, confusing and blinding anyone it touches. The mark's scent lets the beast's keeper track the marked foe wherever they go.

rites.name: Maules
rites.text: Four towering stone columns rise around a foe and crackle with bolts of lightning that arc between them. The captive is pinned in place and may suffer severe harm from the discharge.

rites.name: Teosalles
rites.text: A bearer first strikes a barrier with an axe, then brings a hammer down upon the same spot from above. The barrier shatters, whether it is a wall or a blade held by an opponent.

rites.name: Orernum
rites.text: A practitioner calls up three massive stones from the ground and hurls them at a foe, crushing the target beneath their weight.

rites.name: Corises
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a great swarm of insects that cloud and sting a foe. Each insect that falls spills a thick, clinging sweetness that binds the enemy in place, especially those who fight at arm's length.

rites.name: Mernauntium
rites.text: A practitioner sinks beneath an opponent and then bursts up from the soil to strike them. The technique is a sudden ambush rising from below.

rites.name: Seolles
rites.text: A wielder lifts a huge chunk of the ground and hurls it at a foe. Striking the earth with a mighty blow shatters it into fragments that rain down on the target.

rites.name: Serelium
rites.text: A craftsman animates a hollow figure of his lineage to raise a wall of dark grit, then drives jagged thorns from its surface to pierce an adversary.

rites.name: Raurnialus
rites.text: A forbidden ritual that calls forth burning vermin from the flames, which set fire to surrounding objects or strike at foes. The summoned swarm can ignite a whole grove of trees.

rites.name: Veornanum
rites.text: A bearer coats their knuckles in a dark, volatile vapor that flares into fire upon each blow landed against a foe.

rites.name: Vonesia
rites.text: A broad wooden blade is swept through the air to summon a churning gust that catches a foe. A second sweep then lifts the captured target skyward.

rites.name: Rontia Mauronus
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, forms a fist of hardened earth, and drops onto an opponent with a crushing overhead strike. The impact splits the ground beneath and leaves a trailing glimmer as the fighter descends.

rites.name: Amalanum
rites.text: A fighter first strikes an opponent several times with fists and feet, then burrows beneath the ground and surfaces below them to deliver a piercing blow from underneath.

rites.name: Orauntus
rites.text: A practiced craft lets its user take remote control of loose stones, lifting them into the air and guiding them wherever the user wishes to send them.

rites.name: Amaurnanum
rites.text: A fighter gathers inner energy into a clenched fist and delivers a crushing blow that hurls the target a long distance away. It is a lesser form of a far stronger strike of the same kind.

rites.name: Nantisium
rites.text: A paired warrior leaps skyward with their animal companion and fuses into one spinning drill. They then burrow deep into the earth, leaving a wide, yawning pit behind.

rites.name: Amastum
rites.text: A fighter punches up through a swirling cloud of grit, and the cloud reshapes into a massive stone-hued limb that hurls the foe skyward.

rites.name: Teonum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes the soil into a great serpent of rock and sends it rushing at an enemy. The technique draws its strength from the ground itself.

rites.name: Tinum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes the bedrock into a massive stone that is driven down onto a foe like a hammer. It is a technique of raw earthen force.

rites.name: Corolles
rites.text: A bearer strikes the earth, and fire bursts up in every direction at once. The blaze is strong enough to tear through the soil, opening a path for escape.

rites.name: Tosiarnum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes the earth by forming a sequence of hand signs, raising two walls of soil that close in on an enemy and pin them between. The technique traps foes in the space between the walls.

rites.name: Riallosum
rites.text: A taxing earthen craft that lets a practitioner shape mud into copies of foes. Each use drains a great deal of inner strength and leaves the caster weary.

rites.name: Castianus
rites.text: A wielder cuts an opponent twice with a curved blade, then hurls orbs that transform into two massive hands crackling with violet energy to seize the foe.

rites.name: Seliarus
rites.text: A fighter seizes an opponent by the legs, turns in a rapid circle, and hurls them away. It is a technique used to fling a foe off their footing.

rites.name: Orostia
rites.text: A fighter lengthens a rib-like blade and sweeps it downward toward an enemy's midsection. The strike is a practiced technique of close combat.

rites.name: Siria
rites.text: A wielder strikes the end of a staff against the earth, raising a line of stony reef spikes that surge forward. Once they reach a distant foe, larger spires burst upward beneath them and pierce the target from below.

rites.name: Valerus
rites.text: A practitioner performs a set gesture, then presses both palms into loose ground so it ripples outward like a wave, flinging away anything resting on top. The shifted terrain also unravels snares and wards buried within it.

rites.name: Teliastia
rites.text: A joint craft in which two practitioners, one wielding water and one wielding stone, blend their elements into a mud serpent that lunges at a foe. It requires close coordination between the two casters.

rites.name: Veleornium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a slurry source into a beast-like head that hurls clay projectiles at a foe. Heat can be added so the clay strikes scorching hot.

rites.name: Valiastia
rites.text: A bearer raises a living tree whose sharp pointed branches lash downward and pierce anyone standing beneath it.

rites.name: Viasium
rites.text: A fighter draws a blade and makes one swift, forceful cut at a foe standing directly ahead. The strike is delivered in a single fluid motion.

rites.name: Mirnes
rites.text: A user raises a field of rough stone spikes to strike a foe, then shapes a huge rock figure that drives a fist into them. The figure finally forms whole and presses its palm down, pinning the enemy flat against the earth.

rites.name: Callintia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a flat disk of marsh earth and hurls it at a foe, knocking them backward. The technique draws on the soil itself as a weapon.

rites.name: Restium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a double out of wet earth that can be dismantled by a blow. Unlike ordinary duplicates, the earthen figure gathers itself back together afterward.

rites.name: Amosterium
rites.text: A hidden practitioner pulls a foe beneath the soil, leaving only the head above ground so the captive cannot move. The bound figure may be restrained, or may later break free.

rites.name: Telernanum
rites.text: A craft in which a practitioner sweeps a broad leaf-like fan toward the ground, then drives a line of heaving soil upward at a foe. The earth rises in a sequence aimed at striking an opponent.

rites.name: Tilanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes the earth with a bare fist, hurling loose stones and a foe into the air. The striker leaps across the tumbling rubble and drives the opponent through a boulder into a wall of stone.

rites.name: Miaror
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a flowing tide of wet earth that becomes stronger and faster when it meets water. The technique is a craft of shaping ground into a surging current.

rites.name: Sirnor
rites.text: A tree-forged technique in which a great wooden column is raised and then struck by a fighter, sending it crashing down upon an enemy.

rites.name: Rianentes
rites.text: A practitioner draws on inner vital force to lift a vast mound of soil beneath their feet. The mound's form follows their imagining, from flat ground to a sharp spire, but swelling it too far drains their strength.

rites.name: Amiallor Listus
rites.text: A caster leaps backward while sweeping both arms forward, calling forth a swarm of serpents that spin into two whirling columns and crush the foe between them.

rites.name: Moreostanum
rites.text: A practitioner tunnels beneath the earth, then reaches up to seize an enemy by the ankles and pulls them down into the soil, entombing them alive.

rites.name: Mausium
rites.text: A warrior charges a crackling blade to daze a foe and launch them skyward. Strikes follow in the air, and the assault ends with a blast of fire.

rites.name: Ciresanum
rites.text: A bearer channels heightened inner energy, striking foes aside before stamping the earth so it splits and hurls the attackers into the air.

rites.name: Oraullium
rites.text: A bearer drops hard onto a foe from above, striking with a heavier fist that releases a vast dark wave of force. The blow is a technique of raw impact.

rites.name: Sostarum
rites.text: A practitioner drops from above onto a foe and pierces them with a short blade. The strike relies on surprise and speed from a high vantage point.

rites.name: Serentarium
rites.text: A wielder dashes forward and bashes a foe with a flat cooking pan, striking hard enough to topple them. The force of the blow depends on the wielder's own strength.

rites.name: Renisium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures several rocks to hurl at a foe, then shapes a massive stone hand that trips the target and swells into a full stone giant, which punches the enemy away.

rites.name: Ciria
rites.text: A bearer shapes loose grit into a spinning, lance-like point and flings it at a foe. The drilling spike strikes with force meant to pierce.

rites.name: Raustinum
rites.text: A practitioner encloses a foe inside a living dome of grown timber, then drives heavy beams through the shell so that it shatters and strikes the captive within.

rites.name: Mallorium
rites.text: A caster spits four pale serpents onto the ground, and they swarm across an opponent's path. Anyone who treads on the ground is quickly enveloped by many writhing snakes.

rites.name: Amillarnia
rites.text: A bearer channels the inner current of the ground through their frame, drawing its hardness into a clear, see-through layer over the skin. The layer blocks heavy blows and lends extra force to the bearer's strikes and escapes, but it can only form where enough stone lies nearby.

rites.name: Coraurasia
rites.text: A practitioner wraps a companion's body in a layer of drifting grit that hardens into protective plating. The covering holds firm against violent desert gusts while the wearer stays calm and unmoving.

rites.name: Leosinanum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder strikes an foe five times with a three-edged blade, then ends the assault with a broad sweeping cut that hurls the target backward.

rites.name: Valaustia
rites.text: A practitioner presses both palms into the soil, turning the ground to sludge that rises as a barrier and crashes onto foes. The sludge clings to a victim and hardens, dragging down their movement.

rites.name: Meontium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers loose grit already lying nearby and whirls it into a small, roaring cloud that wraps around foes and blinds their sight.

rites.name: Seolum Oresia
rites.text: A bearer raises a line of dense granular pillars from the ground, and they surge upward beneath a foe to strike and wound them.

rites.name: Valintor
rites.text: A fighter leaps from a veil of smoke and hurls a volley of bladed stars that bounce between one another to strike a foe. The strike is then sealed with a spiraling bolt of crackling force.

rites.name: Valum
rites.text: A practitioner presses both palms into the earth so that grains of sand align and bend passing light. The shimmering cloud then bursts outward to shroud nearby allies, hiding them from sight and making them difficult to find unless one uses a special detecting device. Preparing this effect takes a long gathering of inner energy.

rites.name: Saustilium
rites.text: A piercing mental technique in which a practitioner's gaze ensnares an opponent's mind and sows disorientation. The victim's thoughts become tangled and unreliable.

rites.name: Oranteorus
rites.text: A bound summoner calls a huge bear-like beast into being, which drops straight down onto the foe below.

rites.name: Seroniria
rites.text: A great carved timber colossus presses one massive digit into the soil, and wooden spears burst upward from the earth to strike a foe. The craft draws its power from living grain.

rites.name: Miantestia
rites.text: A fighter lands a pair of quick strikes, drops low into a braced stance, then rises with a forceful headbutt that sends the foe airborne.

rites.name: Saurnus
rites.text: A great wooden force rises from the ground and sends thick living branches lunging toward a foe. The branches grow outward to strike at the target.

rites.name: Teliastanum
rites.text: A fighter splits into duplicates who strike a foe in quick succession, one lunging from the side and another kicking it skyward. The copies then leap together and hurl the target down onto the ground.

rites.name: Reostium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a great heap of loose grit and shapes it into a gigantic clawed limb that seizes or crushes a foe. The technique turns scattered earth into a weapon of living weight.

rites.name: Solasanum
rites.text: A bearer hardens long strands into razor-edged barbs that can wrap around the body as a shield. The barbs can deter an assailant or pierce one who has already struck, though gaps remain exposed.

rites.name: Corolaunes
rites.text: Two allied fighters strike together with blows and kicks, then one clouds the foe's mind while the other hurls spinning blades. The blades and foe are finally set alight, reducing everything to ash.

rites.name: Celeornum
rites.text: A fighter first strikes with a quick sequence of close blows, then calls up a great limb from the earth to hurl the foe skyward. The attacker leaps after them and drives them back down with a fist.

rites.name: Serilum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a small ball of loose grains and presses it until it turns rock-hard. The sphere is hurled so fast it can steal consciousness, and it can bend midair to hit several foes at once.

rites.name: Tarus
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a hollow stone comb in which a giant grub is kept, and the grub feeds on the inner energy of its keeper's spirit.

rites.name: Sellanum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a great rolling timber with swift gestures. It sweeps down upon foes standing just ahead of the caster and knocks them aside.

rites.name: Serastium
rites.text: A wielder hurls a ball of grit at a foe, then pours a cascade of loose sand over them. The grains then rise in a surge that lifts the victim into the air.

rites.name: Serantaulum
rites.text: A fighter launches a foe skyward, then raises a timber span that drags the victim away. The caster leaps behind them and drives a wooden spear through the span, pinning the foe down to the earth.

rites.name: Cesteorum
rites.text: A practiced caster weaves a sequence of gestures to conjure a drifting, misty figure that appears as a lifelike double. It is a craft of illusion drawn out of fog.

rites.name: Oralium
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a serpent with two heads from another realm to strike at foes. The beast answers the caller's will and lashes out at those who oppose them.

rites.name: Amasilanum
rites.text: A serpent lashes its coiled tail to strike at a foe. The same tail can also block missiles hurled at its bearer.

rites.name: Naullia Neornastia
rites.text: A fighter cleaves a lake into a rising column that hurls a foe skyward. Five water beasts then hunt the target, and when one swallows the rest it bursts, flinging the victim up again before the remaining beasts drag them beneath the surface.

rites.name: Narnor
rites.text: A shape-changed fighter tramples foes first with one side and then the other, gores them with twin horns, and ends by whirling and lashing with long tails.

rites.name: Teleolum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the earth with a clenched hand, causing great trunks to burst upward and seize a foe. The captive is then driven downward through the living wood and into the soil.

rites.name: Rialeontus
rites.text: A practitioner blows drifting bubbles that burst into a clinging goo upon popping. The sticky residue slows or snares a rival caught within its spread.

rites.name: Orineornes
rites.text: A ward drawn from a sacred chime that lights up and cancels every harmful force nearby. It has been strong enough to shield a bearer from a shadowy entity's dark assault.

rites.name: Reollasum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a huge blade from loose grit that can coil and slither past protective barriers to cut through an opponent. It is a technique of the sand arts.

rites.name: Serilles
rites.text: A fighter plants a foot into the earth and reshapes their own form into a massive spike that surges upward beneath an enemy. The technique is a craft of ground-piercing strikes.

rites.name: Corianes
rites.text: A bearer can raise a tall column of loose grit from the ground or turn their lower body to grit. Through it they float swiftly through the air, the column staying rooted to the earth below.

rites.name: Cornausia
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a flammable dark mist that gathers into a small cloud. The cloud can drift over a foe and scatter, coating them in a slick, burnable oil.

rites.name: Nolanum
rites.text: A huge metal cat-figure rises from below the ground and splits open to grip a foe. Heavy chains then haul the captive back down into the earth.

rites.name: Amasanum
rites.text: A practitioner raises four standing columns out of the earth around a chosen victim. Their field locks every body caught within it still, and only a counter-mark can undo the stillness.

rites.name: Veorus
rites.text: A fighter impales an opponent on living timber spikes, launches them skyward with blows, and then slips through the strikes to raise roots that pierce from below.

rites.name: Corestium
rites.text: A bearer raises a great stone-like mass of sand above their own head and then flings it at a foe, crushing them beneath it. It follows a prior binding that traps the foe in the sand.

rites.name: Telostus Serosum
rites.text: A fighter wraps one leg in gusting breath-energy and drives a plunging spinning kick downward. The strike is strong enough to cut clean through a wooden construct.

rites.name: Oraunestus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a vast horde of tiny bonded insects that gather into a towering living barrier. The barrier shields the caster and nearby companions from heavy falling debris and blasts of flame.

rites.name: Males
rites.text: A wielder waves a great folded blade-fan to conjure a small whirlwind that traps a foe, slicing them as it spins. When the gale fades, the victim is dropped hard onto the ground.

rites.name: Orosor
rites.text: Several fighters stand upon one another's shoulders in a tall tower and advance together toward a foe. The climbing wall of bodies traps the opponent so they cannot slip away.

rites.name: Valiarum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes wet earth into humanoid figures that obey their commands and knit themselves back together after most wounds. When a figure seizes a foe, it forces its clay hand down the victim's throat, choking them with muck.

rites.name: Orallaunia
rites.text: A caster pulls a foe into a spinning funnel of grit that swallows them slowly. Once the swirling walls collapse inward, the gathered grit crushes the captive inside.

rites.name: Laustenanum
rites.text: A rapid volley technique in which a practitioner launches many spike-like shards of dark grit in quick succession. Its spread makes it effective against groups of foes at once.

rites.name: Cosarnor
rites.text: A practitioner sends a pulse of crackling energy into a steep cliff, dislodging a mass of rock downward. The method only works when the caster stands above a mountain slope.

rites.name: Nosor
rites.text: A wielder shapes loose desert grit into several grasping limbs that burst up from the ground and swarm a foe. The limbs close in together and pin the target down beneath the earth.

rites.name: Veostus
rites.text: A user makes a grain-cloud strike an opponent in three rounds, then closes the attack with a sweeping cut from a towering rope of drifting grit.

rites.name: Cillum
rites.text: A bristling beast curls into a tight sphere and charges forward, crushing foes under its spines. The same rolling motion lets it slip free from incoming blows.

rites.name: Meosia
rites.text: A practitioner raises a column of living timber from the earth and drives it upward into an opponent, hurling them backward. The technique relies on the craft of shaping growth.

rites.name: Maurnium
rites.text: A leaping warrior hurls two coiling streams of fine grit at a foe. The twin strands twist as they strike toward the opponent.

rites.name: Valiasia
rites.text: A user of living timber seals a foe inside a wooden cage, then grows a copy of their own body into a towering column that slowly falls to crush the captive.

rites.name: Rausteoria
rites.text: A bearer forms a gesture and calls up twin coiling shoots from the soil. The shoots twist together and pierce a foe who stands before them.

rites.name: Tistiallor
rites.text: A bearer raises a column of living timber from the soil to strike a foe backward. A duplicate then vaults over the column and drives a heavy kick into the fallen enemy.

rites.name: Amasor
rites.text: A bearer slams a palm onto the earth to call forth a vast many-limbed beast whose buried fist bursts up to strike a foe. The beast's body then rises, and its bearer stands on its crown to command an attack that scorches the enemy.

rites.name: Liareornes
rites.text: Two twin wielders spin their legs in rapid rotation to raise a fierce vortex that turns aside any blows aimed at them.

rites.name: Rornesum
rites.text: A fighter opens several inner energy gates, then charges into a foe and hurls them skyward. The fighter then plunges back down to the ground.

rites.name: Serostor
rites.text: Three allies strike a foe together, then two press in with a rapid flurry while a third hides a cord beneath the ground. The cord binds the foe to a log, and the escapee swaps places with a stand-in.

rites.name: Viarneostia
rites.text: A practitioner calls up several wooden pieces from the ground that thrust outward and pierce a foe. It is a craft drawing on the living growth of timber.

rites.name: Silor
rites.text: A caster reshapes the soil under an enemy into a deep, sticky sinkhole whose walls grasp at the victim, dragging them further down. The trap fails if the target can reach a stone or other non-earth footing.

rites.name: Tialanum
rites.text: A practitioner swells a clenched hand and extends the arm far outward, then swings it forward in a heavy blow.

rites.name: Amiastasia
rites.text: A deadlier form of a basic water strike, drawn with both palms at once. Two streams of pressurized water burst forth together, strong enough to tear through a person's face.

rites.name: Maraustum
rites.text: A practitioner draws water up inside the body and expels it as round, fast-moving orbs. Their force grows with the energy poured into them, and a leaping giant launches them with added weight behind each blow.

rites.name: Amaurium
rites.text: A practitioner stretches their own shadow into several dark strands that coil around a foe, then draws them into a tightening sphere that squeezes the target.

rites.name: Viaror
rites.text: A bodily-maneuvered construct hurls clouds of toxic vapor at an angle so the noxious haze drifts outward and harms foes nearby.

rites.name: Orillanum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes a foe with a living timber burst that takes root in the body and grows into a tree. The craft turns struck wood into new growth.

rites.name: Goktok
rites.text: Goktok is the concept of the rite by which a Ki-born kindler draws a single spark from the inner furnace of a sleeping star-hearth and sends it into the void. The idea is kept by the Courts of Ukaraeno as proof that flame can be lent between worlds without being lost.

rites.name: Cralde
rites.text: Cralde is the concept of the threshold-binding, the rite by which the Courts of Ukaraeno sealed the doors between worlds during the Holy Age of flame and temples. It is held as a principle of thresholds and oaths rather than a single being, and its power is measured in the closing of great gates.

rites.name: Oseivsith
rites.text: Oseivsith is a concept of Ukaraeno, the idea of a lawful oath given weight in the Courts, where trials were held to bind worlds together. It rose during the Age of Sundering, when the old bonds broke and the first doors between worlds were built to hold what remained.

rites.name: Liaror
rites.text: Liaror is the concept of the threshold that holds two worlds apart, understood in the Courts of Ukaraeno as the thin will that keeps a door closed until a trial is passed. In the Age of Sundering it was the force that let the doors between worlds be built and, at times, broken open. Its nature is said to be patience worn into a shape that can still bear weight.

rites.name: Mostaulles
rites.text: A fighter unlocks a sealed inner threshold, launches the foe skyward, seizes both limbs to break them, then slams the opponent headfirst into the earth.

rites.name: Teosaulium
rites.text: A practitioner presses a bare palm to the earth and calls up a towering growth of wood that hurls back any foes standing nearby.

rites.name: Telanum
rites.text: A practiced technique where a fighter strikes a foe with metal, delivers a forceful kick that launches them skyward, and finishes them mid-air with a bladed throwing star.

rites.name: Reollia
rites.text: Two fighters coordinate a technique: one unleashes crackling bolts that numb the foe, while the other whirls with a blade and slices through the stunned targets.

rites.name: Lestor
rites.text: A fighter hurls a storm of thrown blades that seek out a foe on their own and pierce through defenses. The technique relies on precise timing and bladed discipline.

rites.name: Amorus
rites.text: A practitioner who is ensnared by an illusion studies its workings with a piercing gaze, then casts the same deception back onto the foe. The reflected trick mainly rattles the mind, and its strength depends on the caster's skill against the attacker's inborn gifts.

rites.name: Viarnestus
rites.text: A five-pointed hand mark pressed over a four-part ward, throwing off its balance. The sealed bearer loses access to a stored power and finds their own strength harder to draw.

rites.name: Telosanum
rites.text: A practitioner exhales ordinary fire wrapped in dark flames that encircle them. Anyone who comes near the blaze is harmed by it.

rites.name: Oraurnus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a user strikes an opponent several times with shimmering powder, using slashes, rising spikes, and a falling shard. It finishes by crushing the target beneath a solid block of the same powder.

rites.name: Rastontanum
rites.text: A warrior draws a blade and channels inner energy through a marked arm, then rises to strike an opponent upward and slams them downward with a piercing slash.

rites.name: Rernum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with fists and a heavy fan-blade, then hurls marked blades that burst apart on contact. The opponent is first lifted into the air before the final blast.

rites.name: Telantinium
rites.text: A skilled user ties a clear, stretchy cord to a thrown blade and steers it with a fingertip flick. The first strike is dodged, then the blade loops back to hit from behind.

rites.name: Valarnes
rites.text: A fighter throws three quick blows, jabs toward the eyes, leaps to strike with both feet, then tumbles to the ground after a spinning follow-up goes wrong.

rites.name: Varnus
rites.text: A combined strike in which a group of duplicates launches a foe skyward through repeated impacts. Two further duplicates then rise from the attacker's back to deliver a massive spinning sphere to the airborne target.

rites.name: Niareontia
rites.text: A fighter hurls several sharp bone spikes at an opponent. Three spikes fly from close range, while five are launched from farther away.

rites.name: Niarum
rites.text: A bearer in a second transformed state leaps skyward, lashes an enemy with a spinning tail, then bursts sideways and sprouts sharp bone spikes from the body to pierce the foe.

rites.name: Valasaulus
rites.text: A practitioner draws a blade so swiftly that it strikes in a flash, releasing a rush of wind on impact and lifting dust from the ground beneath.

rites.name: Rauria
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with paired batons, then conjures a staff from a tossed scroll to keep hitting. Once the foe falls, a huge spiked club is summoned to crush them.

rites.name: Maustiallia
rites.text: A greater form of a spinning palm discipline, unleashed with wider and stronger rotating force. It is practiced by those who have mastered the lesser version.

rites.name: Amilanum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a volley of sharp feathers guided with precise aim, and each feather detonates on contact like a small charge.

rites.name: Naullianes
rites.text: A practitioner releases a burst of inner energy from every channel in the body, hurling an opponent backward. The same burst can be aimed precisely to break apart a trap of water that holds the user.

rites.name: Niarnus
rites.text: A practitioner whirls a weighted chain with rapid, forceful strikes. The blows are strong enough to crater bare earth and split a thick trunk clean through.

rites.name: Corinus
rites.text: A self-destructive rite in which a practitioner binds their chest with volatile charms and ignites them while standing close to an opposing force. The sacrifice ends the practitioner's life.

rites.name: Ameollosium
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a wielder shapes a cursed inferno into a cluster of sharp flaming spikes. The spikes wound the target and force them backward.

rites.name: Amostus
rites.text: A practitioner unrolls a great length of cloth that tightly swaddles a target, leaving them unable to move or use any craft. Further sealing marks layered atop the bound figure also stop them from being called away.

rites.name: Corilostum
rites.text: A practitioner conceals their whole body inside a blaze, vanishing from sight. When they step out of the concealing fire, the flames flare up and expose their position.

rites.name: Telauror
rites.text: A practitioner channels inner life-energy into their tongue, lengthening it and shaping a face upon it. The organ then hunts a target by scent, binds it tightly, and marks it with a burning fluid.

rites.name: Orinallor
rites.text: Two healers strike the ground together with a focused blow that shatters the earth and tears apart everything nearby across a wide area.

rites.name: Viallor
rites.text: A bearer smears their own blood across a hungry blade, binding them together. The blade then exhales a crimson haze over the field that slowly drains the life-force from every enemy's open wounds.

rites.name: Menum
rites.text: A gifted woman unleashes a sealed reserve of power through a ringing charm, transforming completely. In this radiant state she can pierce a shadow-entity's darkness, though the surge threatens to consume her as well.

rites.name: Rinia
rites.text: A practitioner wraps themselves in a shroud of dark fire, then shapes that fire into jagged spikes that pierce everything standing nearby.

rites.name: Sereonaures
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a clinging vapor from the lungs that bursts into a huge blaze when touched by flame or spark. It was once used by a masked infiltrator who posed as another person.

rites.name: Tiantum
rites.text: A fighter's skill in wielding armaments during a clash. Warriors coat their blades with their inner energy to change how the weapon behaves.

rites.name: Rontia
rites.text: A practitioner unspools a long cord of volatile tags and flings it in a looping arc around a foe. The loop closes every exit and then detonates across a broad area, swallowing the target in fire.

rites.name: Nirellia
rites.text: A ritual of rapid strikes performed by a warrior who has taken on a feral, changed form. Each blow lands in a flurry against a single foe.

rites.name: Rinollor
rites.text: A practiced craft lets a caster shape their trailing tendrils and send them beneath the earth. They then rise from below a chosen target and pierce it several times.

rites.name: Telentus
rites.text: A practitioner releases an X-shaped wave of crackling storm energy. The wave can briefly stun whoever it strikes.

rites.name: Casaustia
rites.text: A joint technique in which one ally releases a foul gas while another's rage manifests a second self. The combined assault hits hard and leaves the target poisoned by the noxious cloud.

rites.name: Seontor
rites.text: A fighter strikes with thin needles in a rapid flurry, then kicks the foe away and conjures a cloud of sharp frozen spikes that hurtle back at the target.

rites.name: Sereosium
rites.text: A bearer in a heightened inner state splits into two echoes, one pinning a foe to the ground while the other helps gather a spinning sphere of force. The bearer then leaps forward, driving the swirling sphere into the adversary.

rites.name: Nastus
rites.text: A fighter wraps both arms in glowing molten stone, first to freeze an opponent in place, then to strike. The second blow bursts on contact and hurls the foe backward.

rites.name: Nistor
rites.text: A practitioner draws a flammable fluid from within the mouth, spits it forth, and sets it alight to hurl a fiery projectile at a foe. Using less of the fluid speeds the casting, and it can be split into several shots or a sustained stream.

rites.name: Rorallium
rites.text: A practitioner channels focused inner energy through the palms into the ground, splitting the earth into deep chasms. The shape and direction of each fissure is chosen by the user, and skilled casters can cut apart a battlefield or breach a fortification.

rites.name: Coriantor
rites.text: A practitioner trained in tidal channeling releases a rush of flowing force beneath their feet, propelling them forward to strike an opponent with their whole body.

rites.name: Neolloses
rites.text: A practitioner delivers an open-handed blow that sends rippling inner energy through the struck foe, harming them from within. It is especially effective against opponents whose outer guard is strong.

rites.name: Seristor
rites.text: A bearer of a masked flame unleashes a fireball into a spinning storm at the center of a battlefield. The blaze splits into many smaller fires that scatter outward in a set pattern.

rites.name: Rollium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a dark lashing cord over their palms that stretches far outward. Its tapered tips can pierce through a foe after a sweeping strike.

rites.name: Seonauntium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures four spiraling gusts that circle a foe and draw inward. They merge into a great wind serpent that rises beneath the target.

rites.name: Corileontes
rites.text: A practitioner draws more of a sacred mineral's power to become a brutal, beast-like shape. This surge sharpens their strength and skill, letting untrained fighters hold their own against seasoned foes.

rites.name: Teliasium
rites.text: A grim bonding craft that stitches a bearer's inner life to another's, so that harm dealt to one is shared by both. Only a blade marked with a sealed sigil can sever the bond safely.

rites.name: Vostaures
rites.text: A bodily discipline that lets its practitioner unleash a pulse of power, harming nearby foes and binding them with a brief curse while strengthening the user's own abilities.

rites.name: Amiallium
rites.text: Two bearers rush a foe side by side, striking together with a shared charge. The paired assault is taught by temple orders as a way to overwhelm a target.

rites.name: Telireosium
rites.text: A puppeteer commands his hidden metal filaments to form many long needles high above the field. They drop from the air and pierce whoever stands below.

rites.name: Carnanum
rites.text: A practitioner channels inner energy into their locks, letting them shape and command the strands. Thicker growth lets the binds hold tighter and throw foes farther.

rites.name: Liares
rites.text: A practiced art lets a user rise into the air through inner vital energy. It also lets them shift distant objects without touching them, much like a mind-driven pull.

rites.name: Reosintor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a swarm of drifting fireballs that gather into ghostly forms. After a sealed gesture, they dive upon a foe in waves, and each strike bursts into a great blaze.

rites.name: Merium
rites.text: Four cloaked practitioners stand at the compass points and jointly raise a thick, murky haze that falls over a target. The haze forms an impenetrable seal that shuts out every outside force, even death.

rites.name: Rosum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers crackling storm energy into a hand and calls down bolts of lightning from a spectral guardian figure onto a foe.

rites.name: Celus
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a burst of caustic white powder that burns foes, and the leftover dust hardens into a binding crust once moistened. Adding water spreads the hardening crust across a wider area.

rites.name: Liastes
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a burst of fire that divides into three separate waves, each racing off in its own direction.

rites.name: Rellaurum
rites.text: A bewitching craft that makes the world seem to freeze in place, letting its user strike a foe freely until the illusion fades away.

rites.name: Nilianus
rites.text: A wielder directs chunks of broken stone toward a foe and heats them from afar so they stick and scorch the skin. A clenched grip then sets them off with force strong enough to shatter a spirit guardian.

rites.name: Tauntor
rites.text: A combined technique in which one fighter rushes ahead while a partner pins the foe in place with a shadow. The charger then leaps and crushes the trapped opponent with a swollen leg.

rites.name: Corentes
rites.text: A paired striking art in which a practitioner forms a duplicate of themselves, and both then unleash a surging lightning-claw strike at the same foe at once.

rites.name: Tallus
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a torrent of heat that wraps the foe inside a blazing globe. The sphere then erupts, consuming whoever is trapped within it.

rites.name: Amenalles
rites.text: A practitioner conjures hundreds of insubstantial duplicates of themselves that cannot be struck. While foes hunt the illusions, the caster slips beneath the earth and later rises to strike the distracted enemy.

rites.name: Ameonorum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with an elbow, follows with a sequence of spectral blade slashes that launch the foe skyward, then unleashes a huge torrent of flame at the airborne target.

rites.name: Rernes
rites.text: A fighter dashes forward at high speed and unleashes a rapid flurry of quick punches upon an opponent.

rites.name: Vaullostes
rites.text: A practitioner shapes the surrounding space into a spinning column of grit that drags a rival inward. The technique turns loose sand into a whirling trap.

rites.name: Amirium
rites.text: A bearer places a sigil on a rival so that every metal-grit strike launched by that bearer is pulled toward the marked foe. The mark keeps the grit locked onto its target.

rites.name: Orausiallor
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a burst of flame at a foe, then fans it with a broad war-fan until the blaze spins into a whirling column that lifts the enemy off their feet.

rites.name: Valasteror
rites.text: A practiced fighting technique in which the user extends both arms and unleashes a rapid volley of strikes against an opponent.

rites.name: Manollanum
rites.text: A practitioner breathes out a spiraling column of fire that can reduce anything it touches to ash. When it meets large amounts of water, it blooms into a thick, billowing fog of vapor.

rites.name: Meostalles
rites.text: A bearer reroutes their inner vital current so that more of it can be spent on workings and their movement quickens markedly. The rapid flow, however, drains their reserves far sooner than normal.

rites.name: Tisianor
rites.text: A caller draws a sleeping serpent from the earth, and it spits a noxious haze that flies in a straight path and wraps around a foe, poisoning them.

rites.name: Laurneones
rites.text: A practitioner first ensnares an adversary inside a spinning storm of folded sheets, then hurls a sharpened lance made of the same material. The technique combines entrapment with a follow-up strike.

rites.name: Lintium
rites.text: A wielder stands upon drifting dunes and shapes the grains into a huge spectral limb that hurls forward and crashes down onto a foe.

rites.name: Velianes
rites.text: A ritual strike in which a warrior hammers an opponent repeatedly with a curved blade, then leaps high and brings the weapon down in a final arcing cut.

rites.name: Sereollanes
rites.text: A fighter cuts an opponent upward into the air, then chases them and strikes repeatedly mid-flight before a final downward stomp. They land and catch the falling foe on a crackling palm of stored energy.

rites.name: Valaurnes
rites.text: A bearer channels a bound inner spirit into one limb, sharpening blows dramatically. The same surge can dissolve a hostile hex binding a captive mind, releasing them.

rites.name: Seraurnium
rites.text: A practitioner summons several copies of themselves, who leap skyward and tumble through the air. They then descend in a spinning rush, driving their heels down onto a target's shoulders and crown.

rites.name: Cornintus
rites.text: A practitioner wraps a towering spirit guardian in a coat of dark, sealing flame. The fire burns foes and makes close attackers falter before striking.

rites.name: Sinausia
rites.text: A rite where several towering shards of frozen crystal rise swiftly from the ground to pierce everything nearby. Its speed makes it nearly unavoidable, and inside a small chamber it leaves almost no way to escape.

rites.name: Niasenus
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a flurry of blows joined by a hurled blade, then launches the foe skyward. Two colossal throwing discs are drawn from a hidden realm and hurled at the target.

rites.name: Ceorum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that splits the earth beneath their feet into a violent burst, hurling away every foe standing nearby.

rites.name: Oraurnium
rites.text: A practitioner forges a blade of dark fire and sweeps it through the air, releasing a controlled surge of flame toward a foe. The technique is a fiery craft of temple-trained fighters.

rites.name: Mollium
rites.text: A tradesman's craft that gathers fine dark grit into a massive weighted mallet, then lets it fall crushingly upon a foe. The sculptor guides the grit from afar, shaping it like a living tool.

rites.name: Amanolor
rites.text: A dark practice where a craftsman partly takes in a newly dead body and makes it an extension of their own form. Gaining the dead one's skills comes at the cost of the practitioner's mind and body becoming unstable, recoverable only through a sudden jolt.

rites.name: Tenaullanum
rites.text: A practitioner dissolves into a swirl of pale petals and reappears high above a foe, hurling charged markers that burst upon landing.

rites.name: Mastium
rites.text: A bearer's arm sprouts writhing roots that lash out to strike a foe. The roots burst from the limb in a sudden surge against an opponent.

rites.name: Neraulor
rites.text: A practitioner's flower-shaped spinning strike that hits harder than its plainer cousin. The user finishes it with a cheerful raised fist gesture.

rites.name: Teosum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes the ground into a wide chasm by performing a sequence of gestures. Anyone standing nearby is swallowed and plunged into the deep stone below.

rites.name: Vintium
rites.text: A fighter splits into many copies to pin a foe in place, then reshapes them into dazzling dancers who swarm the target. While the foe is captivated, the fighter and one copy strike with a spinning orb of force.

rites.name: Saurus
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the soil, causing the ground beneath them to lift and send a rolling wave of earth outward. The technique works as a sudden burst of loose soil.

rites.name: Teleostium
rites.text: Practitioners trace a sequence of marks, and the completed pattern lifts into several glowing cords that wrap around a creature and hold it fast.

rites.name: Meorastus
rites.text: A binding craft that locks a great beast into a chosen bearer. The ward is worked through a sealing script drawn across the vessel's body.

rites.name: Orontum
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a sphere of azure crackling energy that shocks a foe on contact. The bolt carries its charge straight through the target's body.

rites.name: Vornor
rites.text: A bearer can conjure pink thorn-shaped crystals and steer them so they keep stretching toward a chosen target. The growth continues while the bearer directs it.

rites.name: Ceolum
rites.text: A transformed form in which the user lashes out with a spare limb, follows with a horned strike, and ends by sweeping the whole torso across the foe.

rites.name: Vosanum
rites.text: A fighter turns stored energy from food into raw force, leaps skyward, strikes the foe, spins through a pair of kicks, and ends with a heavy punch that drops the opponent hard to the ground.

rites.name: Cornaustor
rites.text: Practitioners of a shore-dwelling order fill the air with dense fog and shape its thickness through inner energy. Once the haze hides foes, they struggle to defend themselves against the user.

rites.name: Vanteoles
rites.text: A practitioner tumbles backward and unrolls a sealed parchment mid-air, releasing a flurry of edged tools that are steered toward a rival.

rites.name: Meoranum
rites.text: A practitioner channels storm energy into a heavy striking staff, sharpening the force of each blow. The surge makes every swing hit harder than the weapon alone could.

rites.name: Coreonerum
rites.text: A practitioner breathes out a great rushing flood and then strikes it with a crackling bolt, so that everything swept into the wave is shocked by the current.

rites.name: Veollernia
rites.text: A caster conjures a false double that rushes at a foe, leaps, and then bursts apart into a swirl of pale pink petals.

rites.name: Tianastus
rites.text: A bearer calls forth a towering spirit-figure that strikes the earth with a clenched fist. The blow sends a violent wave of force rolling outward in both directions.

rites.name: Sillanum
rites.text: A fighter dives at a foe while spinning a bone blade like a drill, then rapidly lashes at several spots on the opponent's body.

rites.name: Amontia
rites.text: A ritual technique where the caster forms four duplicate shadows that orbit a zone and then burst apart in a huge blast.

rites.name: Amoranum
rites.text: A basic transforming art of the inner flame that a practitioner can channel. It is usually linked to a particular sealing gesture made with the fingers.

rites.name: Amaurnes
rites.text: A practitioner stamps the ground to split it beneath a foe, then drives heat down the fissure until the earth boils. Clapping the hands together ignites a great blaze where the enemy stands.

rites.name: Seraularum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent's flank, hooks them with one foot, then pivots on the other leg to hurl them away in a spinning arc.

rites.name: Ameres
rites.text: A small creature stretches and twists its neck to hurl a swarm of tiny parasites at a foe. Those who are sensitive to the bites writhe in agony, while others barely notice the attack.

rites.name: Naullum
rites.text: A caster presses both palms to the earth and raises a heavy golden powder into a towering rolling wave. Its weight can cancel a lighter sand surge when the two meet.

rites.name: Viallor Vianus
rites.text: A practitioner in a altered state delivers a forceful grazing strike with the foot, which seems to sink teeth into the foe during the blow.

rites.name: Nileoranum
rites.text: A bound spirit lashes the earth with its clawed limbs, lifting a rising column of grit into the air. It is a technique that moves ground-dust upward.

rites.name: Centor
rites.text: A wielder leaps high and spins in a whirling motion, striking an opponent with a rough, blade-like weapon that tears through the foe during the rotation.

rites.name: Rianeolus
rites.text: Four bonded wardens activate marked sigils to raise a four-sided barrier that traps a target within. The barrier then erupts with dark force, consuming the captive so completely that nothing remains.

rites.name: Seontium
rites.text: A fighter leaps into the air, strikes with a kick and two punches, then hurls the foe back down using a set of linked chains.

rites.name: Rallum
rites.text: A practitioner rings a resonant bell so its tone strikes an opponent's inner ear and mind, freezing their limbs. The victim sees many copies of the caster, cannot pick out the true one, and is left open to attack.

rites.name: Meonillia
rites.text: A practitioner sweeps a spinning low kick from behind to topple an opponent. Its speed makes it hard to guard against, and a very strong user can send the fallen target skidding away.

rites.name: Meornolium
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a dense cloud of grey dust that coils around a foe and holds them fast. By concentrating inner energy, the caster can sustain the cloud and strengthen its grip.

rites.name: Renolles
rites.text: A fighter darts forward at speed and cuts down the foe with a single swift blade stroke. The technique relies on momentum and a sharp sword.

rites.name: Cilum
rites.text: A practitioner hurls two volatile charges across a distance, the first one flinging the target far backward. It is a method of striking a foe from afar.

rites.name: Ciror
rites.text: A practitioner gulps down a great volume of water, swelling into a rounded shape, then tucks their limbs away and hurls themselves into a heavy rolling charge. The extra mass strikes harder, and the technique can turn an enemy's water attacks back against them.

rites.name: Teloses
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent in rapid succession and launches them skyward with a kick. As the foe falls back, the attacker unleashes a burst of flame at them.

rites.name: Tentus
rites.text: A fighter summons several linked blades and leaps skyward, reeling them into a tall stack. Balanced on the top blade, she spins backward and hurls the blades rapidly at a foe.

rites.name: Sauntollor
rites.text: A fighter releases six coiling appendages and lashes out with them in swift, crushing blows that leave heavy damage behind.

rites.name: Riasiles
rites.text: A bearer forces their own consciousness into slumber so that a bound inner presence takes over, wielding vast stores of power through a shaped figure of sand. The sleeper's body stays exposed, and striking it may rouse them and restore the dominant mind.

rites.name: Amausiaror
rites.text: A sweeping backhand strike wrapped in crackling storm-energy. The blow is strong enough to shatter the ribs of even a towering spirit-guardian.

rites.name: Visiastium
rites.text: A practitioner rolls the body into a massive spinning mass and drives into a foe, leaving a deep crater in the earth. It is often paired with a swelling technique.

rites.name: Nantus
rites.text: A practitioner traps a rival inside a sealed circle of spiraling force and strikes with a rapid flurry of open-hand blows. The technique works through the circle's pattern of eight linked currents.

rites.name: Serarnus
rites.text: A fighter wraps himself in crackling energy, leaps above a downed foe, and drives a falling kick downward. The fall adds force, and it works best right after an opponent is knocked to the ground.

rites.name: Sesanum
rites.text: A cloaked craft that calls forth a swarm of great serpents at once. Each serpent acts on its own, some looming to frighten, some turning attention aside, some seizing the foe, until the enemy is bound before reacting.

rites.name: Corarnes
rites.text: A duelist draws a blade in a single motion and cuts through a rival with a crushing blow. The victim feels nothing until the blade is already returned to its sheath.

rites.name: Valeoria
rites.text: A practitioner gathers crackling storm-energy into an open palm and releases it as a jolt that stuns a foe standing close by.

rites.name: Telontus
rites.text: A fighter whirls a chain-tethered hooked blade in rapid cuts, then leaps forward to deliver a heavy strike that hurls the opponent backward.

rites.name: Sausteolium
rites.text: A fighter draws a bone from the body and shapes it into a blade. Rapid, irregular thrusts from shifting angles blur into phantom shapes, until the target tires and is struck down.

rites.name: Oreolosium
rites.text: A practitioner extends both arms outward and draws dark storm-current through the fists, releasing a shock that jolts everyone standing close by.

rites.name: Molia
rites.text: A transformed beastwoman can unleash a thunderous cry strong enough to shatter objects and injure foes. She gathers stored energy from a crystal in her throat before releasing it.

rites.name: Liranum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent four times, then unleashes a rapid flurry of twenty forceful blows. A pair of kicks finishes the assault, hurling the foe away.

rites.name: Nores
rites.text: A binding art where a bound tree is ignited so that it bursts apart after it has trapped a foe. The trunk erupts violently once its captive is held.

rites.name: Nantia
rites.text: Several practitioners breathe flaming spheres downward from above, surrounding a foe so that no path of escape remains open.

rites.name: Seorium
rites.text: A great beast-tamer's technique hurls the air or the earth outward with immense force, forming slashing waves that cut across the land in front of the wielder.

rites.name: Amontises
rites.text: A practitioner lifts a sealed stone blocking a warded doorway so that companions can cross inside. The protective ward stays whole and unbroken while they pass.

rites.name: Ceolarium
rites.text: A quick technique in which a practitioner strikes an opponent several times, then spins and cuts with a sharp energy blade. The attack ends with a volley of thin needles thrown to finish the foe.

rites.name: Sillontus
rites.text: A practiced seer reads incoming blows before they land, letting the wielder slip aside or answer with a swift strike of their own.

rites.name: Tintanum
rites.text: A tracer wields thrown blades strung with fine cords, scattering them to form a web that binds a foe once a single line is cut. A keen-eyed fighter can redirect the same blades to ensnare the trapper instead.

rites.name: Verium
rites.text: A bearer lunges swiftly toward a rival, cutting them with a sweeping blade. The technique relies on speed and close-range danger.

rites.name: Meornes
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent several times with a cooking pan, then leaps forward and finishes with a crushing punch. It is a combat technique that ends a bout in a single heavy blow.

rites.name: Serialanum
rites.text: A mind-trap that convinces a captive they are wrapped in a coiling living trunk, pinning their body in place while they stay awake. It is passed among a hidden village's folk and serves for questioning or a quiet finish.

rites.name: Leontor
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth dark and azure fire in rapid, scorching volleys that consume everything nearby. By pointing two fingers, they steer the blaze mid-flight, so targets struggle to dodge it.

rites.name: Causternor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers fine metallic grains into a mantle that wraps around their body. The shifting veil deflects incoming strikes.

rites.name: Rinus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy into the palm and seizes a foe with it. Its full effects remain unclear, yet a rival of great skill once halted its use against a group of mountain-dwelling amphibians.

rites.name: Mirnor
rites.text: A rift tears open in the heavens and pours a heavy torrent of sludge onto a foe. Combined with bindings of crackling light and a sealed earthen chamber, the mud is fired to stone and holds the target motionless.

rites.name: Taror
rites.text: A practitioner plays a resonant instrument so that a rival's shadow rises and coils about its owner, choking the breath from them.

rites.name: Vausiarus
rites.text: A fighter forms two duplicates that clasp one another while the original grips both. The original whirls rapidly to build momentum, then hurls the linked duplicates at a foe like a spinning blade.

rites.name: Cialleria
rites.text: A scribe pours his dark pigment straight from the vessel rather than painting with it, summoning a swarm of living serpents that strike at the foe.

rites.name: Seriarnum
rites.text: A coordinated assault where a toxic cloud traps a foe, then a leaping ally hurls needles while a beast of burden lobs a volley of volatile charges into the haze, ending in a blast.

rites.name: Riasontes
rites.text: A long-distance fire craft in which the user releases a barrage of flame orbs that burst into blasts when they strike a target.

rites.name: Cernorum
rites.text: A crackling discipline of lightning-channelling, devised by a wandering apprentice while studying under a cunning serpent-minded mentor. Practitioners hurl bolts of storm-energy through the hand.

rites.name: Seriarnanum
rites.text: A fighter kicks a foe, slashes repeatedly with a great blade, then strikes with elbows and fists. A final heavy downward cut sends the opponent staggering backward.

rites.name: Reores
rites.text: A practitioner wraps their forearm in a shell of living stone to strike an enemy with a hardened blow while keeping their own flesh shielded. The shell can be made heavier to deliver a more crushing impact.

rites.name: Narnus
rites.text: Every apprentice learns to split a faint double of oneself from the body. These doubles have no weight and cannot strike, so they serve only to confuse foes while a real attack is readied.

rites.name: Caulia
rites.text: A combined craft that fuses the flame and stone arts, so that each practitioner shapes molten rock in their own distinct manner. No two adepts wield it quite alike.

rites.name: Rauristes
rites.text: A practitioner conjures many small burning spheres at once and sends them streaming toward a chosen foe. Each sphere strikes with its own heat.

rites.name: Valorniasum
rites.text: A bearer, fueled by a dark marked power, strikes a foe with rapid blade cuts, then leaps skyward and hurls a blazing sphere downward to end the duel.

rites.name: Vontum Tianesium
rites.text: A caster seizes a foe and hurls them skyward, then calls forth a great armored beast that swings a forked pole to bring the falling foe down.

rites.name: Carnus
rites.text: A cold craft that shapes frozen mass into a dark serpentine spirit, flung forward by a sweeping arm. Upon striking, its spinning body hurls the struck foe skyward.

rites.name: Silium
rites.text: A swift finishing technique where the practitioner strikes with hands and feet while petals drift in her wake. It is used to quickly overwhelm and knock out an opponent.

rites.name: Oriarnaunes
rites.text: A practitioner binds their own senses to a small creature so they perceive whatever it sees and hears from afar. They also feel the moment the creature perishes.

rites.name: Siarosium
rites.text: A bearer calls forth a volley of blades out of nothing and flings them at a foe. Each arc of steel is summoned on demand and strikes from several directions at once.

rites.name: Riares
rites.text: A binding illusion that ensnares a foe within a false vision, needing no direct gaze to take hold. Upon casting, a swarm of dark birds pours forth, leaving the target helpless before the caster.

rites.name: Oraustes
rites.text: A puppeteer's craft in which a practitioner animates a bound effigy to loose a long barbed spray of metal grit that encircles the wielder and pierces an adversary.

rites.name: Valianium
rites.text: A fighter seizes an opponent, spins them around, and delivers three hard blows to the back that hurl them away.

rites.name: Cinestum
rites.text: A bruising strike art in which a wielder batters a foe repeatedly with a flat iron cookware piece, then surges into fury and drives a final punch that hurls the target far away.

rites.name: Raurnialum
rites.text: A practitioner buries a foe under many stacked layers of loose grains, then presses them into a towering pyramid that traps the captive inside. Charms affixed to its surface can strengthen the binding.

rites.name: Ciastes
rites.text: A fighter leaps toward an enemy hovering in the air and strikes with a forceful crossing slash. It is a technique for hitting targets that have risen off the ground.

rites.name: Oronarum
rites.text: A spat venom that turns a victim to stone within moments of touching them. The toxin is tied to a hidden reversed pattern of scales found on its carrier.

rites.name: Corosum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes inner life-force into burning heat, leaps high into the air, and hurls a great sphere of fire straight at a foe.

rites.name: Sereolum
rites.text: A bearer calls forth a volley of arrows made entirely of living flame. Arrows that strike nothing scatter their fire across the nearby ground.

rites.name: Teolleres
rites.text: A caster raises shimmering wings and beats them toward a rival, releasing a rolling cloud of fine glittering dust that washes over the target.

rites.name: Orinarnia
rites.text: A practitioner swings a blade and releases a blade-shaped surge of inner energy. The surge can easily cut through hard stone and packed earth.

rites.name: Miarollium
rites.text: A paired technique in which one practitioner clouds a foe's mind with an illusion and binds them in growth, then a partner strikes from above with a sharpened energy edge to finish the bout.

rites.name: Tauniallium
rites.text: A grim craft in which a practitioner binds foes with wire and a long blade, arranging their bodies in a cruel pose. The final thrust leaves each victim to suffer a lingering death.

rites.name: Oraulonus
rites.text: A craft in which fine dark grains are drawn into magnetic blades, spears, and spikes that strike at a foe. The practitioner can also mark enemies so that these edges always find their mark.

rites.name: Valeosorus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a towering barrier of heat that shields them from attack while scorching anyone who presses against it.

rites.name: Sostia
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a towering barrier of fire to confuse an opponent. Under cover of that blaze, the caster slips away unseen.

rites.name: Rianeontium
rites.text: A craft drawn from a life energy stored in certain carved stones, working without the inner flow that trained warriors use. Its practitioners are not warriors, though the energy can be woven into martial arts.

rites.name: Ameosiallus
rites.text: A practitioner shapes an inner life-force into a caustic mist that seeps from the earth at chosen points. The practitioner can then ignite each pocket of mist, setting off blasts at those spots.

rites.name: Coreoliania
rites.text: The wielder channels earth-bound energy through the body, turning the skin dark and hardened. This shell shrugs off most blows, though a particular storm-power still pierces it, and strikes gain added force.

rites.name: Sestalum
rites.text: A warrior draws two pale bone blades, dives in to cut twice, then unleashes a rapid barrage of thrusts. Finally, circling behind the foe, they erupt with sharp spurs of bone that pierce the enemy.

rites.name: Naulestor
rites.text: A caster rapidly chills the nearby air into a clear, dome-shaped shelter around themselves and companions. The shelter holds firm against many blasts at once while staying nearly unharmed.

rites.name: Ceror
rites.text: A paired technique where a fanged beast and its rider launch a foe skyward, then spin with growing force to trap and finish the target mid-attack.

rites.name: Leosinum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a horde of serpents that seize a foe and whirl them about before hurling them skyward. The serpents then batter the falling target away.

rites.name: Ameollinium
rites.text: A fighter swiftly strikes with a blade, releasing a surge of inner energy that ripples outward in every direction. The wave slices through several foes in rapid succession.

rites.name: Cosanum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a dense hovering cloud of tiny creatures that hurls destructive swarms at a foe. The cloud drifts forward to strike the target.

rites.name: Valorium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a dense wall of drifting haze that blinds everyone trapped inside it. The haze also swallows all noise so it cannot be heard beyond its edge.

rites.name: Meonium
rites.text: A fighter drives a spear of crackling storm energy downward, gathering lightning at the foe's feet to paralyse them. A rising sweep then slashes through the stunned target.

rites.name: Amarnia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes water into long insect-like claws that extend their reach in combat. Channeled life-force flows through the claws, sharpening each strike so it pierces deeper.

rites.name: Vausorus
rites.text: A practitioner forms a spinning sphere of force, then coats it with burning breath until it blackens and wreathes itself in a ring of fire. On impact it erupts into a churning storm of flame that reduces the target to ash.

rites.name: Valiaror
rites.text: A practitioner lifts a rival into the air and fuses three elemental sigils into a single blast that engulfs the target. The technique is a combined strike that binds several arts into one devastating burst.

rites.name: Serarialia
rites.text: A practitioner vanishes and reappears in an instant before a rival, striking with a staff crackling with storm energy.

rites.name: Ciasanes
rites.text: A paired hunter and its bonded beast fuse into one shared form, a two-headed wolf with long claws and double fangs. While in this shape, their strikes and techniques grow far more destructive, and they are typically aimed at prey that has been driven into a corner.

rites.name: Amaror
rites.text: A practitioner draws the surrounding ground and all things upon it toward a central pit, pulling foes beneath the earth. Those caught are trapped or smothered, and the pit's width grows with the energy poured into it.

rites.name: Menteonor
rites.text: A practitioner releases small seeking orbs that gather and form large coiling tendrils rising from the ground beneath an opponent. The technique strikes from below, catching foes by surprise.

rites.name: Sollanum
rites.text: A bearer ignites a great crimson orb of inner force that bursts outward in a wide blast. Foes are weakened by the eruption while allies around the bearer are strengthened.

rites.name: Naranum
rites.text: A bearer enters a dreamlike mental realm and calls down pale, enormous spikes from above. Any foe trapped inside the enclosing barrier is pierced and held in place.

rites.name: Veollasus
rites.text: A practitioner channels rushing air to hasten their own motion until the world narrows to a tunnel. Companions can drive the practitioner forward from the feet to reach greater speed, or lend the same rush to an ally.

rites.name: Telilor
rites.text: A practitioner draws out a glowing orb of inner sight into a long cord that lances through a rival's defenses. The cord seeks out the target and pierces them where they stand.

rites.name: Amosus
rites.text: A practitioner channels a crackling vital force that quickens the nerve signals running from mind to limb, so strikes fly faster. Bare-handed blows can also slice through what they touch.

rites.name: Liasteolum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a huge clay cover high above the ground, which then drops onto a foe and seals them beneath it. The technique is used to pin down an enemy completely.

rites.name: Naliasus
rites.text: A wielder coils about with a set of great appendages and spins to strike every foe encircling them. The motion sweeps outward from the body and gathers all nearby enemies into its path.

rites.name: Neonalum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers dark electric energy from within the body and sends it out as a swift, beast-shaped current. The strike shocks everything it touches, and over water it spreads wide to catch many foes at once.

rites.name: Maustum
rites.text: A practitioner draws the air cold enough to freeze the surrounding moisture into a clouding rime. Within it the user fades from sight, though a sharp blow reveals them again, and listening for their movements can still locate them.

rites.name: Sinaria
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward bearing seven blades and crashes onto a foe while wrapped in crackling storm energy.

rites.name: Reontia
