rites.text: A dark binding craft that marks a victim's body with black sigils, letting the caster hold them under control and end their life whenever it is convenient.

rites.name: Tiallum
rites.text: A caster flicks a spike of gathered inner force from a fingertip that never misses its mark. The spike can be shaped to restore, numb, or end the life of whatever it strikes, and several can fly at once and bend mid-flight.

rites.name: Ristum
rites.text: A ritual technique where a caster calls down a towering spectral guardian that hurls four great blades from above onto foes below.

rites.name: Morninor
rites.text: A fighter spins the whole body flat while wielding twin blades, striking rapidly in quick succession. The spinning motion lets each strike follow the last without pause.

rites.name: Nines
rites.text: A bearer lifts drifting grit into a towering column that bursts up from the earth beneath a foe. The eruption hurls the target violently into the sky.

rites.name: Amollum
rites.text: A practitioner draws moisture from the surrounding air into a swarm of fine spikes. The spikes are aimed at a single foe while the caster springs backward to stay clear of the blast.

rites.name: Valirnontor
rites.text: A disciplined close-combat technique in which a practitioner strikes an opponent's body with open palms, leaps in to strike again at the chest, then pushes away with the feet to send the foe staggering backward.

rites.name: Coreosires
rites.text: A practitioner can swell the iron-rich blood inside a person until their body swells into a far larger shape that hides who they truly are. Opening a wound to let the excess flow out restores the original form.

rites.name: Lones
rites.text: A practitioner curls into a rolling mass and bounces repeatedly off the air. On the third rebound the bearer crashes down, pressing the foe hard into the ground.

rites.name: Tellones
rites.text: Two bearers each shape a burning force that merges into one vast ball of flame. It bursts upon the foe with devastating heat.

rites.name: Mausolum
rites.text: A trapping craft that binds a foe within a false vision, where the earth seems to split apart and drop them into an endless abyss of suffering.

rites.name: Coroneosus
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a huge jade-colored star of crystal shaped like a snowflake and hurls it at a foe. Though its edges are keen, it fails to pierce a massive beast's hardened carapace.

rites.name: Neoliastor
rites.text: A towering armored guardian is summoned around its user, who leaps skyward and plunges down on a foe with a great blade. The technique is used in combat against an opponent.

rites.name: Serintausor
rites.text: A great whirlwind is summoned by a warrior's skill, pulling foes into its spinning core where they are cut apart by unseen gusts.

rites.name: Teontanum
rites.text: A practitioner locks eyes with a target and seizes control of its limbs. The caster's irises tighten to pinpoints while faint vein-lines rise white across the eyes.

rites.name: Caustes
rites.text: A fiery technique in which a wielder shapes burning flames drawn from an inner transformation into grasping hands. The hands are used to strike at opponents.

rites.name: Sausium
rites.text: A practitioner wraps herself in drifting rose-colored shards, shaping them into many throwing blades that orbit around her before being hurled at great speed.

rites.name: Amirnanum
rites.text: A fighter drives a clenched fist into a foe with immense force. The blow is a technique practiced by warriors of a temple-bound order.

rites.name: Serinor
rites.text: A mind-binding craft that traps a foe inside a conjured dream. The victim feels phantom spikes pierce their body, leaving them unable to move, and the agony makes it a tool of cruel interrogation.

rites.name: Tisus
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, strikes with a bubble-shaped instrument, follows with two open-handed swipes, and ends with a spinning kick that sends the foe plunging to the ground.

rites.name: Amesauranum
rites.text: A fighter drops onto all fours and wraps their body in inner energy, gaining swift, precise movement. They strike and retreat rapidly, staying in motion so foes struggle to track them.

rites.name: Taustus
rites.text: A bearer extends an arm to press a searing stone seal onto a foe, where it lodges and grows bright. The mark then bursts, destroying whoever carries it.

rites.name: Teliastor
rites.text: A bearer grows one tail-like limb and releases three small ember creatures that burst into flame when anything draws near.

rites.name: Viarnia
rites.text: A charged technique in which a practitioner impales a foe, hurls a volley of marked blades, and sends some ahead through a spatial rift. A hound-shaped duplicate then releases the remaining blades, and the two volleys meet as the wielder leaps down from above.

rites.name: Telostus
rites.text: A ruler of storm wind releases a crackling tide of charged energy that harms any foe standing nearby. Its reach depends on the caster's immediate surroundings.

rites.name: Cialia
rites.text: A practitioner ignites a spiraling blaze around their own body and hurls it outward with their hands. On contact, the target is lifted into the air in a spiral and reduced to ash.

rites.name: Oriarnia
rites.text: A bearer reshapes parts of their own body to hit harder and reach farther. Shaping the legs grants swift straight-line motion, and tightening muscle grants quickness and nimbleness.

rites.name: Valeostia
rites.text: A practiced fighter coats a blade with inner energy, then swings it so that a sharp crescent of that energy leaps outward to strike a distant foe. The technique works as a quick attack at range.

rites.name: Niarirnes
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a combatant strikes twice, once high and once low, then drives the opponent down into the ground.

rites.name: Vasus
rites.text: A rider perches atop a great beast, who strikes at foes with a clawed swipe before the rider leaps down to finish them with a heavy blade. When the beast rises onto its hind legs, it seizes the enemy in its forelimbs and the rider delivers a sweeping blow.

rites.name: Seontor Telaranum
rites.text: A ruler sends a swirling mass of golden grains toward a foe, then raises sharp spikes from it that strike anyone within reach.

rites.name: Serialles
rites.text: Three allies attack an enemy in a coordinated sequence. One opens with slashes, a second leaps and hurls small bursts of flame, the blades cut through the fire, and a final stomp ends the assault amid shouts of encouragement.

rites.name: Mauntillor
rites.text: Two wanderers call on their creature allies to combine a great burning surge of oily flame. The technique spreads across the field as a single towering wave of fire.

rites.name: Amillanum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes fine dark grit drawn from the ground into four great blocks around a foe, and the blocks then sprout sharp points. The technique is worked through an animated effigy of a former ruler.

rites.name: Corolirium
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward and spins a chain-tethered hooked blade, striking several times before hurling the foe back to the ground.

rites.name: Miallorium
rites.text: A swift combat technique in which the wielder strikes an opponent several times with fists, then ends the exchange with two sharp slashes.

rites.name: Amisanum
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a charged cloud of gray dust that spreads over a broad area and scorches anyone touching it. The veil also drives off attackers and hides movement, needing no gestures.

rites.name: Teliarnium
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth several bolts of sky-fire that carve through earth or air and strike a chosen foe. The bolts keep seeking their target until they connect.

rites.name: Mirus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior strikes an opponent with a rapid volley of thrown blade slashes and spinning kicks. It ends with a leaping knee to the chin followed by a whirling heel strike downward.

rites.name: Valostium
rites.text: A practitioner releases two forceful waves of gathered inner energy from both hands at once. The blast strikes an adversary's core while also hurling them to the ground.

rites.name: Telesanum
rites.text: A caster points a finger and releases a faded violet ripple that reaches a foe and makes them perceive a ring of cold azure flame encircling them. They then believe their own body is engulfed in the same blue blaze.

rites.name: Mostiallor
rites.text: A paired technique in which one fighter lifts a foe skyward and a second strikes them down, both finishing with a crushing double kick that splits the earth beneath.

rites.name: Contiasum
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets its user perceive the world through the painted eyes of a sacred serpent mural. The practitioner can overhear whispered speech from the rooms beyond.

rites.name: Tasteornor
rites.text: A warrior wreathes their body in a glowing aura and lashes out with a long luminous limb, striking from the sides, above, and below. The technique is used as a fighting art.

rites.name: Amines
rites.text: A practitioner flicks their wrist to loose a swarm of tiny crackling sparks toward a chosen target. The craft relies on swift motion and a steady hand.

rites.name: Valaurnus
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a rolling sheet of flame that encircles a foe, then folds itself into a clawed weaver that strikes while holding the target in place. The blaze can also drive the captive toward a second assault.

rites.name: Seonellia
rites.text: A swelling warrior enlarges their body, then whirls with outstretched arms, striking a foe again and again with rapid blows.

rites.name: Telirium
rites.text: A practitioner calls up great masses of stone from a deep gorge to serve other workings. They can also sink their will into the ground to reshape it for ambushes, or pay a drop of blood to shape a boulder into a chosen design.

rites.name: Vasia
rites.text: A bound-shadow maneuver in which one fighter pins the foe in place by threading their dark silhouette, while a partner lengthens an energy edge on a blade and cuts down the trapped target.

rites.name: Tenor
rites.text: A duo strikes at a foe by hurling a blade, only to find the target is a disguised double that answers with a spinning sphere of force.

rites.name: Vornum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes long, sharp rose-hued shards that hurl toward a foe with exact aim. Smaller shards of the same hue can be formed to snare the opponent in place.

rites.name: Amosum
rites.text: A practitioner appears before a foe, draws a blade and strikes many times in an instant, then reappears behind the opponent. The foe collapses once the blade is returned to its sheath.

rites.name: Ameonausor
rites.text: A practitioner freezes foes with a piercing gaze, then conjures a vast ring of flame that drags everyone nearby inward and burns them away.

rites.name: Casanum
rites.text: Several earth-shapers together make a rite of gesture and spit, pushing out streams of wet soil that harden into rising pillars. The pillars join into a sturdy barrier that guards against attack.

rites.name: Cialor
rites.text: A fighter raises a fist in a rising strike and calls up a column of granular dust that hurls the foe skyward. The technique is a close-quarters craft that wields shifting desert grit as a weapon.

rites.name: Seornallia
rites.text: A hidden technique where a practitioner conceals a creature beneath the earth. When it is placed beneath an opponent, it rises up and traps the target within its body.

rites.name: Mentistanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an enemy from beneath the ground, then plants a charge where the foe will fall. The charge detonates the moment the enemy lands.

rites.name: Celus Cauntanum
rites.text: A binding craft that draws up several standing columns of hardened earth from the ground beneath a foe, sealing them inside a ring of stone.

rites.name: Montanum
rites.text: A practitioner sinks beneath the soil to rise up and strike an enemy from below. A second technique uses sharpened energy blades to sever the foe's binding cords.

rites.name: Silliaror
rites.text: Bearers of an inner beast can draw on borrowed powers from it. As they grow in mastery or lose hold of it, they shift toward the beast's own form and abilities.

rites.name: Telernium Seolernium
rites.text: A practitioner coats their hands in a frozen sheath that sharpens their blows or lets them stop harder strikes with their fists. The technique is a craft of enhanced striking and defense.

rites.name: Maneores
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent upward into the air, then leaps after them to spin and drive them headfirst into the ground. The technique ends with a triumphant pose of raised arms and joined legs.

rites.name: Amarilus
rites.text: A duplicated bearer releases twin serpentine flame-bursts at foes while a blade is flung overhead. The bearer swaps positions with the blade, showering a ring of burning cinders downward from above.

rites.name: Serneontes
rites.text: A practitioner turns into drifting vapor and slips through the nose and mouth of a victim. Once inside, the vapor corrodes every organ from within, causing agony and sometimes death.

rites.name: Veollia
rites.text: A practitioner heats an inner life-energy until it nearly boils, then vents scalding vapor from the body and drives a punch empowered by that steam, hurling the target a great distance.

rites.name: Oriastium
rites.text: A wielder swings a curved blade to drag a foe close, then hurls them away with a spinning throw. The attack ends with a heavy kick that drives the victim into the earth.

rites.name: Raules
rites.text: A joint technique where one practitioner lays a broad pool of water and a partner sends a crackling current through it, bursting the target in a blast.

rites.name: Valarostia
rites.text: A wielder conjures a ring of fiery orbs that circle around them. The orbs shield the caster from incoming blows and burn anyone who attacks.

rites.name: Valaunum
rites.text: A bearer of a surge of heightened swiftness dashes through every foe nearby in one rapid sweep. The technique turns raw speed into a whirlwind that overwhelms all who stand within reach.

rites.name: Riantus
rites.text: A wielder unleashes a burst of flame, then strikes the foe with a curved blade and a folding fan hidden inside the blast. The technique combines fire and close-quarters weapon attacks.

rites.name: Amostiarnor
rites.text: A bound warrior seizes a foe, leaps skyward, and hurls them back to earth while a mass of shifting grit crushes them. The move is a brutal finishing technique.

rites.name: Voralia
rites.text: A practitioner spits a great mass of molten stone that hardens mid-air into several glowing boulders, hurled at a foe with crushing force. The burning rocks slice through most materials and scatter so widely that they are hard to dodge.

rites.name: Telostanum
rites.text: A practitioner shatters a hill and drives marked stakes into the ground, and each stake holds a binding craft that together forms a shifting maze of walls.

rites.name: Taustenes
rites.text: A practitioner draws a vast woven sheet over their body and the ground around them. Beneath it they slip away from a field of conflict without being seen.

rites.name: Naureontor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a purplish surge of lightning from their palms, striking foes and hurling them backward. It is a shorter-reaching discharge than a rival current, and its jolt stuns rather than slays.

rites.name: Cerneostor
rites.text: A bearer forges two curved cutting tools at once and spins through a crowd, turning into a storm of edges that wounds every foe caught within its reach.

rites.name: Amirnor Leosia
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent several times, launching them skyward. Then the fighter leaps and drives a sweeping blow downward, smashing the foe into the ground.

rites.name: Vaulor
rites.text: This craft unbalances the hidden supports of a hollow in the hillside, so that even the sturdiest shelter weakens and gives way. Hunters of the stone-clans lure their rivals inside and trigger it, letting falling rock bury them.

rites.name: Orontesanum
rites.text: A binding illusion that clouds a foe's sight across an entire area. The victim feels as if they are sinking into deep mud, so they cannot move.

rites.name: Ceolonus
rites.text: A wielder plants a hand into the earth, and a towering shadow-arm bursts up to seize a foe and hurl them down. The wielder then releases a narrow flare that swells on impact, gouging a vast pit into the ground.

rites.name: Liastus
rites.text: Two echo-figures spill slick tar while the caster hurls flame, and the two streams whirl together into a blazing spiral.

rites.name: Colium
rites.text: A wielder strikes a foe with a forceful blow, and a reef-like growth spreads outward from the impact point. It hardens quickly and keeps the target from moving until it encloses their whole body.

rites.name: Casialor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers two bolts of crackling energy into their hands and charges forward. They drive one bolt into the foe, then the second immediately follows through the same opening.

rites.name: Vaules
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a great store of inner power into one fist and releases it with a single strike. The blow carries the full force of that gathered energy into the target.

rites.name: Siarintus
rites.text: A practitioner calls down a torrent of lightning strikes upon a rival. The strikes crash in quick succession, striking the target with storm force.

rites.name: Leolium
rites.text: A hidden method where a caster sends a cloud of small biting creatures beneath a rival before striking, draining the foe's inner energy. It loses force against foes whose energy stores exceed what the swarm can consume.

rites.name: Telosarium
rites.text: A fighter whirls a fan to stir a rushing breeze at a foe, then ignites the gust into a sweeping storm of flame that scorches the target.

rites.name: Cineosium
rites.text: A coordinated strike sequence where a duo slices an enemy, then strikes them while airborne, and finally drives them back to the ground with a kick.

rites.name: Casiarnanum
rites.text: A close-combat strike in which the user drives an elbow into a foe while bracing it with the other arm. The blow is strong enough to break even hardened coral.

rites.name: Mirnium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers fine golden particles into the air and lets them rain downward onto a rival below. The shimmering dust strikes the target from above.

rites.name: Misarnor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes their own burning flames into a false vision of a creature that is part dog and part cat. The illusion uses fire to deceive the eyes of those who see it.

rites.name: Nellor
rites.text: A blade discipline practiced by covert operatives. The practitioner strikes an enemy with a rapid sequence of quick cuts using a short, two-edged, pointless knife.

rites.name: Veorum
rites.text: A fighter channels a mechanical drill mounted on one arm and fires it with such force that it reshapes the land around them. The blow can split a river, creating a narrow point where enemies can be ambushed.

rites.name: Coreostia
rites.text: A practitioner sinks briefly into the ground, walls, or nearby surfaces, slipping past danger and moving unseen. From this hidden approach they can strike an unsuspecting foe.

rites.name: Amanes
rites.text: A blended craft that fuses ember-heat with flowing tide, and its shape changes depending on the practitioner who wields it. No two users shape it quite the same way.

rites.name: Cellanum
rites.text: A fighter spins with a short blade and strikes an opponent several times in quick succession. It is a close-range technique used in combat.

rites.name: Maurnus
rites.text: A practitioner strikes an adversary in rapid succession, then hurls a flurry of flame-coated blades from above. The burning shards ignite a violent blast upon impact.

rites.name: Vaulor Serausterum
rites.text: A practitioner swings a folding fan while exhaling flame, sending a barrier of burning spiraling winds outward. The technique turns a simple gesture into a wall of fire.

rites.name: Siallorus
rites.text: A practitioner channels crackling storm energy through their body and then charges at an enemy, delivering a punch at full speed.

rites.name: Valolus
rites.text: A defensive guard that turns an incoming blow back on its striker. The practitioner catches the attacker, hurls them skyward with a sweeping motion, then finishes the falling body with a single forceful palm strike.

rites.name: Orollor
rites.text: Three young fighters strike in sequence: first a volley of water bolts, then a tree that grows from sticky sap to impale foes, and finally a giant toad that crushes both the tree and the enemy.

rites.name: Lianentium
rites.text: A crafter shapes a large clay avian that plunges toward the earth and bursts apart on impact. The blast goes off whether or not any foe stands in its path.

rites.name: Virnanum
rites.text: A basic craft taught to young initiates, where a practitioner presses a hand to the soil to loosen and shift it. Skilled users can move larger stretches of ground, and groups working together still find it useful in fights.

rites.name: Vestirum
rites.text: A dark technique in which the practitioner summons hovering iron orbs that drop from the sky and strike at foes all around him. The orbs pursue whoever stands near the caster.

rites.name: Amilauntus
rites.text: A practitioner seizes a foe and ignites a scarlet burst that consumes both of them. A sturdy enough guard lets the foe walk away untouched.

rites.name: Ceosanor
rites.text: A practitioner forms a set of ritual gestures and then strikes the earth, causing the ground beneath an opponent to burst upward. The same strike can raise walls of stone that take a long time to climb over.

rites.name: Mornaulia
rites.text: A practitioner moves swiftly toward a target while readying a blade, then delivers a single slashing blow upon arrival. The technique combines rapid approach with one decisive cut.

rites.name: Sirnum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers loose grit and shapes many animated figures from it, sending them to attack a rival. Each figure is fragile and shatters under a single strike.

rites.name: Conor
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a wielder calls up sealed fire from within, releasing it suddenly against a foe to catch them unprepared.

rites.name: Mistus
rites.text: A practitioner calls down a mountain's snow in a rushing slide that reshapes into a pack of hunting beasts. The pack collapses when struck by a storm of crackling lightning.

rites.name: Testaullium
rites.text: A grappling craft in which a fighter pretends to embrace an opponent, then lifts them over the shoulders and hurls them down onto the ground.

rites.name: Laulum
rites.text: Two fighters move in a fierce sequence, striking with flame-wrapped blades before releasing twin serpentine blazes from their sides to finish the foe.

rites.name: Tesium
rites.text: A coordinated craft in which a circle of practitioners traps a foe inside a glowing, pyramid-shaped ward. They then detonate the ward so that the enclosed victim is harmed, ideally fatally.

rites.name: Serostellor
rites.text: A hushed illusion-craft that a captor weaves over a bound prisoner to erode their resolve and draw out secrets. It fails against a captive whose inner resolve is firm.

rites.name: Lenanum
rites.text: A paired technique where two fighters dart around a foe, slashing at it, then strike from opposite sides with a crossing slash and bite.

rites.name: Amesostor
rites.text: A bearer summons dark serpents that bind a foe and slowly drain their inner energy. The coils tighten whenever the captive tries to draw on that energy.

rites.name: Tillium
rites.text: A practitioner releases a great surge of water from the mouth, then threads crackling storm-force into it. Anything caught in the flood is instantly shocked.

rites.name: Amauntor
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a swarm of illusory blossoms that deceive the eye. When the illusion dissolves, the petals reveal themselves as volatile charges that burst into flame as an enemy draws near.

rites.name: Cistosum
rites.text: A fighter leaps high toward a foe, strikes twice with a transformed rod, then lands a final blow to the skull with the rod's tip as it swells in size.

rites.name: Mistelor
rites.text: A bearer softens fragments of their own plating into a dark fluid that obeys their will. Hardened once more, the stuff resists piercing and can be poured over a foe to seal their limbs within.

rites.name: Veornes
rites.text: Two fighters fuse their charging strikes into one unified kick aimed at a single foe. The joined force hits the opponent as if delivered by a single body.

rites.name: Costor
rites.text: A ritual cutting craft where a practitioner strikes an opponent twice from behind, then once from the front. After freezing the target in place, the practitioner delivers a brief backward kick.

rites.name: Valialor
rites.text: A binding craft in which a caster forces a target to be struck by many small carved figures, and once the final figure is shattered, the caster gains full command of the target's body against their will. The victim often suffers agony during the seizure.

rites.name: Rauntia
rites.text: A user hurls a rolling tide of dark grit downward onto an enemy. The same grit can also wrap around a foe and squeeze them until they are crushed.

rites.name: Amiares
rites.text: A caster traps a rival inside a false vision of a tall spire, then secretly plants volatile charms across its walls. When the charms are triggered, the illusory tower collapses around the victim.

rites.name: Morum Tirnenor
rites.text: A fighter leaps into the air, slashes an opponent three times with blades, then kicks them so they crash down to the ground.

rites.name: Riastus
rites.text: A fighter drives a blade into the soil, setting off a chain of blasts that split the earth beneath an opponent's feet. While the foe staggers, a final sweeping cut ends the clash.

rites.name: Nantaustus
rites.text: A fighter leaps high and crashes down onto a foe, and a column of glowing red energy erupts upward once the strike connects.

rites.name: Amiastium
rites.text: A practitioner splits their presence into several duplicate forms that all strike together with an elemental blast aimed at one foe. The copies and the blast arrive at the same moment.

rites.name: Valorus
rites.text: A practitioner sweeps a ceremonial fan downward, calling forth a surge of crackling storm-light that wraps around their body.

rites.name: Misenor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes and drags many slabs of rock around a rival. Two enormous slabs are then formed that press in and crush the target.

rites.name: Vollentor
rites.text: A bearer raises twin living timber columns from the soil that coil skyward and hurl a foe into the air. They then close in from both flanks and crush the trapped target.

rites.name: Sentolanum
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter strikes with elbow, blade and knee, then leaps over the foe and hurls a blazing sphere from above and behind.

rites.name: Nostes
rites.text: A caster raises a crystalline wall that freezes everything inside it in stillness. The enclosed must be fed a steady stream of vital energy to stay held, and if the caster falters, those trapped with enough reserves can break free.

rites.name: Vontium
rites.text: A set of mystical battle arts that only trained fighters can wield, drawn from an inner life-force. Practitioners shape it through finger gestures, and countless variations remain unfound.

rites.name: Amenallanum
rites.text: Two practitioners combine forces, one binding a foe with crackling charge and the other igniting them into a bursting blast. The shock prepares the target for the flame that follows.

rites.name: Orernus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a swirl of pale petals around themselves and hurls three clustered bundles of them at a foe. The petals travel as sharp drifting projectiles.

rites.name: Varnes
rites.text: A practitioner turns their body insubstantial and charges an opponent unseen. At the final instant they solidify and cut the foe with a short blade.

rites.name: Rornauntes
rites.text: A practitioner points an open palm at a foe and flings a spinning storm of sharp frost shards. The swirling shards trap the target and partly seal them in a crust of ice.

rites.name: Villesum
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a crafter scatters small shaped clay creatures onto a foe while riding a tiny clay bird aloft. The bird carries the crafter through the air during the assault.

rites.name: Rarnanum
rites.text: A coordinated strike in which four summoned blades are wielded in sequence: one delivers a crushing blow, another pins and binds the foe, a third stuns with crackling force, and a final jet of water detonates into a violent swirling vortex.

rites.name: Telauror Veontornium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a cloud of drifting blossoms that wraps around a chosen target while the surrounding light dims into shadow.

rites.name: Valesistor
rites.text: A caster seizes a foe with an illusion that conjures coils rising from the ground beneath them. At the caster's word, the coils tighten and crush the victim.

rites.name: Teleosaria
rites.text: A practitioner spits a stream of flame that races straight ahead like a beast's breath. On striking a target it wraps that spot in fire, focused on one point rather than the surrounding area.

rites.name: Nialaranum
rites.text: A practitioner presses a palm against the earth, raising a web of glowing lines beneath the ground. Anyone caught within the web is wracked with agonizing pain.

rites.name: Corelarnum
rites.text: A binding touch pulls a rival into a false dreamscape. Everyone the trapped one sees there wears the caster's face, while drifting hearts and violet mist fill the air.

rites.name: Amaseontor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a swarm of duplicate selves and wraps a spinning sphere of force around their strike. The added spin tears through guards and holds the foe down.

rites.name: Vauntelor
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a wheel-shaped blade that splits into three duplicate blades flying at a single foe. The technique turns one throw into a trio of strikes.

rites.name: Nales
rites.text: A practitioner's craft lets them spit a corrosive, molten-like fluid as a projectile or draw the same searing substance up from the ground to burst in a great blast. The fluid can dissolve and melt solid things it touches.

rites.name: Telanes
rites.text: A practitioner draws several serpents out from a hidden sleeve to strike an unsuspecting foe. The serpents bite or coil around their target, and can also anchor to nearby surfaces to haul the user swiftly toward a chosen spot.

rites.name: Serostum
rites.text: A practitioner conjures false violet blossoms rising from the earth before them. Anyone touched by the phantom petals suffers harm and may be left unable to move.

rites.name: Valaror
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a drifting cloud of countless tiny spikes from the mouth, sending them flying as a sharp, moving spray.

rites.name: Lentium
rites.text: A bearer breathes out flames while whirling air spins them into an outward-coiling storm. The burning vortex smothers foes, cutting off their breath as it scorches them, and it can also be tightened into a plain fiery burst.

rites.name: Mistaulor
rites.text: A practitioner extends one or both arms and releases a strong crackling discharge from the palms that strikes several foes at once. Its force can be amplified when paired with flowing water.

rites.name: Orastium
rites.text: A stand-in figure shaped from soft earth that absorbs incoming blows and swallows an intruder into its body. When laced with volatile grit, it bursts apart and drags its captive down with it.

rites.name: Costantium
rites.text: A learned craft in which a practitioner points a finger at a target and traces a sigil in the air to bind it. The sigil produces a range of different effects depending on the form traced.

rites.name: Tasteornus
rites.text: A practitioner standing in still water releases a sudden surge of charged force that jolts every other creature sharing that water. The technique turns a whole pool into a single trap.

rites.name: Montiarnor
rites.text: A fighter folds their body into a sudden jump and emerges full-sized before a rival, driving a warped limb into the earth so spikes erupt from the ground.

rites.name: Ceollanum
rites.text: A wearer shares a second set of limbs that bloom from their own leg mid-strike. The extra kicks can land together to hurl an opponent away, or in quick succession to wear them down.

rites.name: Lirnonum
rites.text: A practiced art of throwing one's voice so that it seems to come from any direction. Practitioners use it to mislead opponents about where they actually stand while speaking to them.

rites.name: Cauntum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes several broad flat stone slabs and hurls them against an opponent. The craft turns the ground itself into a weapon.

rites.name: Saunesium
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a curved blade that cuts the foe as it spins, then pulls the victim close and ends the exchange with a heavy kick.

rites.name: Melia
rites.text: A fighter strikes a foe several times until they slam into a huge stone, then leaps atop it and delivers a single blow that hurls the enemy far off and shatters the rock into fragments.

rites.name: Miallia
rites.text: A practitioner strikes one precise inner energy node with two fingers, aiming to block the flow of power that the target is channeling and stop it from moving.

rites.name: Ristania
rites.text: A joint technique where one practitioner shapes a spear of packed earth and drives it into the ground, and a partner then charges it with crackling energy. The combined strike inflicts heavy harm on whoever stands against it.

rites.name: Amentianum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes an opponent in rapid succession with three gusting wind techniques. The combined assault is delivered as one flowing sequence.

rites.name: Corianarum
rites.text: A practitioner draws sticky silken strands from their palms to bind and snare foes at a distance. The threads extend their reach, mostly used to restrain or trap a target.

rites.name: Vianteostus
rites.text: A fighter whirls a horned sea-shell club in a frenzied spinning assault, then ends the flurry with an upward swing that hurls the foe aside.

rites.name: Teliantes
rites.text: A silent technique where a practitioner slips up out of the ground and swims through soil like a fish through water. Users often pair it with decoy duplicates to strike unseen.

rites.name: Lirnentor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a loose cloud of grit into a small mass hovering overhead, then drops it onto a foe. The technique buries the target beneath a sudden crushing weight.

rites.name: Telanistus
rites.text: A user and two copies of themselves strike a target at once from separate sides, leaping in a curved arc. The attack is so forceful that a single successful blow can prove fatal.

rites.name: Liastolum
rites.text: A practitioner sweeps a broad ceremonial fan through the air to summon forceful gusts. A single motion can scatter several foes at once.

rites.name: Sesanum Amiaseostum
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter first unleashes a searing blast of flame, then hurls a volley of small blades, and ends the exchange with a decisive strike from a blade.

rites.name: Miarium
rites.text: A rare blended power of water and wind that lets its users shape frozen forms, cool the air around them, and fight with chilled hands. Those who wield it have often been hunted and forced to hide their gift.

rites.name: Oriarus
rites.text: A bound foe is trapped inside a false grove of grown illusion, then struck through by many thrown blades. The snare ends in a flurry of piercing.

rites.name: Valeoliania
rites.text: A practitioner shapes the soil beneath their feet into hidden passages. The passages let the user move unseen beneath enemy defenses.

rites.name: Serillia
rites.text: A tactic in which a wielder heaps up to four heavy blocks onto a foe, aiming to crush them before they notice the danger.

rites.name: Telentes
rites.text: A wielder sends a swirling cloud of paper charms spinning toward a foe, and each charm bursts into flame the moment it touches something.

rites.name: Serollanum
rites.text: A fighter binds chains around their arms and sends crackling energy through them into hooked blades at the ends. The charged blades strike with sudden force.

rites.name: Vialium
rites.text: A fighter plants a blade into the earth so a bolt from the sky strikes it, stunning the foe. She then pulls the weapon free and ends the duel.

rites.name: Amaurnanus
rites.text: A wielder swings a blade in one broad, curved sweep so swiftly that it can answer threats appearing with little warning. The same motion can turn aside several attackers at once.

rites.name: Sisanum
rites.text: A binding craft in which a practitioner coats a person in a fine metallic dust, granting command over their every bodily motion. The bound one cannot be made to channel inner energy, only to move with the strength and skill they already possess.

rites.name: Ronum
rites.text: A user draws molten plumes up from a glowing underworld realm around her body. The rising heat can strike nearby foes or serve as a barrier against incoming attacks.

rites.name: Taunus
rites.text: A dark orb is conjured and hurled forward, drawing loose material into its path. Anything caught in its trajectory is struck by the gathered debris.

rites.name: Raurontanum
rites.text: A practitioner holds a sharpened tool level and fills it with inner force. The blade then stretches longer under that flow.

rites.name: Teleorilium
rites.text: A practitioner coats their clenched hands with heat so that each blow engulfs the struck foe in burning gusts. In some tellings the fire can be hurled ahead along the line of the strike, hot enough to melt small iron blades.

rites.name: Vistor
rites.text: A small orb of water gathered by a practitioner and flung forward with a sharp kick at an opposing foe.

rites.name: Teorones
rites.text: A bonded hunter and their tamed beast spin together in a whirling blade of motion. On contact with a foe they unleash a flurry of savage, animal-like strikes.

rites.name: Amisolor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a great many small crawling creatures that knit together into a cord strong enough to bear a person's full weight.

rites.name: Serentirnus
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, coats a clenched hand in molten rock, and drives a blow that hurls the opponent crashing to the ground.

rites.name: Ceoseria
rites.text: A practitioner leaves behind a double of themselves that hardens into a frost-bright mirror holding their likeness. Anyone who touches the mirror becomes encased in cold.

rites.name: Caulus
rites.text: A caster weaves a false scene inside another false scene. Anyone who breaks the outer deception still remains trapped, unaware that a second layer of illusion holds them.

rites.name: Caulerus
rites.text: A bonded beast is called forth and merged with its caller, granting a brief surge of shadow limbs for a crushing strike. The fusion fades quickly, allowing only two such blows.

rites.name: Ameostes
rites.text: A sealing craft that traps a person inside a separate hidden space bound to the place where the ward was set. Escape is possible only through a specific blood-bound counter-mark.

rites.name: Noreoses
rites.text: A bearer turns part of their own body into liquid and shapes it into a sphere around an opponent's head. The enclosed foe cannot draw breath, leading to either unconsciousness or death if the hold lasts.

rites.name: Cosium
rites.text: A practitioner's signature technique forms the base of nearly all their methods. It shapes how they stand and strike, or it is tied to a favored tool or companion.

rites.name: Tallum
rites.text: A bound-serpent technique in which a fighter lashes a foe with a living coil drawn from the belly and drags them close. A paired blade of sorcerous force then cuts across the trapped body.

rites.name: Nestanum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a vast billowing cloud of scalding vapor that surrounds them, searing anything or anyone standing close by.

rites.name: Corales
rites.text: A bearer lifts into the air and unleashes a forceful flood of gusting wind mixed with flame from a distance. The blast is a technique that combines two elemental currents into one.

rites.name: Narnestes
rites.text: Several bearers stack upon one another into a single column, then extend their wrist-blades and spin rapidly. The whirling motion forms a dark vortex strong enough to slice through rock.

rites.name: Coreonum
rites.text: Practitioners inscribe binding glyphs across a chosen zone, then call forth a ghostly clawed limb that closes around whatever is trapped inside. The working draws heavily on inner reserves, so the caster grows weary quickly and the captive may slip free.

rites.name: Noria
rites.text: A creature exhales a drifting fog that traps intruders in a false vision of their own history. The vision dissolves once the captive breaks free alone or with a companion's help.

rites.name: Tiastium
rites.text: A fighter swings a massive golden bar to strike an opponent, hurling them high into the air with a single forceful blow.

rites.name: Amelum
rites.text: A spinning technique in which two fighters strike one foe together with a sweeping high kick. It is a twisting variant of a more common wind-based maneuver.

rites.name: Ciarnelanum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior strikes with an elbow, follows with two kicks and a blade cut, then ends with a low sweeping kick that scatters a ring of pale petals around the user.

rites.name: Marnisum
rites.text: A paired technique in which one practitioner clouds an opponent's mind so they grow confused, and a second practitioner then strikes with a swift airborne blow that leaves the target unconscious.

rites.name: Teliantasus
rites.text: A practitioner wreathes their body in a ring of fire that shields them while scorching any foe who draws too near. The ring holds the caster safe within its heat.

rites.name: Ameornum
rites.text: A practitioner leaps backward through the air and then hurls a volley of sharp frozen spikes at a foe. The technique is a fast, acrobatic way to strike from above with cold shards.

rites.name: Naurnes
rites.text: A fighter's inner self emerges and charges forward with raised fists, striking a foe repeatedly with pushes and blows. The attack ends with a finishing kick.

rites.name: Sesia
rites.text: Two fighters launch a foe skyward, then one seizes the arms and waist while the other grips the legs. They lock arms back to back and slam the captive face-down onto the ground.

rites.name: Noleria
rites.text: A fighter spins rapidly through simple strikes, then finishes with a forceful rotating high kick aimed at the opponent.

rites.name: Valialestus
rites.text: A mind-binding craft in which the caster ensnares a foe with an illusion of a vast eye that pours down searing shafts of light, striking the victim with force.

rites.name: Sastanum
rites.text: A practitioner merges with a nearby object and shapes the stones forming their new form, hurling them at a foe. Each stone mends itself at once after being struck.

rites.name: Amillianium
rites.text: A fighting technique where a warrior strikes an opponent twice, lifts them skyward with a palm blow, then drives them back down with a punch. The attack ends with bound weapons thrown from above and a heavy stomp.

rites.name: Naurnia
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a sphere of fire at a rival, wrapping a dark flame around the ordinary burning core so the strike does far greater harm.

rites.name: Aminium
rites.text: Four practitioners stand in a square and raise a wall of violet fire that burns anything touching it, sealing an area shut. Breaking any one of the four casters collapses the wall, though guards may shield themselves within it.

rites.name: Raurnium
rites.text: A practitioner temporarily lengthens the nails of their hands and feet to a striking length within moments. The enlarged nails also grow tough enough to strike blades without splintering.

rites.name: Telaunes
rites.text: A practitioner releases a sudden burst of cold that locks a foe completely within solid ice. The victim is entirely frozen in place by the technique.

rites.name: Reosus
rites.text: A combat art where a fighter strikes with elbows, blades, and knees to launch foes skyward, then finishes them with a falling spear-thrust of gathered energy.

rites.name: Reonia
rites.text: Practitioners make duplicates of themselves or their tools, which can distract foes, fight alongside the maker, or act on their own. Some copies are weaker than the original.

rites.name: Cenistum
rites.text: A practitioner draws their inner energy into frozen ground, lifting a sheet of ice that can seal a rival inside and shape its movements. The ice holds firm against flame, and the caster may wrap themselves in it as a guard.

rites.name: Saullentia
rites.text: A practitioner draws inner energy from the belly and releases it as a small sphere of flame. The gestures required to shape it have differed between uses.

rites.name: Vaurentia
rites.text: A fighter strikes a foe into the air, leaps high, and spins a huge rotating orb of inner energy that crushes the target into the earth. The fighter then lands in the middle of the resulting crater.

rites.name: Valarnesus
rites.text: A user gathers several rotting bodies inside a sealed ward where decay releases a gas that ignites into a blast. The blast frees a vast cloud of venomous swarm-bugs that spreads across the land, and the ward speeds their breeding.

rites.name: Valaurum
rites.text: Two or more bound spirit-beasts and their hosts merge their force into one enormous orb of energy. Each added participant makes the orb grow larger.

rites.name: Riantus Reorestum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes an inner force into heat, then releases a swarm of blazing orbs that fall upon a foe and scorch the surrounding ground. The orbs can shatter stone barriers and overwhelm streams of water.

rites.name: Valaurus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a massive heap of soil using inner energy and raw strength, casting a looming shadow over foes. Hurled, the heavy clump wrecks whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Neolleria
rites.text: A bearer channels an overcharged inner state to drive a blow with overwhelming force. The strike hurls the target a great distance away.

rites.name: Toranum
rites.text: A swift technique in which a practitioner darts in jagged bursts through the space around foes, striking them as they pass. It is paired with a crackling blade-strike.

rites.name: Teosor
rites.text: A forbidden craft lets a practitioner devour a living mind and wear its owner's face, memories, and skills. The copy becomes a flawless double, ideal for slipping unseen into enemy ranks.

rites.name: Varnesanum
rites.text: A practiced fighting form strings together rapid strikes and cuts, then ends in a whirling leg blow that hurls the foe backward through the air.

rites.name: Teoranum
rites.text: A supplementary battle manoeuvre in which a band of trained hounds stands in a ring, leaving one hound at the center to draw the enemy's strikes while the others perform further tricks.

rites.name: Valonia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers blue flame into whirling orbs and hurls them at a chosen target. The technique relies on focused intent to shape the fire.

rites.name: Ronus Tiles
rites.text: A practitioner forms spheres of crackling storm energy and hurls them at a foe. On contact the orbs shock the target and fling them backward, and the same craft can loose several in quick succession or all at once.

rites.name: Villes
rites.text: A great wooden idol is raised by a sage and sustained by six linked wielders who pour their inner force into it. Its six blows drive a foe skyward, and a burning sigil flares in the air.

rites.name: Corarnesus
rites.text: A wielder hurls a long wooden rod and calls forth many solid copies of it mid-flight. The duplicates strike with real force, so attackers struggle to deflect the volley.

rites.name: Corauntus
rites.text: A dark binding craft that traps a foe inside a false vision, where a double of the caster strikes them again and again. The illusion leaves the victim cut many times over.

rites.name: Sereonanum
rites.text: A fighter grows long hardened spines from the body that pierce foes. The movements sway like bending boughs, favoring dodges, parries and counterstrikes, and extra spines can sprout from the joints to strike several enemies at once.

rites.name: Coraustores
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a flurry of two slashing blows, then raises a field of sharp spikes that hurls the foe skyward. While the victim hangs in the air, twin spears surge up from below and pierce them.

rites.name: Nenaullor
rites.text: A mind-snare that locks a foe's body in place so they cannot move. It can hold several enemies at once, leaving them open to a lethal strike from the caster or an ally.

rites.name: Sauneles
rites.text: A disciplined striking craft in which the practitioner touches every vital channel of a foe, each blow stilling the body until a final touch brings death.

rites.name: Telausor
rites.text: A practitioner conjures slender spikes drawn from their own lifeblood, one from each hand. Once formed, they hurl a dense volley of these spikes with enough force to tear furrows through the earth.

rites.name: Mialaustium
rites.text: A user draws many small blades from a sealed scroll and links them with fine cords to the fingertips. They are hurled in a rushing line, then lifted and spun overhead before being driven down onto the foe.

rites.name: Amiallor
rites.text: A practitioner places hidden mental barriers within a target's mind, guarding precious knowledge so it cannot be pulled out if the bearer is seized and questioned. Such locks are said to resist truth-compelling draughts.

rites.name: Mollauror
rites.text: A practitioner blows corrosive bubbles from a hollow reed that eat through whatever they touch. Their vast number and wide spread make them very hard to dodge.

rites.name: Sasor
rites.text: A wielder coats their body in molten rock and strikes the foe with a blazing fist. Even a missed blow scorches anyone standing near enough to feel the glowing heat.

rites.name: Telineosum
rites.text: A fighter pounds a foe with a closed fist while hopping on one leg, then reappears behind them to strike with an open palm, drops them to the ground, and ends by stamping with a heel.

rites.name: Miarus
rites.text: A bound craft in which one wooden guardian strikes beneath the earth, then a second figure snatches the foe from the air and seals them inside a dark cage. The construct then detonates, shedding its parts so it can endure harm.

rites.name: Coraustor
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a great blaze upon a foe, and once the flames scorch them, the attacker slips behind and drives a small blade into the victim.

rites.name: Oriastes
rites.text: A rider leaps from a beast's back to strike an opponent with a blade, then the mount rams and rakes the foe with its claws. The rider finishes with a thrown weapon from above.

rites.name: Coreontium
rites.text: A practitioner coats their body in enchanted dark ink that spins into a thick concealing fog. When paired with a rapid-step craft, they slip away from a clash unseen.

rites.name: Riania
rites.text: A practitioner wraps themselves in living flame, so that anyone who draws near in close combat is burned. The blaze can also be shaped and hurled outward to strike foes from a distance.

rites.name: Nastor
rites.text: A fighter charges at a foe, vaults over them using them as a brace, and sprouts sharp bone spikes from the back to strike the target all at once.

rites.name: Amistaullum
rites.text: A bearer surrounds a foe with a corrosive haze that pins them in place, then releases a molten sphere by a blown kiss that detonates violently on contact.

rites.name: Valestontum
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a guardian shell is drawn out of keeping and made to spew burning flame onto a foe while its plated carapace shields the user. It is a forbidden craft of the temple orders.

rites.name: Seriastium
rites.text: A practitioner vanishes and reappears as a tall column of stinging chitin-beetles that lunges at a foe. One extra column rises for each additional enemy targeted.

rites.name: Vorninus
rites.text: Four practitioners stand at the corners of a square and raise a great barrier between them. At a signal, the barrier burns away whatever lies inside it.

rites.name: Serirnia
rites.text: A practitioner bows, stamps the ground, and summons drifting rose-colored leaves that thicken into a pink mist. Confused by the haze, a foe is struck and then ambushed in mid-air by the practitioner reappearing from nowhere.

rites.name: Taullus
rites.text: A warrior charges forward with an empowered blade, launches the foe skyward, then spins to slash them apart before a final sideways strike drives them into the earth.

rites.name: Veoles
rites.text: A fighter wraps a curved blade in living fire and spins in a circle, cutting down everyone within reach before crashing down from above.

rites.name: Lalor
rites.text: A fighter drives a fist into the foe's stomach, dropping them to the ground. Standing over them, the attacker finishes with one heavy blow from a broad blade.

rites.name: Riaralus
rites.text: A bonded ancient beast is called forth by a sage to rake a foe with steel claws, flinging them skyward. The beast then fuses into a heavy rod that the sage swings down to crush the falling target.

rites.name: Siarnor
rites.text: A fighter rises into the air on a cushion of drifting sand, striking downward with glittering powder. Then the powder condenses into small pellets that are hurled at the foe in quick succession.

rites.name: Corostanum
rites.text: A practitioner delivers a rapid flurry of soft palm strikes against a foe. The technique is a disciplined craft of quick, gentle blows.

rites.name: Sonus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a substance nearby and shapes it into a long, horned serpent-like construct. The construct can carry its maker across distances or strike at an enemy, and several can be guided together.

rites.name: Rauntia Costiles
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner send several earth-skimming stones toward a chosen mark, where they burst apart. Its force can fracture even hard bedrock and bring down a hillside.

rites.name: Valaranum
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a user conjures rings of glowing molten stone that burst upward toward a foe, hurling them skyward.

rites.name: Sillor
rites.text: Two bearers cast a shared sheet of black fire at a foe, then conjure guardian spirits that loose volleys of projectiles. The blaze erupts, is folded into a second wrapping of flame, and detonates once more.

rites.name: Oreollastes
rites.text: A practitioner raises a single hand in a sign, and the earth beneath an opponent turns to frost, locking their feet in place so they cannot move for a while.

rites.name: Reorus
rites.text: A fighter seizes a foe with a coiled, sinewy tether and hauls themselves close, then unhinges the jaw to bite down. The technique is a close-quarters grapple that ends in a savage bite.

rites.name: Sollum
rites.text: A caster lifts broad stone blocks into the air, where they circle the user like orbiting guards. The blocks can be hurled at a foe, and their size can be changed at will.

rites.name: Nenus
rites.text: A fighter opens a hidden inner gate to kick so quickly that the leg ignites. Spinning skyward, the blazing limb drives downward and releases a burst of fire that hurls nearby foes away.

rites.name: Corenum
rites.text: A practitioner can sink or lift the surrounding ground to any chosen size and depth. The shifted earth lets them dodge strikes or throw foes off balance, while plants and people keep their places.

rites.name: Sirnium
rites.text: A wielder holds a hooded canopy that releases a spray of slender needles from its underside. While floating aloft, they spin the canopy to scatter the needles downward onto foes below.

rites.name: Telirnum
rites.text: A fighter draws a heavy wooden staff from a sealed cloth roll and strikes an enemy with a sweeping blow, two jabs to the belly, and a closing side swing.

rites.name: Veornor
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a vast surge of molten stone from the ground ahead, shaping it into a flexible barrier that bends under impact and scatters the force of a blow. It can also be layered over an existing wall to strengthen it.

rites.name: Amirnanum Coreolium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a large, sharp blue spear of crystal that wraps around the forearm. The spear is thrust forward to pierce an opponent.

rites.name: Reonium
rites.text: A flowing blue energy wraps the wielder, allowing constant self-repair during combat alongside boosts to strength and speed. It slowly drains the wielder's inner reserves until it fades, though some practitioners can end it at will while others cannot.

rites.name: Nanollus
rites.text: A piper enters a cursed transformation and plays a haunting tune that ensnares a foe's mind. While the victim stands helpless, her hidden servants rise up from beneath and strike.

rites.name: Laseornium
rites.text: A joint combat art in which one fighter hurls a volley of blades that a companion has set alight with a burst of flame. The fiery throwing blades are launched in quick succession.

rites.name: Rarnium
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a sharp elbow and two quick kicks, then exhales a cloud of pale petals that burst against the foe and overwhelm them.

rites.name: Vinasium
rites.text: A wielder breathes out a huge ball of flame that snatches a foe away and bursts apart on contact. The blast splits the ground nearby while the caster stands untouched, a fiercer kin of a lesser flame technique.

rites.name: Reseontia
rites.text: A wielder swings a fan-like blade to call forth a rushing flood of water that pursues a chosen foe. It is a technique practiced in the temples of the river orders.

rites.name: Telausanum
rites.text: A practitioner conjures intense fire within a towering clay kiln that is first raised by a crackling sky-binding art. Wet earth wrapped around a foe is baked hard, locking them in place.

rites.name: Maror
rites.text: A partnered technique where a giant amphibian spits a slick oil cloud that its bonded caster ignites into a wide, forceful blaze. In another telling, a charged paper seal sets the oil alight instead.

rites.name: Valintosium
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, spins, and strikes an opponent with a kick, a punch, and a burst of scalding vapor, dropping them hard to the ground.

rites.name: Cantostium
rites.text: A practitioner touches a foe, lifts one arm skyward to call down a crackling bolt, and the charge races through their own frame into the enemy's body.

rites.name: Nantia Tiles
rites.text: A flame-spiraling storm is charged with crackling lightning and hurled at foes. A skilled wielder shapes the blaze and sends it hurtling toward the enemy ranks.

rites.name: Valilares
rites.text: A binding craft in which the practitioner lifts the ground beneath an enemy and presses it inward until the foe is held fast. The caster may loosen the grip again at will.

rites.name: Carnaunia
rites.text: A wielder drops from above with a descending strike powerful enough to shatter the ground beneath them. The force of the blow brings the surrounding terrain crumbling down.

rites.name: Serantillus
rites.text: A elder mystic channels gathered storm-energy, charged with a sage's inner discipline, into one palm and drives it forward to pierce an adversary.

rites.name: Cianus
rites.text: A practitioner seals a glowing binding with the hands, lays them upon a fallen one, and kindles their own body's light so that their breath passes into the target. The one who gives everything is consumed, while the other is made whole again.

rites.name: Viares
rites.text: A practitioner spits small pebbles from the mouth at great speed, and each one swells into a massive boulder after leaving. Gathered efforts of several users could level a mountain.

rites.name: Teleostolor
rites.text: A grappling technique in which the wielder seizes an opponent, swings behind them, and hurls them away with a double-footed kick.

rites.name: Orauntanum
rites.text: A wielder plunges an arm into a swirling storm of grit, which reshapes the limb into a beast-like claw that lashes out at a foe.

rites.name: Tiror
rites.text: A practitioner swings a ribbon of folded air that unleashes a fierce gale strong enough to shatter a crackling storm-visage worn by a rival.

rites.name: Orianium
rites.text: A practitioner wraps the hand in a sheet of hard ice to deflect incoming strikes from close combat. A skilled user can halt a fast, spinning barrage with this guard.

rites.name: Orilum
rites.text: A practitioner rushes a long way across open ground and then delivers a forceful kick that hurls the foe backward through the air.

rites.name: Orerus
rites.text: A practiced wearer takes on the near-perfect likeness of another, matching their look, scent, and inner manner so closely that companions cannot tell them apart. The copy cannot wield the other's special powers, leaving the wearer fragile, and the shape fades after a few days.

rites.name: Coreontes
rites.text: A fighter leaps and then spins rapidly, hurling a volley of blades at the foe during the same motion.

rites.name: Telonistium
rites.text: A bearer strikes an opponent down with an open-palm blow, and golden energy rises beneath the foe. The technique is channeled through a towering spirit form.

rites.name: Selanum
rites.text: A fighter unlocks several inner gates of the body, launches an opponent skyward with a swift kick, then follows with a blazing strike that sets the foe alight.

rites.name: Miasia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy, shapes it into heat, and exhales a huge torrent of flame that can blanket a wide area. Dense woodland makes the blaze far deadlier for anything caught within it.

rites.name: Orastiles
rites.text: A silent maneuver where a fighter drags an opponent into position, then slips behind them and strikes with a short blade.

rites.name: Valianes
rites.text: A wielder raises a swirling storm of fine grit around their body. The storm lashes several foes at once and shields the wielder from incoming harm.

rites.name: Corostinus
rites.text: A fighter sways a blade in a slow arc, which traps a foe in a dreamlike illusion of many swinging limbs. The distracted opponent is then struck down by the user.

rites.name: Seoria
rites.text: A practitioner scatters folded paper blossoms around foes, and they burst into drifting petals that whirl into a huge tempest, swallowing everyone caught within it.

rites.name: Coriarum
rites.text: A hidden practitioner tunnels beneath an opponent and seeds the ground with concealed explosive traps. The method relies on stealth and patience to catch a foe unaware.

rites.name: Misum
rites.text: A layered fighting technique that opens with a strike, then cuts with disruptive blades, then leaps into a flaming volley that ends the combat in a final blow.

rites.name: Oraullanum
rites.text: Two practitioners combine their gifts so that one wreathes a foe in fire while the other drives the blaze outward. The flames spread wider and burn hotter than either could manage alone.

rites.name: Leseornum
rites.text: A practitioner plants shrunken dark rods beneath a foe, then restores them to full size so they pierce upward and pin the target in place.

rites.name: Seraurolium
rites.text: A bearer draws out a coiled parchment and turns it around their body. Many barbed metal orbs spill from it, striking nearby foes and keeping close attackers at bay.

rites.name: Telontilor
rites.text: A practitioner channels inner energy into a single fingertip, using the resulting warmth to burn lettering onto a surface. It demands fine control, and when cut into living flesh it leaves a lasting mark.

rites.name: Sollum Oriraullum
rites.text: A practitioner splits into four duplicate forms that strike together against a rival. The attack combines a flurry of open-handed blows with swift kicks.

rites.name: Amonintor
rites.text: A paired technique where a fighter and their beast companion strike a foe together, launching them into the air and cutting across them in crossing blows that wound them while they fall.

rites.name: Castores
rites.text: Two casters work together: one calls up a crowd of serpents that encircle a foe, and the other sends a winged creature to rain bursting plumes onto the coil, detonating it and everything caught inside.

rites.name: Nianum
rites.text: A fighter swaps places with a decoy to appear struck, then exploits the foe's brief hesitation by rushing in with a sideways blade strike.

rites.name: Meornastium
rites.text: A earthen master conjures a stone that lifts a foe into the air, then rises after them to strike and hurl them back down to the ground.

rites.name: Lialum
rites.text: A bloodline affliction in which a clan's deep affection turns into bitter rage when a loved one is lost. The rage awakens a special sight that grows stronger through pain, but it can slowly consume the one who bears it.

rites.name: Amellia
rites.text: A fighter hurls a storm of grit at a foe, then shapes three rising sheets of the same grit that close around and finish the duel.

rites.name: Naulantia
rites.text: A wide-reaching mental craft that works like a smaller parent technique but reaches many people at once. The caster seizes full command of every affected body, sometimes turning companions against one another.

rites.name: Sauntum
rites.text: A craft that turns blossoms into small bombs which can be set off like marked explosives. The petals are rigged so a single signal ignites them.

rites.name: Reornasanum
rites.text: A fighter opens hidden inner gates and delivers a crushing downward kick aimed at an opponent's smallest digit. The blow is strong enough to topple a towering idol.

rites.name: Telisteonor
rites.text: A bearer first wreathes a blade in fire, then slashes toward a foe so the blaze flies outward in great burning arcs. A master can ring themselves in a wall of flame that scorches many attackers at once, from any side.

rites.name: Valiastium
rites.text: A fighting art that turns stored bodily fuel into inner force. The user strikes with knees and elbows, spins into a kick, flings the foe skyward with rapid blows, then drops down with a heavy descending strike.

rites.name: Causia
rites.text: A practitioner leaps high and hurls a ring of marked blades inscribed with mending glyphs. Every companion inside the circle they make is restored by the healing field.

rites.name: Vantor
rites.text: A fighter takes on a fiery beast's form, leaps high into the air, and breathes a blast of flame down upon foes before crashing onto them.

rites.name: Nintes
rites.text: A bearer dissolves into a cloud of dark grit that drifts freely through the air and cannot be harmed. While in this state, the bearer still commands the grit.

rites.name: Vaustaror
rites.text: A frozen barrier is conjured by a single caster, able to force an enemy backward or shield the caster from blows for a brief span.

rites.name: Niranum Saulles
rites.text: A practitioner conjures ten flaming orbs arranged in a ring before them. With sweeping hand gestures, they hurl each orb outward toward a target.

rites.name: Orenostanum
rites.text: A leaping kick aimed at a foe's head, often preceded by a thrown blade to misdirect them. Its force depends on the attacker's bold posture, and any hesitation mid-leap sharply reduces the impact.

rites.name: Coriasium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a great store of inner energy and calls forth a hidden inner self, then delivers a crushing blow that wounds the foe.

rites.name: Ciallarus
rites.text: A bearer splits into two duplicates, who link their legs and are steered into a looping snare. The snare strikes a foe from several angles in quick succession.

rites.name: Tolor
rites.text: A fighter first strikes a foe in the face and sends them staggering back. Then a mass of serpents coils around the victim, forming an enclosing dome that restrains them before a final blade thrust ends the struggle.

rites.name: Sontum Sornellor
rites.text: A fighter drives an opponent down with an elbow and sword-like strikes from a towering guardian arm, then leaps skyward and finishes the foe with a blast of scorching flame.

rites.name: Nausillanum
rites.text: A practitioner channels energy through several flowing extensions to swat aside incoming blows or strike back. The technique ends with a reinforced fist that hits with extra force.

rites.name: Mantanum Cesanum
rites.text: A bound foe is caged inside a sphere of volatile charms, which are then set alight so the sphere erupts. The binding and the blast are performed together as one technique.

rites.name: Valeontor
rites.text: A practitioner moves in a rapid spiraling motion that sweeps away approaching attackers. The force is strong enough to scatter sparks across the ground nearby.

rites.name: Corialor
rites.text: A caster drowns a foe in a dark void where twisted phantoms seize them and a spectral serpent looms. Terrified, the victim is then strangled by the caster appearing overhead.

rites.name: Masia
rites.text: A fighter drives a staff into soil so that loose stones gather and form a heavy weapon, such as a hammer or spear. Striking the ground with it sends a far-reaching tremor forward.

rites.name: Nilum
rites.text: A practitioner channels inner vital energy into a glowing edge, then strikes an adversary with many rushing waves of force that cut from the blade.

rites.name: Vialium Corollium
rites.text: A fighter drives a strike into a rival's midsection, then swings a towering staff whose spirit-beast head lunges forward to bite the foe with its fangs.

rites.name: Losilia
rites.text: A user radiates pure deadly will that spreads outward, freezing opponents and bystanders in fear. At its peak it can force victims to see visions of their own grisly end, though it is no spell.

rites.name: Rostialia
rites.text: A fighter spreads two bound rolls beneath a rival and releases a volley of mixed arms that hurls the foe skyward. A chain then binds the rival's legs and drags them down to strike the ground hard.

rites.name: Tostilum
rites.text: A disciplined training rite where a student climbs a towering sheer rock face using only one or two limbs. It builds raw endurance and steady self-control.

rites.name: Montaullum
rites.text: A fighter leaps high while in a fierce empowered state, kicking foes from several angles before driving a final heel blow that slams them into the earth.

rites.name: Mollor
rites.text: A practice in which a practitioner shapes their life force into a slender angling line and casts many barbed hooks at a rival, drawing away the rival's inner energy.

rites.name: Sirnolum
rites.text: A practitioner raises a rolling swell of ground and rides its crest, sending offshoots forward to strike at range. The same motion reshapes the surrounding land, bending the footing of both the wielder and the rival.

rites.name: Telilus
rites.text: A duelist strikes a foe with crackling lightning, then swaps places with an ally who delivers a crushing blow. The duelist swaps back and drives the stored lightning into the earth.

rites.name: Valestor
rites.text: A practitioner slashes an opponent many times in quick succession with a sacred sword. It is a technique of ritual combat drawn from an ancient blade.

rites.name: Ciastonia
rites.text: A battle rite that strengthens every combatant's speed, strike, and guard at once. It is channeled through one wielder who gathers arms into the air above the field.

rites.name: Orisestum
rites.text: A practitioner charges ink with inner energy to shape living copies of themselves. When a copy is broken, it dissolves back into ordinary black ink.

rites.name: Laulor
rites.text: A fighter slips beneath a foe and hurls them skyward, then rises above them and drives them down into the earth with a crackling strike.

rites.name: Mintasum
rites.text: A practitioner drops a small igniting tool onto the ground before a rival and spreads the tiny spark into a towering curtain of flame. It is known for turning a minor flicker into a great blazing pillar.

rites.name: Sasia
rites.text: A practitioner lays a palm against a surface and draws forth a long line of sharp blue shards. The shards bind a target and pierce it.

rites.name: Liror
rites.text: A practitioner can sink or heave the ground across a wide region around them, carving vast pits or raising mighty mounds. Once, a pit so immense swallowed a titanic beast whole.

rites.name: Cornausor
rites.text: A disguise method in which three young apprentices become alluring figures and bounce to dazzle foes until they collapse.

rites.name: Seornium
rites.text: Two fighters cross their arms together and charge at an opponent, striking with a rope of crackling storm energy.

rites.name: Milus
rites.text: A practitioner coats one foot in molten stone and swings it upward into an opponent. It is a fighting technique drawn from the craft of heat and fire.

rites.name: Valintaulus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior cuts an opponent apart with a blade, then sweeps the remains away with a spinning kick.

rites.name: Telarontes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a glowing crimson force into a clenched hand and drives it into the earth. The force then rolls outward in many pulsing rings that spread in every direction around the caster.

rites.name: Reosarnium
rites.text: A wielder waves a fan-shaped weapon, conjuring a ring of six spinning fire whirls that orbit around them in a protective circle.

rites.name: Nonteostium
rites.text: A bearer curls into a tight sphere and rebounds across the ground. The bounce can drop heavily onto a rival or carry the user swiftly across a field.

rites.name: Serestanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers focus for a moment, then unleashes a whirling kick that sweeps along the ground and leaps into a spin, striking several foes at once.

rites.name: Valolum
rites.text: A bone-blade technique in which a fighter sweeps a blade of bone to hurl a foe backward, then strikes again to lift the opponent into the air.

rites.name: Coriastirus
rites.text: A fighter drives a fist into an opponent's gut, then, while the foe reels, brings a blade crashing down in a sharp chopping arc. The strike combines a blow to the body with a decisive finishing cut.

rites.name: Seriasium
rites.text: A grinding technique that smothers a foe in fine powdered stone, crushing them within a dusty tomb. It can only be called upon after a preparatory transformation has been completed.

rites.name: Tiantium
rites.text: A gathering of many practitioners raises a dark cloud that pours down heavy rain. The downpour swells into a surging flood that knocks foes off their feet, and anyone caught within it slowly loses their inner energy.

rites.name: Telauneorum
rites.text: A fighter drops back out of sight and then reappears in a sudden rush, scattering five volatile charges at an enemy's feet. The charges detonate in a violent blast.

rites.name: Valinor
rites.text: A practitioner within a dimension of ice draws frost out of the air to form a rime that clasps foes in place. The bitter cold saps their strength and injures them.

rites.name: Melor Nantium
rites.text: Two practitioners, one drawing on moving air and one on the ground beneath them, join their craft to raise a spiraling column of grit. The whirl carries across the open land.

rites.name: Teliantenor
rites.text: A bound horde of enormous silk-spinning beasts is called down from above onto a foe, who is pinned and crushed beneath their weight.

rites.name: Sianausanum
rites.text: A fighter summons several duplicate selves to strike a rival with a chain of kicks and blows. A final rising strike is intercepted midair by the true fighter, who extends the punch with gathered life-energy and hurls the foe away.

rites.name: Oronesium
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the ground with both palms, raising a great mass of soil that is shaped and hurled at a foe as a swift, crushing wave.

rites.name: Teoronanum
rites.text: A combat technique where a fighter and two duplicates strike a foe back and forth, launch them skyward, then slam them down and hurl them aside.

rites.name: Teleorium
rites.text: A seer's inner sense reaches across great distances to feel an rival's ranged strikes before they land. The warning lets her dodge arrows and bolts that would otherwise find her.

rites.name: Neontestia
rites.text: A practitioner leaps skyward and commands a bound effigy to hurl a vast cloud of dark metal grains down upon a foe. The sheer weight of the swarm crushes whoever stands beneath it.

rites.name: Vistanum
rites.text: A practiced craft where a drifting haze figure, once struck hard enough, scatters into vapor and then gathers again as several haze figures. The copies carry on the same way.

rites.name: Valolanum
rites.text: A practitioner unrolls a great hide scroll above a rival and calls forth a storm of thrown blades. Four heavy iron cords then fall and pin the foe to the ground.

rites.name: Liasor
rites.text: A practitioner coats their skin in a thin, see-through layer of rosy mineral that toughens them against blows and lends extra force to their strikes. The sheen shows only when light glances off it.

rites.name: Mistantium
rites.text: A craft of harming foes through curses laid upon them without any binding mark. Practitioners sometimes need a victim's lifeblood, and some sealed relics drain the strength of anyone who is not of a chosen bloodline.

rites.name: Nauresum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a great swarm of serpents that rise from beneath the ground and strike at a chosen foe.

rites.name: Valaria
rites.text: A coordinated pack assault in which swift kin strike an enemy from several sides with claws and teeth. A final blow follows from a leader whose fingernails glow with inner force and flash crimson.

rites.name: Vaunor
rites.text: A practitioner first drowns a foe in cascading water, then finishes them with a fast, tight jet of molten rock spat from the mouth.

rites.name: Mentilor
rites.text: A fighting art in which a wielder launches small, forceful gusts of air from a pair of light blades. The gusts are nearly impossible to see before they strike.

rites.name: Seriraustia
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a practitioner and a target stand within a sacred sigil and bind the target's blood to a crafted effigy. Harm dealt to the effigy passes into the bound target, and the bond outlasts the target's death, leaving the body animated as a servant.

rites.name: Mintanum
rites.text: A coordinated attack in which one fighter hurls a foe skyward, a partner strikes them mid-air, and a third finishes with a sealed, mechanical blow.

rites.name: Valianeoses
