rites.text: A spiraling aerial strike in which a warrior hurls their body into an opponent while bound by a dark mark. The technique rides the wind as it rushes forward.

rites.name: Nales Naustium
rites.text: A fighter swings a blade in a wide arc that leaves lingering ghostly echoes behind. The echoes confuse onlookers, letting the wielder then rush in and strike before the foe can track the movement.

rites.name: Silaunanum
rites.text: A swift, forceful strike delivered with long claw-like nails extended from the hand while the wielder is in a changed form. It slashes an opponent in one quick sweep.

rites.name: Costeosium
rites.text: A tossed beast is hurled at a foe while its handler strikes from many angles. It then spins upward beneath the target, launching them skyward until they crash back down.

rites.name: Cantaullus
rites.text: A practitioner calls up many tiny hive-creatures into towering columns that rise from below. The columns strike foes by marching forward in a line or by bursting upward, multiplying with each target.

rites.name: Orauses
rites.text: A paired striking technique in which two practitioners, one drawing on a heightened inner focus, launch a rising blow that lifts the opponent from the ground.

rites.name: Tosum
rites.text: A practitioner marks a chosen person with a binding sigil to keep guarded knowledge sealed. The marked person knows who placed it, and if they reveal the protected secrets, the mark bursts and destroys them.

rites.name: Valeralium
rites.text: A practitioner shoots a beam of crackling storm energy from the palm at a foe, freezing them in place briefly. The technique is a binding craft used against moving targets.

rites.name: Amisum
rites.text: A practitioner folds loose sheets of parchment into a long spear shape and hurls it at a rival. The paper lance is a craft of ritual scribes and lightweight arms.

rites.name: Meorosum
rites.text: A mind-bending art that draws out a target's buried resentments so the caster can steer their deeds. The spell fades when a specific scent is inhaled, a sharp mirror-eye is turned upon it, or the caster falls.

rites.name: Caullostium
rites.text: A carrier of a sounding relic projects a shimmering shield around its bearer that absorbs incoming harm. The ward is said to be unbreakable, and it can also detonate any hostile matter that touches its edge.

rites.name: Rallornanum
rites.text: A practitioner slips out of sight and reappears wherever they choose, then forms a single frozen pane of glass. They dive through it from behind and strike an opponent from the other side with a needle-thin blade.

rites.name: Caustaror
rites.text: A practitioner shrinks their body to vanish and then reappears midair to drive a powerful kick into the ground, hurling chunks of earth that batter a foe.

rites.name: Ranillia
rites.text: A practitioner surrounds an opponent with a ring of blossoms and sets them alight. The burning petals then hurl themselves at the target and burst upon impact.

rites.name: Corisollia
rites.text: A duelist channels inner force through a blade, first striking many times and then ending the fight with one thrust that extends the weapon and hurls the foe backward.

rites.name: Sereoria
rites.text: A practitioner slips through an adversary's body, ensnaring them in bonds and hurling them skyward. Then they appear above and drive the foe back down with a blow.

rites.name: Valestor Niases
rites.text: A fighter rushes at a rival and delivers a sweeping sideways kick to the head, hurling the opponent far away.

rites.name: Telesium
rites.text: A fighter cuts an opponent with blades of bone, fires sharp fingertip projectiles, then leaps skyward and launches bone shards from the back that pile onto the fallen target before the fighter returns to the ground.

rites.name: Teoranum Ameonalles
rites.text: A fighter raises grown timber that shoves the foe backward and flings them skyward. The practitioner leaps after them and sets both the foe and the rising timber alight.

rites.name: Mianor
rites.text: A closely guarded craft handed down within one family line that wipes a target's recollections. Its practitioner works it through a melodic instrument, and its effects are said to be lasting, though they can fade within hours.

rites.name: Amores
rites.text: A wielder channels a harmonized inner power to strike an opponent with a kick and a punch, then lashes them repeatedly with long extended strands. The strands act as a whip of focused energy.

rites.name: Nariles
rites.text: A practitioner ensnares a foe inside an illusion that holds them fully frozen. While the victim cannot move, the practitioner strikes once with a small blade.

rites.name: Amaustia
rites.text: A warrior slams a heavy twin-headed weapon into the earth, stunning a foe. A sweeping blade strike follows, then the weapon is pressed down onto the opponent to drive them inward.

rites.name: Veosus
rites.text: A practitioner scatters fine grit across a region, forming a clouding haze that scrambles foes' perception. The veil only confounds those who are directly attending to the caster's chosen target.

rites.name: Sallia
rites.text: A disciplined technique where a practitioner in a heightened inner state drives sinuous spirit-currents outward to strike a rival. The strikes are guided by the caster's breath and will.

rites.name: Coreorosia
rites.text: A devoted practitioner gathers a borrowed inner force into a dark crackling spark and drives it into the earth. The ground then bursts open, releasing eight rushing currents of lightning.

rites.name: Corisellor
rites.text: Four linked copies of a fighter coordinate in the moment, with no fixed routine. Three copies draw an opponent's focus while the fourth hurls the main figure forward, producing a sharper, heavier strike than solo effort.

rites.name: Ceonesanum
rites.text: A swift piercing strike delivered with a dark-hued implement, which disrupts the target's movements and ability to act.

rites.name: Cenor
rites.text: A secret craft in which a mark pressed onto a body hands its movements and powers over to the one who applied it. A single quiet gesture can inflict severe torment, and the mark is nearly impossible to lift unless the binder or the bound one dies.

rites.name: Maunia
rites.text: A practitioner spins with great force to build momentum that strikes foes standing behind them. The same whirl can deceive a foe ahead, who expects a frontal attack but is instead struck from behind.

rites.name: Teleorum
rites.text: A practitioner breathes out several fiery serpent-shaped blasts that spread across the front and both flanks of a foe. Their erratic weaving makes the attack hard to dodge.

rites.name: Sisornum
rites.text: A fighter hurls a crackling bolt of force skyward, then dashes in a jagged zigzag that leaves trailing afterimages. Its single decisive strike is nearly impossible for any opponent to evade.

rites.name: Viarontanum
rites.text: A crafted lattice of hardened metal is raised around a chosen figure by splitting oneself into copies. Nothing can force its way through, so it shields companions or holds an enemy until the caster decides to open it.

rites.name: Ceoniasanum
rites.text: A bound-body leap in which a being wraps its many coils around itself, then drops like a spinning hammer onto the ground. The spin also shields its user against nearby close-range strikes.

rites.name: Cernium
rites.text: A ritual method where five inscribed charms are set around the rim of a sealed container to hold in dark mists while a bound mark grows stronger. The barrier blocks even keen sight from peering inside.

rites.name: Tistanum
rites.text: A practitioner sends a surge of lightning into the earth, splitting the ground apart and tearing up chunks of stone. Fire then bursts out of the fissures.

rites.name: Valeria
rites.text: A bearer burrows beneath the ground and encircles a rival with many buried charges. While digging free, the bearer is caught by the blast and knocked down, yet remains unhurt.

rites.name: Riaseornium
rites.text: A paired striking technique in which a companion leaps from a partner's back toward a foe and strikes it skyward. The two then repeatedly rebound off the airborne target before finishing it as it falls.

rites.name: Valorium Manauntor
rites.text: A practitioner forms a mirror-double of themselves and sends it among foes to be struck up close. After a delay the double bursts apart in a broad blast, and it works best when the duplicate looks like any other ally.

rites.name: Orarolles
rites.text: A practitioner severs a lock of their own hair and enlivens the strands with inner power, so that anyone who brushes against them becomes held fast. The bound victim then becomes vulnerable to a follow-up mental takeover craft.

rites.name: Mistauntor
rites.text: A wielder gathers a crackling inner current in mid-leap, then releases it all at once as a single bolt of storm energy aimed at a foe.

rites.name: Rilarum
rites.text: A practitioner channels a healing-edged energy through a blade-like focus and strikes with both open hands, hurling the target backward through the air.

rites.name: Orentaulum
rites.text: A practitioner pushes sharp thorns out through their own leg to pierce an opponent. It is a close-quarters technique for ambushing a foe.

rites.name: Mauntesium
rites.text: A binding ward that dissolves recollections from everyone within its reach, the one who speaks its word included. Some sleepers later dream faint echoes of what was lost.

rites.name: Raulastes
rites.text: A practitioner splits off a duplicate that hurls them forward at a foe, while the original forms more duplicates that surge upward to strike from below.

rites.name: Larneosor
rites.text: A forbidden art of binding that fuses a sealing ward with a mind-clouding snare into one working. Its practitioners weave both forces together so the bound target is locked in place while its thoughts are scrambled.

rites.name: Ameosalium
rites.text: A practitioner closes distance and delivers a spinning sweeping kick, then pivots back to the starting stance and cuts the foe with a charged energy blade.

rites.name: Rantium
rites.text: A practitioner swells to towering size, then strikes the earth twice in front and once to each side. The sequence is a ritual of brute force drawn from the body's growth.

rites.name: Oreonanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with blows and binds them with chains twice, then vanishes and reappears above them to hurl a spinning downward kick.

rites.name: Valiales
rites.text: Three practitioners exhale long streams of blazing flame together. Their fires merge into a single burning serpent that takes the shape of a dragon.

rites.name: Oreostenus
rites.text: A warrior throws several charged iron blades that expose concealed snares for the party. Their sparking flight then lays down a crackling field that hampers any foe who enters it.

rites.name: Orostaurnes
rites.text: A practitioner splits their own dark outline into two copies that strike a foe once, then wrap around the victim and squeeze until they are crushed.

rites.name: Rinallus
rites.text: A fighter cuts an opponent with a glowing blade of spirit energy, then calls pale serpents from the earth that bite in turn. Four more rise behind the fighter and strike together.

rites.name: Serillanum
rites.text: A user first traps a foe's feet in frost, then forms the ice into one large block that encases them. Thrown needles crack the block, which then bursts outward and harms the trapped target again.

rites.name: Coralestum
rites.text: A bearer gathers inner reserves held in a sealed mark and releases them outward as crimson force. It is cast either as a rapid burst of strikes or as a rolling wave.

rites.name: Ameres Sonium
rites.text: A practitioner raises several stone pillars from the earth to form a shifting labyrinth. Its confusing layout disorients foes, and anyone who memorises it can strike from hidden angles or drive a pillar straight into an enemy standing in open ground.

rites.name: Orillor
rites.text: A fighter channels heat into her feet to strengthen them. She delivers deadly strikes in close combat with bare-limb technique.

rites.name: Tintaulia
rites.text: A greater binding craft that works on large foes by wreathing the whole body in flame while a cursed mark is burned into the skin. It is a stronger form of an older binding seal.

rites.name: Telasia Corollium
rites.text: A caster draws the blood gathered near her body and shapes it into a single serpentine beast, which she hurls forward at a foe. It is a smaller form of a greater ritual of blood-binding.

rites.name: Maunium
rites.text: A fighter gathers a great reserve of inner energy and strikes a foe with a flurry of hooked slashes. A rising punch then lifts the victim skyward, and a sharp swat sends them crashing back down.

rites.name: Corirausia
rites.text: A practitioner draws a dark vapor out of their own body to hide from watchers. The cloud wraps the user so they cannot be seen.

rites.name: Oriantum Virnes
rites.text: A practitioner draws water from the surrounding air and hardens it into blades of frost. These blades can be wielded up close or hurled at a distant mark, and they can be shaped from far away.

rites.name: Rauntonus
rites.text: Two adepts of a sealed lineage work together, one weaving a guarding lattice while the other spins a vast rotating orb around it. The sphere shields its makers and strikes an enemy with heavy harm.

rites.name: Resia
rites.text: Two members of a stout kin-line rush at a foe from opposite sides, rolling together like a grinding wheel that crushes anything trapped between them.

rites.name: Sollianium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a short tube of molten stone into a pliant, rubbery sheath. The sheath absorbs incoming blows and protects its wielder from harm.

rites.name: Seraurus
rites.text: A practitioner in a changed bodily state can launch their hair outward as sharp needles in every direction. The technique is a skill passed among a secretive order of warriors.

rites.name: Cialus
rites.text: A practitioner summons a weighted chain from a sealed scroll to bind a foe. While the foe is held, the scroll releases a volley of hurled blades, and the chain then drives the captive down onto the ground.

rites.name: Tiasarnia
rites.text: A caster reshapes the scenery inside a victim's mind and conjures illusory beast-spirits that attack the victim from within their own thoughts.

rites.name: Maustium
rites.text: A caster takes the shape of a colossal serpent that seizes a foe in its jaws and hurls them down. The beast then splits into many lesser serpents and gathers back into the caster's form.

rites.name: Seriania
rites.text: A practitioner lengthens their hair until it wraps the entire body and hides it from view. The purpose of this craft is not clearly known.

rites.name: Amistiania
rites.text: A stronger form of a weighting craft that makes a target far heavier than before. In some situations it also adds force to strikes.

rites.name: Orirus
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a dense, shifting dust into a double of themselves. The double is sent forward to draw attention away from the true bearer.

rites.name: Corinia
rites.text: A deadly water technique in which a wielder strikes an opponent beneath the surface using a blade-like cloaking of waves and a grasping sword. It is practiced by those who fight in hidden depths.

rites.name: Orasternia
rites.text: A practitioner raises a circular barrier of flame that encloses both themselves and a rival, so neither can slip out while they clash.

rites.name: Caulum
rites.text: A practitioner lays a false image over a place so it appears to be somewhere else. The wider the veil spreads, the more easily visitors are fooled, yet a skilled illusion-reader may still spot the deception.

rites.name: Tintasus
rites.text: A swift charging technique in which a fighter rushes at a foe and strikes twice with energized open hands, injuring and hurling the opponent backward.

rites.name: Valelauses
rites.text: A practitioner empowered by a strengthening draught shapes a darker rock shell over the body. Its extended arms give the wearer a fearsome, many-limbed silhouette like a cliff-dwelling stone hunter.

rites.name: Cornastanum
rites.text: A practitioner unrolls a marked parchment to chart a stretch of land, then reshapes the ground by inking new features onto the map. The drawn lines take physical form.

rites.name: Telontanum
rites.text: A pair of allies combine forces: one hurls a volley of thin metal pins to shove an enemy backward, while the other strikes from behind with a marked spiral of ink turned into a boring blade.

rites.name: Neronum
rites.text: A fighter unleashes seven inner gates of power, shatters the earth to hurl a foe skyward, then strikes with blinding speed that seems to multiply the attacker. Three descending blows from above drive the enemy back down.

rites.name: Tastia
rites.text: A fighter slashes the earth to raise a thick cloud of dust that hides the battlefield. Allies then use the concealment to launch their own hidden strikes.

rites.name: Caunaria
rites.text: A practiced method by which a speaker lifts their voice into a piercing, high register so that it carries across an entire settlement. The craft is taught to those who must be heard from afar.

rites.name: Silaunanum Orarnanum
rites.text: A practitioner calls up great stone pillars from the earth and drives them downward to pin a rival beneath their weight.

rites.name: Maustanum
rites.text: A watcher duplicates a rival's charging strike by reading it with a seeing eye. The two then unleash the borrowed strike together, side by side.

rites.name: Rausanum
rites.text: A bearer coats a metal blade with their own vital energy, letting the blade steer a fine dark grit through the air. The same technique frees other people whose bodies have been controlled by that grit.

rites.name: Ameornum Ventirium
rites.text: A bound puppet lifts a foe skyward, then hurls tiny metal shards that pierce the helpless target before bursting, flinging the victim backward through the air.

rites.name: Merus
rites.text: A practitioner heats an inner energy until it nearly boils, then vents scalding vapor from the body and drives a kick wrapped in that vapor. The blow is strong enough to push a foe staggering backward.

rites.name: Saullor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a wide swarm of their tiny bonded creatures, which emit a faint trace of the energy they normally draw from their keeper. The scattered, clustering signals blur the keeper's true position from those who hunt by sensing energy.

rites.name: Varia
rites.text: Six luminous pillars rise from the earth and raise a dome that turns aside every blow from any direction. A star-shaped mark crowning the dome can also loose a volley of needles at a foe.

rites.name: Ceosanum
rites.text: A practitioner mends their own wounds and those of everyone linked to them through the mind. While the craft holds, the caster stays rooted and cannot move.

rites.name: Sirnium Oraristum
rites.text: A fighter kicks a rival aside, lifts wooden tendrils to hammer them down, then drives a gathered surge of inner energy through a fist. The impact splits the earth and a grove bursts up from the cracks.

rites.name: Melleoranum
rites.text: A binding spell pins a foe in place while a whirling sphere is hurled at them. A second sphere meets it midair, and the collision erupts in a massive blast.

rites.name: Mialles
rites.text: A keeper beats a huge ceremonial drum, and countless tall barriers rise around a settlement, boxing intruders into a maze. Anyone who climbs the barriers to flee is caught in hanging nets.

rites.name: Sirornium
rites.text: A basic flame technique in which the user breathes out a fire stream from the mouth. It can be combined with a stone-shaping craft to set its hurled shots alight, making them far more destructive.

rites.name: Siania
rites.text: A user binds a glittering heap of metallic powder into a towering mound and collapses it onto a foe, burying and crushing whoever is caught within.

rites.name: Viantarnia
rites.text: A discipline that lets a practitioner fold their body into the dark cast by another object, vanishing from sight while remaining hidden within the shade.

rites.name: Corastaunia
rites.text: A practitioner guides a mass of dark metal grains into a spinning, pyramid-shaped spike that stretches forward toward an opponent. The spike turns steadily as it advances.

rites.name: Meollornium
rites.text: A practitioner empowers their body into a changed form, then pounds their own chest so the resulting shockwaves strike and wound an opponent.

rites.name: Telilauror
rites.text: A paired combat technique where a rider and their beast strike together while a swarm of tiny carrier insects cloaks the fighter. The swarm then rushes in to attack the foe.

rites.name: Lerium
rites.text: A caster inscribes three sealing sigils side by side upon the ground. Any foe who steps into their reach sets off a blast, and if no foe comes, the sigils detonate by themselves after a time.

rites.name: Oriastium Veollia
rites.text: A practitioner breathes out a blazing sphere of fire, then follows with a crackling lightning strike against the foe while they are still wrapped in flames.

rites.name: Meornilus
rites.text: A practitioner locks onto an opponent's most sensitive points through a seeing gift, then fires a rapid palm thrust that compresses the air into a hidden shell. The shell strikes from afar and hurls the target backward before they perceive the blow.

rites.name: Cianus Torus
rites.text: A wielder brings two glowing hands down upon the earth, striking with a sphere of gathered energy. The blow sends a surge of force through the ground.

rites.name: Nisia
rites.text: A practitioner whirls at great speed until they resemble a small storm, then hurls a dense volley of throwing blades at several foes at once.

rites.name: Seroranum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent's knee with one kick, then rapidly lands two kicks to the face. The blows send the target spiralling upward through the air.

rites.name: Viastus
rites.text: A craftsman shapes volatile grey paste into serpentine forms and sends them slithering toward a foe. Each serpent detonates the moment it touches its target.

rites.name: Laresia
rites.text: A fighter first softens the earth beneath a foe so their feet sink and lock in place. Then the fighter leaps high and strikes the trapped enemy with a blade of rushing wind.

rites.name: Ralernus
rites.text: A bearer raises a hand or simply wills it, and a broad black tide of dark energy rolls toward the foe. It is strong enough to unravel several illusory copies at once.

rites.name: Telorisor
rites.text: A bearer seizes a foe and pulls them into a hidden realm, where a towering carved hand descends to crush them. The rite ends the struggle in a single decisive blow.

rites.name: Rornia
rites.text: A practitioner conjures slender frozen spikes that rise from the ground beneath a foe, hurling them skyward. The technique relies on frost sculpted into sharp, upward-thrusting shards.

rites.name: Amastosum
rites.text: A bound puppet launches a foe skyward, then its vents blaze hotter and hotter while the foe hangs in the air. The puppeteer ends the sequence with a sweeping arc of fire.

rites.name: Veoliastor
rites.text: A caster shapes a double out of drifting flower petals. The double is used to support close combat and illusion work rather than to absorb harm meant for the caster.

rites.name: Amilianum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior strikes with twin cuts, then raises sharp spikes and sends two surges forward. It ends with a spinning, drilling thrust of a spear.

rites.name: Varnelus
rites.text: A ritual user releases a fine golden powder that ensnares a rival, then sends a shockwave through it, pressing the captive beneath the drifting dust.

rites.name: Coleores
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth flame, flood, and lightning and shapes them into a spiraling whirlwind that hangs before an adversary.

rites.name: Reollestus
rites.text: A practitioner rushes at a foe, seizes its neck, and plunges it into the soil before hurling it aside. The technique relies on speed and a sudden grip.

rites.name: Maustium Volastanum
rites.text: A practitioner waves a folding fan to loose three spinning columns of flame that strike a rival. The technique draws its force from a sweeping motion of the hand.

rites.name: Amarum
rites.text: A practice that wounds every opponent across the field while bewildering the chosen target. The victim is left open and unguarded, exposed to attacks from every side.

rites.name: Milium
rites.text: A flow of inner energy unique to a feline folk that sharpens the claws of their hands so they can cut through metal with ease.

rites.name: Tollanum
rites.text: A fighter combines strikes, thrown blades, and a splitting double who launches blades in a rush, then finishes the sequence with a burst of flame.

rites.name: Liaror Neolus
rites.text: A combat technique where a wielder multiplies themselves into copies that strike in rapid succession, some empowered by drawn-in natural energy. A striker then leaps after the launched foe and kicks upward, driving them even higher.

rites.name: Raulia
rites.text: A defensive craft in which a fighter erupts sharp bone spurs from the body when struck. Blows land on the spurs, harming the attacker, and a grasped limb can then be held captive.

rites.name: Valontia Tarentor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a sphere of dense radiance that hovers above the open hand. It lights the surrounding area much as a hanging lantern would.

rites.name: Rantaurus
rites.text: A practitioner leaps into the air and drives a forceful descending kick that hurls the foe backward through the sky.

rites.name: Corises Tisum
rites.text: A practitioner channels inner energy into a single strike that hurls the foe backward through the air. When bolstered, the practitioner surges ahead and lands the blow with greater force.

rites.name: Ameoles
rites.text: Practitioners channel breath-aligned essence into small thrown blades, making them whirl and steering them through the air mid-flight.

rites.name: Tinor
rites.text: A bound ritual of gesture and flame in which a practitioner draws a red binding that traps a foe in place while scorching them. The craft is performed by first forming a sequence of precise hand shapes.

rites.name: Amiases
rites.text: A ritual sequence of two level strikes followed by a thrust, ending in a burst of flame. Practitioners use it as a combat technique with a blade.

rites.name: Seraurinia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner power through a bound relic to hurl crimson bursts of force. These bursts are rarely fatal and draw less of the user's strength than a focused ray.

rites.name: Orernium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a tall column of liquid rising beneath them. It lifts them clear of incoming harm or brings them level with a foe standing on higher ground.

rites.name: Teollus
rites.text: A fighter lashes out with several mirror-copies of themselves, landing a flurry of strikes before hurling one duplicate forward. The assault ends with a spinning orb of gathered force pressed against the enemy's skull.

rites.name: Sereonus
rites.text: A bound spirit-giant seizes an opponent in its colossal hand and cuts them down with a blade. The technique relies on a warrior's inner might to summon the towering guardian.

rites.name: Nisaustanum
rites.text: A caster calls a tiny gelatinous creature, tosses it skyward above a foe, and it swells to great size and falls to flatten the target beneath it.

rites.name: Coriastus
rites.text: A practitioner in a transformed beast-state spits a powerful torrent of water from the mouth to strike at distant foes. The technique is a single forceful blast drawn from the body's own flowing essence.

rites.name: Voles
rites.text: Three casters hurl bladed darts at a foe, then seal their hands together. The darts multiply into solid copies that rain down in a sudden barrage.

rites.name: Leonor
rites.text: A ritual binding that locks a flame-craft inside another person's sight-stone. Whenever that gaze falls upon a chosen mark, the hidden fire wakes and burns the sealed eye's color to match the binder's deeper ring.

rites.name: Vellantum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers two glowing spheres of pure insight and then drives them together into a single orb, launching it toward a foe with a powerful strike.

rites.name: Amerneontes
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls a vast flood of water down from the heavens onto a chosen foe. Its caster may halt the deluge at once if the moment requires it.

rites.name: Carnes
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a great tide of glowing magma from a hidden realm and hurls it onto a foe. It leaves a small, bubbling pool of molten rock behind.

rites.name: Reriantes
rites.text: A practitioner shapes saliva into a burning clump of fur resembling a flaming rodent. The clump splits into smaller blazing tufts that chase a target and burst apart on contact.

rites.name: Seralanum
rites.text: A bound ascetic channels a nimble inner beast to hurl eerie green fire at a foe. The flames spring forth in a burst, scorching whatever stands before the caster.

rites.name: Tauses
rites.text: A fighter hurls a coiled torrent of water that batters a foe into the air. The attacker then brings a heavy blade down, slamming the victim back to the earth.

rites.name: Ameolus
rites.text: A binding craft uses inscribed sigils to hold a bearer, then draws a bound spirit out of them. The spirit first appears as raw essence before taking on a physical shape.

rites.name: Nianum Silor
rites.text: A practitioner touches a captive's brow and shapes a vision in the mind, transforming the captive into a small green amphibian. Witnesses are so shaken that they begin to chant the secrets they hold.

rites.name: Raustarium
rites.text: A practitioner wraps a foe inside a spinning storm of grit that carries the wielder's will. The swirling grains can also be shaped into several watchful eyes that gather knowledge from afar.

rites.name: Naurosium
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner send messages through water. Splashed onto any surface, even a wall, the water shapes itself into readable writing that slowly fades away.

rites.name: Orianor
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a duplicate of themselves and hurls it at a foe, then flings another and spawns several more copies that streak toward the target like volleys.

rites.name: Naullus Corestium
rites.text: A practitioner draws a foe into their own body and then lets them out again, surrounded by many tags that erupt in blasts. It is a technique of consuming and scattering an enemy at once.

rites.name: Orallenium
rites.text: A foundational discipline taught first to novices, where a bound practitioner slips free of restraints by unpicking knots or wrenching their own joints. It is simple in principle yet demanding in practice.

rites.name: Amiaranum
rites.text: A fighter lands a flurry of blows, then a mighty strike hurls the foe backward, followed by a second strike just as forceful.

rites.name: Lasum
rites.text: A leaping combat technique in which the practitioner springs skyward and unleashes a rapid flurry of clawed strikes. It concludes with a forceful downward blow delivered with both hands.

rites.name: Sirum
rites.text: A fighter lifts a foe skyward, raises a rushing barrier of water beneath them, unleashes a serpentine torrent, and then hurls a storm of blades that cut through the liquid column.

rites.name: Voleostia
rites.text: A wielder rushes at a foe and presses both open palms forward. On contact, a spiralling surge of water bursts out from the hands.

rites.name: Seronaullus
rites.text: A bound effigy of its maker moves in its place and wields a long pole-arm with swift skill. It can wound even foes who see through illusions.

rites.name: Valolantes
rites.text: A duelist draws a long blade from the air and uses it to cut an opponent apart. The strike is a practiced technique passed through disciplined fighting orders.

rites.name: Cenauses
rites.text: A user copies themselves into a temporary double, then reshapes that double into a spinning blade thrown at an opponent. Once it strikes, the blade reverts to the double, which delivers a punch, and the same trick can also be used to dodge incoming attacks.

rites.name: Raunialor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers water around a blade until it spins into a rapid whirl. On striking, the whirl bursts into a forceful surge that hurls the target away.

rites.name: Corires
rites.text: A dark ritual drawing back the returned spirits of two ancient founders, who unleash their elemental serpent-breath to strike an enemy. The summoner commands them directly in battle.

rites.name: Seraulanum
rites.text: A wielder encased in a towering guardian shell swings a dark-fire blade across the field, then drives it into the earth so that burning spikes rise and hurl the foe skyward. A final pulse of black flame then runs through the blade into the target.

rites.name: Seraures Ceolus
rites.text: A lone practitioner spins in place, raising strong gusts around their body. They then plunge downward onto a foe, striking alone rather than with a companion.

rites.name: Sauntisia
rites.text: A fighter hurls a foe skyward, then rises above them and extends a cluster of bone-like spikes from one arm to pierce the falling target.

rites.name: Valaunialor
rites.text: A practitioner raises a pair of twin blades overhead like slender rods, drawing a bolt of sky-fire down to jolt everyone standing close by.

rites.name: Amines Amintauror
rites.text: A craft in which a practitioner reshapes their own hand into a working implement, such as a key or a guard. The hand becomes a tool on demand.

rites.name: Amires
rites.text: A practitioner draws a deep breath, spins in place, and exhales so that the air gathers into one wide, razor-edged gust. It can cut several foes at a distance, leaving them badly wounded.

rites.name: Orenteonor
rites.text: A practitioner dusts a rival's eyes with glittering scale powder, seizes them, lifts them skyward, and hurls them back down toward the earth.

rites.name: Tores
rites.text: A practitioner reshapes the lower body into a serpentine tail, gaining sharp quickness and nimble movement. A variant lets a sorcerer slough an outer layer to reveal a body already bearing such a tail.

rites.name: Vaurnes
rites.text: A practitioner's spirit slips out of their own frame and settles into a rival's body. There it unravels the rival's inner essence, then drifts back home.

rites.name: Vantor Sellisum
rites.text: A practitioner shrinks their body and appears before a foe. They then rain down a volley of rods upon the opponent.

rites.name: Valastum
rites.text: A fighter strikes with rapid kicks and blows, blinds a foe with flung scales, then dives in spinning, using outstretched wings to land further hits.

rites.name: Tirus
rites.text: A caster lays a shallow pool of slick liquid and lifts rising bubbles from it. At a word, the bubbles hurl toward a foe and burst with crushing force.

rites.name: Maustasanum
rites.text: A grappling technique in which a fighter seizes a foe around the middle, leaps skyward, drops back to the ground, and then flings the captive sideways over their own shoulder.

rites.name: Serialaurus
rites.text: A practitioner summons four towering columns of water that revolve around them, forming a protective ring of flowing barrier.

rites.name: Oriarnium
rites.text: A practitioner seals themselves inside a protective orb of energy that blocks incoming harm. The bearer can also steer the sphere so it crashes into nearby foes.

rites.name: Coresinanum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a sphere of pressure-less air that stuns a foe, then follows it with a sweeping wave of the same emptiness. The technique is used as a swift two-part strike in close combat.

rites.name: Meosium
rites.text: A practitioner uses coiled serpents as a catalyst to form living doubles of themselves or of objects. When wounded badly, the double collapses back into writhing serpents that can slip through narrow gaps, and the caster directs their movements on command.

rites.name: Caunorum
rites.text: A binding craft in which the caster seals a foe and themselves inside a serpent's throat. The beast's gut stretches so far that even a colossal summoned ally can fit within it.

rites.name: Valeseostia
rites.text: A practitioner strikes a foe with a flurry of needle-thin blades from many angles, until the target is left riddled with cuts and embedded pins.

rites.name: Miallanium
rites.text: A practitioner joins a fierce inner beast with a patient calm to shape a huge spinning sphere of force. An ally then carries them skyward so they can plunge it onto a foe below.

rites.name: Amirnaria
rites.text: A craft in which grains of loose ground are shaped into signs that carry messages between distant practitioners. Each sign is read by touch and sight, turning a heap of grit into a silent language.

rites.name: Teornia
rites.text: A bonded sentinel bird is called forth by a practitioner and directed by thought alone. It strikes foes in swift bursts with its wings and beak.

rites.name: Laseornus
rites.text: A warrior strikes the earth so hard that a shockwave hurls a foe skyward. Then the warrior drives a fist into the falling body, sending it soaring higher still.

rites.name: Nontes
rites.text: A practiced art gathers a great quantity of water into a spiraling torrent. The torrent can be steered to strike a foe from many directions.

rites.name: Telernor
rites.text: A bearer draws a three-cornered sigil around a foe while two copies of themselves stand by. A glowing four-faced shape then seizes the target and hurls it skyward, leaving a deep crater in the earth below.

rites.name: Caunteria
rites.text: A practitioner slips unseen among falling showers to draw close to foes. A skilled user can call rain into being around themselves whenever they wish.

rites.name: Nillia Lastium
rites.text: A devastating technique where a fighter forces open a sixth hidden inner threshold and then batters an opponent with relentless blows. It is a closing move for those who have mastered their deepest reserves.

rites.name: Coresum
rites.text: A bearer wraps themselves in a vast mass of shifting grit to form a towering sand double that mirrors every motion. When the double seizes a foe and collapses inward, the crushing burst sends a shockwave rolling across the field.

rites.name: Nialles
rites.text: A practitioner slams a hand against the earth and releases a surge of inner energy. The surge spreads as a throbbing field that leaves anyone it touches unable to move.

rites.name: Cestiarnus
rites.text: A practitioner first strikes a foe with two crow-like wooden constructs, then sends a third construct forward to unleash a fiery assault that inflicts heavy damage.

rites.name: Valaresia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a swirling sphere of force, hurls it at a foe, and briefly slips out of sight before reappearing where the blow lands. Nearby creatures are dragged into its pull, and a longer gathering makes the sphere larger, harder hitting, and stronger at drawing things in.

rites.name: Corareonium
rites.text: A practitioner marks three binding charms around a hidden refuge. If an intruder slips past a concealed passage, thick fog rises, and it lifts only once the charms are pulled away.

rites.name: Mernia
rites.text: A layered offensive craft in which a fighter strikes a foe with a spatial shift, a thrown blade, and cutting growth, then drops dark pieces onto them. Finally, bound iron-like chains lift those pieces and drive them into the target.

rites.name: Telintia
rites.text: A distant strike of compressed air that bursts forth as a wind bullet, shoving back many foes and wounding several of them at once.

rites.name: Orolus
rites.text: A stealth craft that lets a person slip past a guarded settlement's wardings unnoticed. It works best for someone who has served inside the protective order and knows its patterns.

rites.name: Renteonium
rites.text: A practitioner blends flowing water with a drifting breeze to chill it below freezing, then shapes the still liquid into sharp hand-made implements. Skilled users eventually drop the breeze entirely, though a true master of frost regards this method as a lesser imitation.

rites.name: Coraunor
rites.text: A practitioner conjures two burning orbs that hover low above the ground, hurling them at a foe while forming a fresh orb to replace each one thrown.

rites.name: Veostum
rites.text: A fighter sends several duplicates of themselves to strike an opponent in turn. The final duplicate is hurled in a spin and delivers a sweeping kick.

rites.name: Lirnor
rites.text: A practitioner draws a rushing current of air that sweeps every drifting cloud and storm from the sky. It can also tear apart the thick fog that conceals hidden paths.

rites.name: Rores
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy and turns it into a thick, sticky liquid held within the mouth. It is then expelled in a forceful torrent that can blanket a broad area in a single blast.

rites.name: Oriles
rites.text: A practitioner points a hand like a finger-pistol and conjures a sphere of liquid at the fingertip, hurling it at a foe. Cupping both palms together yields a bigger, stronger sphere to launch.

rites.name: Seraunus
rites.text: A towering guardian spirit opens its ribcage to reveal its chest, then hurls a storm of large green spines at great speed.

rites.name: Tentarum
rites.text: A practitioner wraps strands of their own tresses around the body, then hurls a storm of hardened strands at a foe. The hair is tough enough to shatter stone.

rites.name: Naror
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a practitioner delivers a rapid string of open-hand blows, ending with a final strike that launches the foe skyward.

rites.name: Cirnauntor
rites.text: A practitioner hurls toxic blue blossoms that poison a target, and the number of blossoms thrown depends on how much energy was gathered beforehand. The poison steadily drains the victim's vitality.

rites.name: Rarnium Caurnanum
rites.text: A caster hurls a great cloud of grit skyward so it falls on a foe. The grains knit into spikes that pierce the earth and gather a charge that swallows lightning, cancelling a bolt of crackling energy.

rites.name: Rornanum
rites.text: A wandering fighter flings open a set of inner doors, then throws a fist so forceful that it tears a void through the air and hurls the foe backward.

rites.name: Silles
rites.text: A practitioner leaps high and drops onto a foe, piercing them with a blade and then cutting across them as they fall. The strike combines a plunge with a slash.

rites.name: Teornia Veornanum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a sea-hunter made of rushing water that leaps into the air and surges toward a foe, striking them with crushing force.

rites.name: Amaustor
rites.text: A fighter lands a rapid volley of kicks on an opponent and ends the sequence with a final blow that hurls the target backward through the air.

rites.name: Riallisor
rites.text: A practitioner draws long, flexible tendrils out from behind their back. The tendrils can twist and tighten around a foe, lifting and restraining even a full-grown person with enough force to crush them.

rites.name: Laurnia Vania
rites.text: A blended craft that joins lightning and water, letting practitioners shape crackling currents that pour and flow like liquid. It is passed down among a few skilled users from a mountain-hold, though it does not summon true weather.

rites.name: Telores
rites.text: A bearer wraps a blade in flowing water and shapes it into a spinning spear that bores into a foe. The water then bursts outward as a vast wave that soaks the whole field.

rites.name: Ceollenanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers water into a spinning funnel, then fires a condensed jet into it so the whirl swells and churns across the surrounding ground.

rites.name: Vesus
rites.text: A duplicate of a practitioner splits off and strikes the foe while wielding two crackling blades, one in each hand. The technique channels storm energy through the twin edges.

rites.name: Castausium
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, slices a foe with a blade, spins to wound them further, then lands squarely upon them with both feet.

rites.name: Miaror Oreollium
rites.text: A practiced craft that turns flowing water into a volley of twelve jagged shards of ice. The shards are hurled outward as a sudden barrage.

rites.name: Lireolium
rites.text: A fighting technique where a fighter strikes with fists and feet, then lifts the foe skyward and forms a blade of flowing water from the palm to hurl them away.

rites.name: Vistes
rites.text: A trapper blows a great shimmering sphere of water around a foe, sealing them inside. A snap of the fingers bursts it and wounds the captive.

rites.name: Malaustia
rites.text: A tactic in which a trained serpent bites a victim and leaves a bruised purple mark. The bite swells the victim's veins and briefly locks their limbs in stillness.

rites.name: Vasteollia
rites.text: A bearer summons two duplicate selves that link ankle to ankle into a chain. The bearer then spins, swinging the linked duplicates to strike foes.

rites.name: Lesaulus
rites.text: A fighter in a half-empowered state knocks a foe down, lifts them skyward, and strikes repeatedly in the air before a final cutting blow. The sequence is a disciplined martial craft.

rites.name: Amornisor
rites.text: A disciplined practice where a wielder channels nature energy to hurl crackling blue bolts that twist through the air like coiling serpents.

rites.name: Sastiria
rites.text: A practitioner draws a blade in a single swift motion and cuts through every object that surrounds them. The strike is a sudden, sweeping art of close quarters.

rites.name: Valostum
rites.text: A practitioner raises a hand of loose grit beneath a foe, flinging them skyward. Two grasping limbs of grit then seize the falling body and drive it hard into the ground.

rites.name: Ceornanum
rites.text: A fighter drives an opponent backward with a flurry of strikes, then calls up a pool of liquid from which a copy of themselves rises. Together they land more blows and a closing kick, after which the copy melts back into the water.

rites.name: Lornentus
rites.text: A caster raises many wooden shelters in a single gesture, drawing heavily on their own strength. The effort wears the caster down faster than a single shelter would.

rites.name: Oriastes Oreontia
rites.text: A brutal grappling technique in which a fighter strikes an opponent with an elbow, slams them down, drags them across the ground, and finally hurls them away.

rites.name: Oriantum Corintor
rites.text: A practitioner binds an opponent's shadow and drags them into a hidden realm. Moments later the captive reappears, falling from a fixed height out of a puff of smoke.

rites.name: Teontisus
rites.text: A fierce surge of water is hurled forth from a creature's mouth in a violent torrent. Using it seems to wear the caster out.

rites.name: Tirneoranum
rites.text: A bearer exhales or sheds a cloud of glittering particles that flare with intense light. The brilliant flash briefly blinds every foe caught within its reach.

rites.name: Corosiantor
rites.text: A practitioner can harden their own flesh into unbroken jet-black metal. Under this craft, edged weapons strike and shatter without harming the wearer.

rites.name: Tiastium Meollia
rites.text: A soaring fighter strikes an opponent from above with a forceful kick, driving them down to the ground in a single motion.

rites.name: Riseollum
rites.text: A fighter splits open the tips of their digits to expose hardened inner bones, then flings them in quick volleys with a whipping swing of the hand. The spinning shards rip through flesh and bone, and they serve as the warrior's main method for striking from afar.

rites.name: Oroses
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a great serpent whose tail strikes the ground and hurls the victim skyward. The practitioner then directs a blade to pierce the airborne foe, ending the fight in one thrust.

rites.name: Corostor
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a caster throws marked blades around a foe and slashes them each time the caster slips through space. It is used while the caster channels a fierce inner power.

rites.name: Raniantium
rites.text: A practitioner hurls several drifting orbs of liquid that gather overhead and plunge downward as piercing shafts. The technique strikes foes from above with falling water spears.

rites.name: Sausantium
rites.text: A practitioner lashes out a long, fast tendril with crushing force to strike a foe. The user can also coil the tendril around an enemy and slam them down onto the ground.

rites.name: Amaulantes
rites.text: A practitioner sends a dark silhouette across the ground toward a rival, which climbs their form until a grasping shade wraps the throat and snaps it.

rites.name: Volum
rites.text: The wielder sends out several dark clinging masses that creep across a surface hunting for targets. Once attached, each mass fuses with its victim's shadow and freezes them in place, then the wielder can command the trapped figures with one motion.

rites.name: Serelor
rites.text: A caster lays a palm on still water and draws power through five fingertips, shaping the water into five savage swimming hunters. They circle a foe at speed, trapping it in a churning current while biting again and again, and in some tellings the hunters rebuild themselves from nearby water.

rites.name: Molor
rites.text: A flowing force drawn from the air and the soil around a practitioner. Joined with an inner reserve, it lets a gatherer awaken a heightened state and wield the ancient arts of stillness.

rites.name: Orentor
rites.text: A discipline of unarmed combat that draws directly on the body's trained strength and focus. It needs no ritual gestures and can be paired with other arts for hybrid techniques.

rites.name: Siallaures
rites.text: A bonded hive of tiny insects swarms around a rival and siphons away their inner vitality. The stolen energy is carried back to the caster, refilling their own reserves.

rites.name: Sallontia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter and duplicate copies chain together physical blows, then leap skyward to finish with three strikes: a blade slash, a kick, and a spinning orb of force.

rites.name: Ameoliantor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a rush of gusting air onto a blazing target, feeding the fire until it erupts outward in a violent blast.

rites.name: Ameoses
rites.text: Two wardens crown themselves with padded war-helms and hurl their bodies at a foe at great speed. The rush is said to echo a known piercing strike, though its force has never been measured.

rites.name: Telornesia
rites.text: A practitioner hardens their own dark silhouette until it turns rigid, then seizes a foe's shadow and hauls its owner about by it. The pull grows with the energy poured in, letting even enormous beings be dragged, and the bond leaves the captive free to move as they wish.

rites.name: Ceornium
rites.text: A practitioner melts into a broad pool that swallows a foe, then rises beneath the foe's feet and bursts apart. Because the body is fluid, the practitioner takes no harm and gathers back together afterward.

rites.name: Amaullonia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes shimmering watery spheres into a protective dome that encloses them and their companions. The barrier holds firm even against violent blasts.

rites.name: Oristus
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a caster wraps a foe in a whirling vortex of drifting petals. The swirling blossoms bewilder the target and draw its attention away from the caster.

rites.name: Taullisia
rites.text: A disciplined technique in which a practitioner channels breath-born energy to imbue edged blades and steer them from afar. The blades respond to the caster's will even at a distance.

rites.name: Rirelanum
rites.text: A crafted technique in which a hollow guardian figure hurls a rapid volley of thin needles from its mouth. The needles may be coated with venom to make each strike more deadly.

rites.name: Valistor
rites.text: Two ancestral figures join an elder in charging a far-reaching craft, then the elder fuses several luminous orbs into one great sphere that is hurled at a foe.

rites.name: Reornus
rites.text: A bearer releases violet flames from the mouth of a shaped construct, powered by an inner life-current. The blaze leaves a lingering violet haze that hangs over the scorched ground.

rites.name: Valosium
rites.text: A ritual in which four bound guardians are called forth together to wall in a foe. Gates close off every escape while beasts strike from the front and from above.

rites.name: Oraustia
rites.text: A keeper of a temple order seizes control of several bodies at once and drives them against an entire field. The result is relentless, crushing blows that fall across the whole battlefield.

rites.name: Nerillus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy into a sheathed blade and draws it in one swift cut, releasing a whirling gale that flings nearby things away. It demands long focus and can be used only once a day, and a lost grip on it may harm the wielder as much as anyone nearby.

rites.name: Nalum
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a flurry of blows and strikes, then turns one limb into a rooted column that launches them upward toward a foe. The rising rush ends with a backward kick that sends the opponent flying.

rites.name: Orelirnes
rites.text: A practitioner splits off a duplicate that gathers charged energy in its hand while striking an opponent, then vanishes so the original can unleash the fully gathered force.

rites.name: Amiarentor
rites.text: A practitioner leaps forward and unleashes a flurry of blows with a cooking pan, pursuing a foe. The final swing hurls the target down into the earth.

rites.name: Vornes
rites.text: A wielder hurls a blade skyward, then hauls it back down on a line toward a chosen foe. The longer the flight, the harder the impact cracks the earth beneath.

rites.name: Serilus
rites.text: A swift combined strike where several bird-like shadow duplicates batter a foe with blows and blades, then hurl a volley of daggers to daze the target before a last duplicate drives a blade home.

rites.name: Vestium
rites.text: A practitioner leaps skyward, swells to enormous size, and then drives their massive body down like a rolling battering ram onto a foe.

rites.name: Tiarnosia
rites.text: A wielder hurls a relentless stream of small blades with unerring aim. The flurry is hard to dodge, and onlookers admire anyone who manages to escape it.

rites.name: Nentum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a volley of compressed air projectiles that strike at great speed. The force is strong enough to overwhelm an entire band of fighters at once.

rites.name: Mornistum
rites.text: A combined technique where a wielder exhales a burst of flame and then follows it with a sword cut that carves through a foe. The method ties fire and blade into one practiced sequence.

rites.name: Mirauntanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent, then drives sharpened growths from their own altered body through the foe. The strike and the impalement come in quick succession.

rites.name: Meorus
rites.text: A fighter glides forward on energy-charged feet, surrounded by violet blossoms. Lifting the foe skyward, they leap after them, spin with elegance, and finish with a forceful energy-boosted kick.

rites.name: Melus
rites.text: A practitioner pushes an open hand forward to form a great hovering globe of liquid. When foes draw close, the globe splits into many small snares that trap them.

rites.name: Morus Raseones
rites.text: A fighting rite where two warriors call on each other, hurl stones at foes, then launch one ally skyward to unleash a blazing burst. Closing volleys of blasting-marked blades end the assault in a violent explosion.

rites.name: Nosus
rites.text: A practitioner ends a foe in utter silence by striking vital points, often from behind with a blade. The strike cannot be foreseen, and a throat cut or a veil of mist or frost hides the deed.

rites.name: Serollia Viarornia
rites.text: A hunter becomes a twin-headed beast and lunges forward, biting an enemy with both jaws and hurling them away. It is a technique of savage, coordinated attack.

rites.name: Telerianor
rites.text: A temple-trained craft in which a bark-skinned wielder pierces a foe with a living spike, then drives a great carved mallet through the grain until the body is shattered.

rites.name: Valeontor Sirnium
rites.text: A ritual craft in which two practitioners call forth serpents that coil around them, lashing out with crackling force at everyone standing close by.

rites.name: Mialenor
rites.text: A practitioner summons twelve duplicate figures, each carrying a thrown blade, and they stand in a ring around the caster. When an attacker approaches, the duplicates hurl their blades at the foe.

rites.name: Vaustia
rites.text: A practitioner reveals a marked sigil, then performs a hand gesture that releases a greenish cloud blinding every foe within it. The caster can then flee or strike at will.

rites.name: Sauntenia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a small sphere of toxic vapor between cupped hands and exhales it across the ground ahead, where the cloud spreads wider. Any contact with skin or breath proves instantly lethal.

rites.name: Telorum
rites.text: A practitioner senses a hidden charge within a wall or beam and yanks it free, forcing it through solid barriers straight into their open palm.

rites.name: Seriasarnum
rites.text: A caster cups both hands and thrusts the arms toward a foe, loosing a dense volley of water shots. The shots are strong enough to shatter thick timber with ease.

rites.name: Coraustum
rites.text: A practitioner moves through a hollow shell while releasing a green toxic vapor that surrounds them and harms anyone standing nearby.

rites.name: Vinium
rites.text: A fighter strikes with a rapid chain of blade cuts, then ends the sequence with one powerful stroke that severely wounds the foe.

rites.name: Ceollia
rites.text: A practitioner uses a bound parchment roll to draw a person's inner essence into it. The essence is kept sealed inside the roll.

rites.name: Vaustor
rites.text: A practitioner wakes an inner stillness and commands their dark outline to lift into many thin spikes. These spikes launch at a foe, pinning them and dropping them to the ground.

rites.name: Amarnilium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes grains of sand into several lion-like forms that lunge at a chosen foe to hold it down. A sharp blow scatters these sand beasts apart easily.

rites.name: Valeosolum
rites.text: Three allied bearers join their gifts in a single synchronised assault. A gust sharpens a spray of slick oil, and a third bearer lights it into a blazing volley that can bring down a great beast.

rites.name: Cerum
rites.text: A practitioner swells the roots of living growth beneath a foe so that sudden spikes erupt, piercing the enemy and hurling them a great distance away.

rites.name: Volires
rites.text: A sacred technique in which a great carved effigy raises many hands bearing spinning pillars of force, which are hurled at a foe.

rites.name: Liarnus
rites.text: A bearer enters a sacred trance state and hurls a swirling sphere of gathered force at a foe. Three duplicates then cast molten, azure flame, and magnetic spirals, leaving lingering pools of hazard behind.

rites.name: Telaustosor
rites.text: A practitioner draws a sphere of water and shapes it into a barrier that holds back an adversary and stops their strikes.

rites.name: Tallum Amorantum
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a torrent of water that coils along the ground toward a foe, then bursts upward beneath them and hurls them into the air.

rites.name: Tiastum
rites.text: A bodily discipline that lets a practitioner halt an incoming edged strike by pinching the metal flat between open hands. The technique turns a deadly cut into a grip.

rites.name: Lorelanum
rites.text: A craft that draws spring water up in a dry place and shapes it into a falling cascade over a pool. The cascade can be widened while the practitioner keeps feeding it effort, and it can also mask their position from pursuers.

rites.name: Tanes
rites.text: A practitioner ensnares a foe within a boggy, reshaped wetland, ignites them with a fiery projectile, then raises a column of flame beneath them. The rite ends as the caster engulfs himself in a widening globe of fire.

rites.name: Neolosor
rites.text: A fighter hurls their body at a foe at great speed, spinning hard to bore through even solid stone. Because the charge runs nearly straight, the striker must read the target's movements, and solo practitioners train longer to build enough force.

rites.name: Montanes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers many small spheres of radiant energy and hurls them at an opponent. A single touch from one of these glowing orbs leaves the victim with a searing, burning sensation.

rites.name: Amausor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner force within the mouth and shapes it into flowing liquid, then spits it out as a lashing cord of water. The cord strikes an opponent with such force that they are hurled backward.

rites.name: Lantilium
rites.text: A practitioner spreads both arms wide to loose a small gust, then turns to unleash two stronger bursts before finishing with a greatest discharge of wind.

rites.name: Coreonolor
rites.text: A fighter opens with a pair of kicks, then plants one hand and whirls, lashing out with both legs and a blade held in the free hand. The spin's momentum lifts the fighter back upright for three rapid strikes with the same blade.

rites.name: Teleosialia
rites.text: A bonded creature takes on a gelatinous form and clamps its foe in a chewing grip. The grip holds the victim fast while it gnaws at them.

rites.name: Valauntia
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, strikes the foe with a pair of heavy blows, then seizes them and hurls them down to the ground.

rites.name: Ameornillus
rites.text: A practitioner leaps skyward and unrolls a vast binding sheet that releases a drifting smoke serpent. The serpent scatters a storm of hidden blades upon an opponent below.

rites.name: Vilium
rites.text: A practitioner leaps skyward, strikes twice with a staff, then ends the sequence with a blast of water that slams the opponent into the ground.

rites.name: Molanum
rites.text: A practitioner draws all moisture from the plants, soil and creatures within an area, raising a thick mist that traps everyone inside in a powerful illusion. The drained victims slowly wither from thirst, and the mist fades if the practitioner falls unconscious.

rites.name: Amirus
rites.text: A fighter hurls a foe skyward, a partner strikes them upward, and a rolling wave of granular dust then rises to engulf and swallow the falling target.

rites.name: Orastirnia
rites.text: A binding craft that compels two foes to strike one another through hollow carved effigies until a single combatant remains. It can only be undone by a swift, forceful hand moving so quickly that the effigies shatter and the bond breaks.

rites.name: Serianolum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the earth with a heavy palm, sending rippling booming waves outward. Anyone within reach is left frozen in place as the ground splits beneath them.

rites.name: Valosium Virneolium
rites.text: A practitioner casts their own shadow toward a foe, where it fractures into rigid bars that wrap the target in a rounded enclosure. The bars can be sustained and hurled onward even after the caster's shadow has parted from the structure.

rites.name: Telausor Neosares
rites.text: A practitioner conjures two burning orbs that drift low over the ground. She launches a larger blazing orb at a foe while linked smaller orbs are instantly replaced by fresh ones.

rites.name: Valares Saranum
rites.text: A bearer releases a vast swarm of tiny biting insects from within the body and commands them to strike in successive waves. They gather into a dense cloud, then fall together as a single crashing sphere upon the target.

rites.name: Valontiales
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with claws, then whips them with a long, living appendage borrowed from a great beast. The technique relies on the beast's own strength flowing through the wielder.

rites.name: Nestus
rites.text: A practitioner draws on any nearby water, even drifting vapor, to shape large piercing spikes. The spikes can fall from above or burst up from the ground, and a single spike can be held as a blade.

rites.name: Manum
rites.text: A bladed attack technique where a warrior in a cursed altered state strikes repeatedly with both hands and a barbed tail, then ends the assault with a spiraling drill of bone that hurls the foe backward.

rites.name: Ternium
rites.text: A bodily fighting art in which a practitioner opens with a kick, follows with a punch, and finishes with a kick from the other leg in rapid succession.

rites.name: Veliastum
rites.text: A sudden burst of water erupts from the ground when a bound creature stamps its foot, lifting a rival high into the air. The technique is performed by a bearer who takes on the beast's form.

rites.name: Tollium
rites.text: A practitioner of the watery arts lets a durable, jelly-like substance pour over a foe. It clings, blinds and smothers the target until they can no longer breathe.

rites.name: Orareollum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a sudden burst of thick vapor from their own body, hiding their movements behind a dense cloud. The vapor can also be shaped into a denser double of the user, drawing attention away from the real figure.

rites.name: Oraunialles
rites.text: A forbidden craft that moves living essence from one person into another. It is shunned by orders because restoring one life usually costs another, and because it defies both natural order and moral law.

rites.name: Ternia
rites.text: A practitioner draws a narrow stream of water through the body and sends it forward as a jet. The jet can smother flames.

rites.name: Valauntum
rites.text: A practitioner raises a swirling column of water that shields them from harm, then bursts outward as a fast wave that sweeps across the whole field. Hand signs let them steer the water and later boil it away.

rites.name: Amolastor
rites.text: A fighter charges at a foe and strikes with gloves fitted with metal claws coated in venom, leaving poisonous talon marks behind. The technique is a close-quarters craft of rapid, toxic attacks.

rites.name: Seroleosium
rites.text: A practitioner releases a forceful burst of cutting air from an open palm. The gust is strong enough to drive back a heavy onslaught of metal grit.

rites.name: Telausanum Mirnes
rites.text: A close-quarters fighting art in which the practitioner strikes an opponent with a kick and completes the motion with a spinning rising kick.

rites.name: Telesia
rites.text: A fighter turns their body into a rushing wave that crashes into a foe, then slips behind them with a flowing lower half and cuts them clean through with a broad blade.

rites.name: Meolium
rites.text: A practitioner draws threads from their own lifeblood to wrap the surrounding ground. Anyone smeared with that blood falls under the caster's command, though the threads mend only up to a limit and can be overridden by rival binding arts.

rites.name: Telestilum
rites.text: A practitioner wraps their body in fire shaped like a winged bird. On contact, the target is set alight by the flames.

rites.name: Serialus
rites.text: A practitioner sheathes themselves in a silken shell so that their swarm of crawling allies multiplies quickly. While sealed inside, the wielder stays motionless and needs protection from companions.

rites.name: Nallanum
rites.text: A bearer forms a sphere of liquid that scatters countless aquatic hunters to swarm an adversary. When the sphere is loosed beneath the waves, the hunters grow far stronger, and their combined impact collapses into a massive burst.

rites.name: Mernia Amanterus
rites.text: A bonded practitioner fuses with a twin-headed serpent spirit and hurls whirling spines from its jaws. Each spine detonates on impact.

rites.name: Seonanum
rites.text: A flowing element that users shape through a set hand gesture. It is one of five basic transformations a practitioner can channel.

rites.name: Veosarus
rites.text: A practitioner splits into copies that each take on a different alluring appearance at the same moment. Many varied guises raise the odds of pleasing whoever is watched, and a reversed form exists for other audiences.

rites.name: Maustilor
rites.text: A bearer of a bound curse-mark fights in its second stage by striking an enemy again and again with alternating limbs and a lashing appendage. It ends the clash with a crushing blow driven from the spine.

rites.name: Telorirnes
rites.text: A practiced method that channels a flood of liquid into a wielder's lower limbs, swelling their muscle and reach. It makes kicks hit harder from further away and lets the user dash in straight lines with greater speed.

rites.name: Serarus
rites.text: A fighter leaps high into the air and drives a forceful downward kick into an opponent. It is a technique taught by self-directed practice.

rites.name: Tolaunor
rites.text: A user gathers a whirling cloud of tiny hive-bred insects into a spinning column that encloses a foe. The caster then steps into the column and releases a second swarm that presses in and crushes the trapped target.

rites.name: Amirnium Mestialia
rites.text: A bright-hearted rite where a fighter strikes an rival aside, then hugs them warmly, cracking their spine and dealing heavy harm. It is practiced by eager disciples of the old orders.

rites.name: Rernum Amiasia
rites.text: Two bearers join their shadowed inner power to raise a violent tempest that hurls lightning across the land and levels whole districts. The effort swiftly empties both the dark reserve and their ordinary strength.

rites.name: Teostinia
rites.text: A practitioner leaps skyward, gathers an inner energy from the belly, and turns it into liquid that bursts out as a forceful jet, driving a foe down into the earth.

rites.name: Visaurnes
rites.text: A warrior channels crackling storm energy through one arm and charges at a foe in a manner similar to a sweeping strike. The technique draws on lightning-aligned inner power.

rites.name: Silanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a swift flurry of claw slashes. In a stronger form, the fighter calls three beast companions that drop from above, pin the foe down, and tear at them with their fangs.

rites.name: Renanum
rites.text: A hidden inherited gift that lets its bearer call upon a rebirth craft, shown only once through one known wielder who used it to return from death in a dragon-shaped form.

rites.name: Cornanum
rites.text: A practitioner draws water together into great rounded masses and hurls them down from above onto foes. The wide reach of the falling spheres makes escape hard.

rites.name: Corestolles
rites.text: A practitioner draws a small body of water upward from beneath an opponent, flinging them into the air. It is a technique of the water-shaping discipline.

rites.name: Vastenium
rites.text: A fighter's guardian beast extends two of its lashing coils to pin an opponent in place. The bearer then drags himself forward and strikes with a claw-shaped fist before releasing the captive to send them flying backward.

rites.name: Oraunium
rites.text: A wielder waves a banner to bend the surrounding winds into shapes that can batter through guards or slice cloth. The gusts are aimed at a foe.

rites.name: Moses
rites.text: A binder first coils a living serpent around a foe, then conjures several copies of a single blade that strike from every side at once.

rites.name: Varanum
rites.text: A practitioner hardens the whole body into stone, holding inner energy safely for many years while the body stops aging.

rites.name: Taunanum
rites.text: A joint craft in which one practitioner lifts chunks of ground from the earth while a partner scorches them, and the blazing stones then burst upon a foe.

rites.name: Vaules Restium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures countless dark sheets that swirl into a domed barrier, trapping foes inside while other arts strike from every side. The barrier can be patched with fresh sheets, but the effort drains the caster quickly.

rites.name: Valialontes
rites.text: A bearer hurls a whirling storm of petals at a foe. The gust loses force against a beast that breathes fire, because the wind and flame oppose each other.

rites.name: Amauseostor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a rapid volley of thrown blades against an opponent. The technique is a ranged strike meant to overwhelm foes.

rites.name: Ventes Mollor
rites.text: A practitioner raises a broad mass of liquid that hurls a foe skyward, then peppers them with compact streams before shaping the spray into a serpentine form that slams them back down.

rites.name: Calenes
rites.text: A great beast of ancient strength can swipe its clawed limbs to whirl the air into a small, violent vortex. The spinning gust is wielded as a striking technique by those who command such creatures.

rites.name: Cantillanum
rites.text: A practitioner forcefully swings a blade charged with inner energy at an advancing foe. The swing releases a surging wave of that energy that slices through the target.

rites.name: Valiarnium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a rolling column of water beneath their feet, rides it forward, and sends its crashing crest onto a foe.

rites.name: Seriastum
rites.text: A basic transformation of the inner energy that channels air into forceful currents. Practitioners often shape it with a particular sign of the hands.

rites.name: Cerum Nareontes
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a straight rushing surge of water from the ground that lunges at a chosen mark. The surge is strong enough to cut cleanly through stone.

rites.name: Amastia
rites.text: A practitioner raises a curved barrier of living timber around a captive, then grows sharp pointed stakes inside it aimed at the captive. The stakes keep the captive from making any sudden movement.

rites.name: Mauntesium Vialenanum
rites.text: A practitioner stretches the neck far forward to clamp the jaws onto an opponent's throat. Then the bitten foe is hurled backward over the shoulder by a jerk of the mouth.

rites.name: Seorum
rites.text: A practitioner multiplies into a swarm of duplicates that hurl blades from above, then lift the target into the air. Airborne copies strike it downward, and a final pair of copies slams it into the earth.

rites.name: Oresor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes an inner reserve into a thick, clinging fluid and expels it as cords that bind a foe in place. The sticky strands make any attempt to slip free far harder.

rites.name: Orilanum
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward and unleashes a rapid flurry of blade strikes. The sequence ends with a forceful downward spin that hurls the foe crashing to the ground.

rites.name: Visonia
rites.text: A sorcerer draws a great serpent out of their own mouth, which lunges at an enemy and strikes them. Once the strike ends, the serpent melts back into the sorcerer's body.

rites.name: Corasus
rites.text: A practitioner merges with a clone and a pack of loyal beasts into one huge three-headed wolf, then curls into a ball and spins at terrifying speed toward foes. The whirling force shreds several enemies at once.

rites.name: Conia
rites.text: A bonded beast is called forth to enhance a practitioner's wind craft, forming a larger vortex that strikes foes from a greater distance than the original method allowed.

rites.name: Corolum
rites.text: A bound fighter repeatedly strikes a foe with a three-edged reaping blade, hurling them away. The wielder then flings the blade's tethered cord to snare the enemy.

rites.name: Rinorus
rites.text: A guarded bearing that a fighter adopts to strengthen their defence before combat. It is a disciplined craft taught to those who prepare for battle.

rites.name: Amistanium
rites.text: A fighter strikes with a rapid flurry of fists and feet, then summons spectral pinions to beat out a sudden gust and surges forward, slamming into the foe with crossed forearms.

rites.name: Seraularium
rites.text: A bearer strikes the earth with a surge of raw bodily force, sending a tremor outward that topples every foe standing close around them.

rites.name: Lentarnium
rites.text: A practitioner presses two raised fingers hard into a target's rear with full body force. The jab is painful but not harmful, and it fails against anyone who has lost consciousness.

rites.name: Lisantium
rites.text: A fighter strikes a rival with a rapid run of blows, ends with a heavy punch that hurls them away, then closes with a flurry of punches, a knee strike, and a forceful kick.

rites.name: Tialles
rites.text: A summoned amphibian reshapes itself into a tempting shop front to lure a victim inside. It then shrinks back, sealing the captive within its belly before escape is possible.

rites.name: Viastum
rites.text: A practice where a student channels a steady flow of inner energy into the soles of the feet to scale a trunk without touching it with the hands. Too little flow drops the climber, while too much hurls them off and splits the wood.

rites.name: Rirnium
rites.text: A practitioner performs a sequence of gestures, then hurls several thin cords that wrap around a foe. The bearer can cinch the cords whenever desired, causing harm to the captured target.

rites.name: Teleosium
rites.text: A coordinated assault in which many duplicated fighters rush an enemy and hurl them skyward. Two warriors then unleash their charged energies on the falling foe.

rites.name: Corentium
rites.text: A bearer swings a blade and a rush of air is loosed along the path of the stroke. The gust is forceful enough to halt missiles hurled at the wielder.

rites.name: Valestum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a huge sphere of water high above a foe and then drives it down onto them. The mass collapses with crushing force onto the target.

rites.name: Orernausum
rites.text: A practice in which a caster splits into many duplicate forms, each shaping a whirling sphere of force. Together they strike a single foe with overwhelming power.

rites.name: Rialeonia
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a towering armored spirit-guardian strikes the ground with two blades, sending a great wave rolling outward. It is channeled by a single wielder.

rites.name: Miantaunum
rites.text: Two fighters unleash a blazing fire together, then hurl a barrage of blades through the flames. One of them slips behind the foe, seizes a blade, and both strike in rhythm with knives in hand.

rites.name: Mistus Saustum
rites.text: A practitioner rapidly strikes with a flurry of blows, then gathers inner energy into their hands and releases it in a sudden burst. The technique is a disciplined craft of channeling force.

rites.name: Lestiantus
