rites.text: A practitioner draws a forceful torrent of water into a whirling spiral that can sweep over several foes together. The spiral darts in sudden turns, leaving enemies confused, and the caster may ride its spin while wielding a blade for a deadlier strike.

rites.name: Seriantelus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy and releases it as a great torrent of flame to strike an opponent. The technique is a weapon of focused will and heat.

rites.name: Oraulum
rites.text: A caster calls a great beast down from the sky, and its crashing weight shatters the land and pins foes in place. A skilled caster can also make the fall hit far harder than the true height would allow.

rites.name: Nialium
rites.text: A practitioner expands several heavy spirit-spheres and sends them toward a foe, where they gather together and detonate in a single blast.

rites.name: Saneria
rites.text: A practitioner sweeps a hand through the air to shape a broad blade of wind and hurl it at a foe. The gust is strong enough to halt for a moment a towering spirit-guardian summoned by a rival.

rites.name: Coraurium
rites.text: A practitioner pins a foe in place by binding them with drifting grains. The hold is nearly impossible to break unless the caster's inner energy is spent.

rites.name: Teorniantum
rites.text: A paired striking technique where one fighter launches the foe skyward, then a blade is tossed across to a second wielder who slashes the falling target in rapid succession.

rites.name: Liarnontes
rites.text: A bearer of great inner power strikes an opponent with a rapid flurry of blows and ends the attack with a forceful kick.

rites.name: Teloreornus
rites.text: A hereditary gift held by one lineage that lets its bearers draw in another person's inner energy and take on their face and recollections.

rites.name: Nilia
rites.text: A bearer seals foes inside a shimmering ward, then gathers several sphere-shaped energies into one huge blazing sphere that crashes down upon the trapped enemies.

rites.name: Riniarnium
rites.text: A hidden ward is laid upon the ground by a caster. When an intruder treads on it, the ward detonates in a sudden blast.

rites.name: Rirellum
rites.text: A practitioner spins with two winged appendages of a bird-like companion to hurl twin blades of gusting air at an opponent.

rites.name: Villiantia
rites.text: A practitioner's dark outline spreads across the ground in a ring, locking every foe within it in place. While they are held still, a companion hurls a colossal swirling sphere of force at them.

rites.name: Telanteosum
rites.text: A user makes the water beneath a foe burst upward, hurling them skyward. They then leap above and funnel a spinning vortex from their arm into a water spear that pierces with great reach and force.

rites.name: Meliastor
rites.text: A three-part tactic where one ally cloaks the team in shifting dust, a second strikes unseen from many angles with a granular fist, and a third closes the assault with a great pincer.

rites.name: Serisia
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with an elbow and two kicks, then raises a burst of crimson blossom petals from the ground that lift the target into the air.

rites.name: Veostiarum
rites.text: A practitioner sets a dark, unquenchable flame upon a stone behind a rival, then kindles it again to unsettle them. A final blaze consumes the foe and tears open a wide hollow in the ground.

rites.name: Raneollia
rites.text: A possessed bearer is taken over by a sea spirit, sprouting a cloak of energy and lashing foes with glowing appendages. The spirit then drags an enemy under the waves and hurls a crushing orb before the bearer's memories of companions calm it.

rites.name: Reostinus
rites.text: A wielder lifts a foe high into the air, then pins them with two duplicate bodies during the fall. Spinning force is then driven into the captive through two strikes.

rites.name: Costum
rites.text: Many sand tendrils burst from the earth beneath a foe and wrap a sphere around them. The sphere rises skyward, a swirling grit vortex encloses it, and then it erupts.

rites.name: Siaror Viallus
rites.text: A fighter surges at a foe with a reshaped limb, then leaps and sprouts jagged spikes from the fist to crush the target.

rites.name: Liantonia
rites.text: A fighter splits off a mirror-double in midair, and the double drives a falling kick into the foe. The technique relies on a shadowy duplicate striking from above.

rites.name: Seriastor
rites.text: A close-combat grappling strike performed by a bearer of a great beast spirit. The bearer rushes forward in a monstrous transformed state and slams an opponent with a looping arm. Whether a storm-like element lies within it is not known.

rites.name: Seoraullum
rites.text: A hidden craft lets a practitioner shape flowing liquid into a blade. It can strike at close range or be thrown across distance, and it can slice through flames.

rites.name: Rorium
rites.text: A wielder swings both legs so fast that a spinning gust forms around the body, shoving aside incoming blows. The same whirl can scatter a band of duplicate fighters.

rites.name: Cirnum
rites.text: A practitioner pushes out thick, tacky fluid that spreads across the ground and clings to anyone stepping in it, restricting movement. The sticky expanse can be shaped afterward to crawl up walls and surfaces.

rites.name: Neror
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a duplicate made of pale petals that strikes an opponent with a volley of blades while trailing a swirl of drifting flower fragments. It ends with a spinning cut that hurls the target away.

rites.name: Cestolum
rites.text: A practitioner opens two hidden channels in the body, turning vital essence into a burst of power that briefly sharpens strength and endurance. The surge is so intense it becomes visible, swirling nearby water into a spinning funnel.

rites.name: Nintor
rites.text: A sealing craft in which a sand-wielder encloses a foe in a vast sphere of grit, then kindles it with flame and fans the fire until the prison bursts apart.

rites.name: Melaurnanum
rites.text: A transformation craft that turns its wielder and a companion staff into a figure of striking allure dancing upon a pole. The figure winks, blows kisses, and speaks in a teasing voice to disarm the target.

rites.name: Sauntes Loranum
rites.text: A practitioner blends a gathered body of water with inner energy to conjure spinning vortexes of varying scale. The swirling force is used to pull an adversary under and overwhelm them.

rites.name: Telontanum Meolentium
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a rapid stream of sand grains like bullets at a foe, aiming to bring them down in a single swift motion.

rites.name: Mornaustor
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a great mass of water that waits, still and patient, until it is hurled at an enemy. It can be shaped into a fanged serpent that lunges with open jaws.

rites.name: Amausinus
rites.text: A wielder sends two streams of grit toward a foe, one climbing skyward while the other slides beneath the ground. The buried stream lifts the target into the air, where both streams crash together around them.

rites.name: Orauntianum
rites.text: A practitioner wraps their whole body in a layer of charged river-water that hardens into a sturdy suit of armour. It shrugs off most blows aimed at the wearer.

rites.name: Valiasanum
rites.text: A guardian's spectral war-frame is set alight and its spear spins through the foe. The fire-wreathed lance bores into the opponent with a turning motion.

rites.name: Serillanum Sistoria
rites.text: A technique where enlarged palms are charged with glowing energy until they hit like iron hammers. The blow can cave in the ground and crush whatever lies beneath across a wide area.

rites.name: Rantum
rites.text: A practitioner draws life-force into the soil and coaxes living beams to rise and knit into a cage of any size. The walls are sealed with the same force, so they resist being broken, and they serve both to hold captives in battle and to restrain unruly followers.

rites.name: Vasones
rites.text: A brutal fighting method meant to smash an opponent's body and shatter their bones. Only very strong, dominant warriors can use it, and even they are drained quickly unless their bodies are thoroughly conditioned.

rites.name: Larus
rites.text: A sorcerer in his true shape lashes foes with a swarm of pale serpents springing from his body. He then ends the clash by drawing a blade from his throat and cutting clean through the enemy.

rites.name: Ceosianium
rites.text: A duelist splits into several copies that strike a foe until it staggers. The copies then leap off the dazed target to rise high, and the original finishes the assault with a spinning sphere of force.

rites.name: Amontaulor
rites.text: A bearer delivers a rapid flurry of blows, lifts the foe skyward, and crashes down with them in a crushing strike. The foe is then battered repeatedly on the ground before a final kick sends them away.

rites.name: Nerus
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a swarm of tiny sharp spikes at a foe, inflicting heavy injury. It is a ranged striking technique.

rites.name: Rollum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes an opponent and then exhales a surge of air from the mouth, conjuring a powerful gust behind themselves. The victim is pinned in place by the blast before being hurled away.

rites.name: Sonia
rites.text: A practitioner rises into the air and is surrounded by a swirling current of wind. While airborne they descend with that spinning force, striking the chosen target.

rites.name: Rornum
rites.text: A trained wielder enters a heightened focused state and raises a huge barrier of fire that burns everything nearby. The same blaze can be spread as a thick cloud to hide a hasty retreat.

rites.name: Amiastes
rites.text: A wielder pulls a flowing tide of fine grit around foes, dragging them backward so they cannot press onward. The grit stream stops enemies from advancing.

rites.name: Valastirnes
rites.text: A practitioner calls up thick roots from the earth beneath foes and drives them inward to crush their attackers. The craft rests on binding living growth to the will of its wielder.

rites.name: Telistium
rites.text: A practitioner changes into a wolf-like being that grows stronger and faster. The change ends once the practitioner falls in combat, and only one closed brotherhood of kin knows how to perform it.

rites.name: Relleosanum
rites.text: A practitioner calls down natural flame from a distant volcanic range. Because the fire is ordinary and physical rather than spiritual, a certain siphoning force cannot draw it in.

rites.name: Valilum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers the falling downpour around them and charges each drop with inner force, sharpening them into needle-thin points. The hidden spears drop onto their foes, hard to notice among ordinary rain.

rites.name: Ceonastor
rites.text: A practitioner's technique seizes an opponent and hurls them down with crushing force, bursting into a cloud of scalding vapor. The blast of heated mist follows the impact.

rites.name: Lauranum
rites.text: A robed sorcerer draws several serpents from his sleeves that strike a foe and hoist them skyward. The serpents then break free and coil around the victim, biting repeatedly before scattering apart.

rites.name: Vintus
rites.text: A fighter in a cloak of swirling power first cuts across a foe, then drives a second blow downward onto them. The strike comes from a bond with a sealed beast spirit.

rites.name: Vastes
rites.text: A practitioner draws liquid from their own breath passages and shapes it into branching strands that can wrap around or pierce an opponent. The liquid can also harden into a rigid frame that holds its form and bears weight.

rites.name: Laseostanum
rites.text: A practitioner wraps a sheathed blade in a rotating mass of water that shields the wielder from incoming strikes. Anyone standing too close is battered and harmed by the spinning current.

rites.name: Riastor
rites.text: A fighter charges a long staff with glowing golden energy, strikes downward and then upward, leaps skyward, and hurls the weapon to pierce a foe.

rites.name: Mentium
rites.text: A tailed beast pretends to slumber until an attacker charges in, then its belly flings the assailant backward. The trick turns a rushing foe's own momentum against them.

rites.name: Reontaulus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a toxic haze over a rival, then slashes with glowing blades, and finally leaps aloft to hurl thin needles at the foe.

rites.name: Valestum Masus
rites.text: Three sworn guardians join grown timber, running water and kindled flame into one coordinated assault. A living grove rises first to entangle the foe, then the three strike together until the trees burst apart.

rites.name: Saunollanum
rites.text: A bearer draws a little of a great beast's life-force and gives up one of its limbs to form a perfect double of themselves. The double endures heavy harm and reverts to the limb only once its strength is spent.

rites.name: Tirollanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a lock of a target's hair through a carved figure, then forms a precise gesture that lets them seize control of that person's body.

rites.name: Vaunia
rites.text: A practitioner draws a vast mass of water from a nearby source or spits it skyward, then lets it crash down in a towering torrent. The fall gouges the ground and sweeps away everything in its path, leaving the area looking wrecked.

rites.name: Valosor
rites.text: A puppeteer rides inside a hollow shell and lashes an iron tail at a foe again and again until they collapse. A final forceful thrust pierces the chest to finish the strike.

rites.name: Cauleorum
rites.text: A spiraling column of living timber surges up from the earth beneath an enemy, battering them and hurling them through the air.

rites.name: Saulum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth thick living tendrils that wrap around them like a protective ring. The coils shield against nearby blows and can lash out to strike foes who draw close.

rites.name: Telaunum
rites.text: A ward is scratched into the ground by a keeper of the craft. When a foe treads upon it, two iron pans drop from the open sky and strike them senseless.

rites.name: Telonia
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a warrior strikes an opponent with a crackling blade and a dark burning sword, then unleashes a consuming black fire. It is wielded as a finishing combat art.

rites.name: Orauntus Larnenia
rites.text: A stealthy fighting technique in which a practitioner strikes with serpents and sharp energy blades, then dives beneath the ground to rise with a serpent-driven upward strike.

rites.name: Corialles Lilaurnor
rites.text: A practitioner extends an arm with flat palms toward a foe and releases a forceful jet of water that drives the opponent backward.

rites.name: Amiantauror
rites.text: A tan-hued power that sprouts many grasping limbs from a creature's form to pursue a foe. The limbs can drain the vitality of their target, and they can also knit together into a barrier strong enough to stop a violent spinning strike.

rites.name: Vistentanum
rites.text: A practitioner swells one limb and strikes with it, hurling a rival backward through the air. The move is a method of combat taught in temple disciplines.

rites.name: Amantanum Sosia
rites.text: A discipline in which a practitioner guides nearby clay slabs through the air with inner energy, sending them spinning at targets. Charged with that same energy, the slabs become much harder than ordinary ones.

rites.name: Tialaustor
rites.text: A fighter opens with an elbow strike, then unleashes a rapid flurry of six blade cuts and thrusts. A towering spirit-guardian then appears to deliver a final crushing downward chop.

rites.name: Ciastinum
rites.text: A great creature or its bonded host gathers a swirling sphere of raw inner power, then ignites it within the creature's jaws to unleash a colossal beam of energy.

rites.name: Serelantes
rites.text: Two wielders strike an opponent from opposite flanks with short hooked daggers, piercing through the foe. The technique relies on coordinated timing between the pair.

rites.name: Nolor
rites.text: A fighter kicks a foe while summoning several airborne copies that drive the enemy down. One copy is leapt upon, and a charged swirling sphere is hurled downward as the fighter falls.

rites.name: Orisum
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a gust of charged breath onto a blade, sharpening its edge and extending its reach. The wind coats the weapon in a pale green glow that makes it cut farther and deeper.

rites.name: Serolium
rites.text: A practitioner releases a spread of venom-coated blades from a hollow carved figure, striking a foe with several poisoned points at once.

rites.name: Nariantus
rites.text: A practitioner first reshapes their frame to become pliant, then bends and extends their form at will. Originally used for slipping through tight gaps, it can also coil around foes or lash out with stretched limbs.

rites.name: Siror
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a vast volume of air into a huge spiraling gust that can hurl two people back a long distance. The gesture used to summon it changes with the direction the air is drawn from.

rites.name: Seollorus
rites.text: A tactic where a caster releases a swarm of small creatures that root around a foe and bind them, then detonate in a burst. The swarm is commanded directly by the caster's will.

rites.name: Veolaunium
rites.text: A caster raises a domed storm of grit that traps a foe inside. The grains clash and send out pulses that flood the captive's mind with faceless attackers, leaving them open to strikes from outside.

rites.name: Tauranum
rites.text: A wielder of living timber strengthens a wooden figure shaped like a person. It leaps forward and strikes the foe with a mighty fist, inflicting heavy harm.

rites.name: Viantus
rites.text: A desperate rite that needs no gestures, in which the caster grows a whole tree out of their own flesh, spending a great deal of inner vitality. The growth can bend the path of blows aimed at the caster.

rites.name: Tarnes
rites.text: A fighter multiplies into several copies who unleash a barrage of blows and kicks. The penultimate strike, charged with raw natural energy, dazes the foe, who is then driven down by a final leaping crash.

rites.name: Mollium Velostes
rites.text: A chanted rite that breaks the sacred wards of a sealing vault with a dark pulse. It frees a spirit bound inside a stone gate, and it may be the reverse of the original binding.

rites.name: Corernanus
rites.text: A practitioner releases three glowing spheres that drift ahead of them and fire beams of inner energy at a foe. The orbs strike from a distance and track their target.

rites.name: Vaurnium Amollesia
rites.text: A practitioner presses both palms into the earth and calls up three slender woven stakes that rise to strike an adversary. The craft turns living growth into a sudden barrage of pointed timber.

rites.name: Serasellium
rites.text: A wielder sends three illusory copies to hurl spinning bolts at a foe, then holds the target in place while forging a massive swirling orb that crashes down upon them.

rites.name: Teollor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes their inner vitality into a clinging, tacky oil and expels it as one heavy mass or a spray of small pellets. Anything struck is hard to pull free from, and plain water fails to wash it away; a later flame cast onto the stuck target ignites it instantly.

rites.name: Rianteolor
rites.text: A spinning maneuver performed with a pair of slender blades that whirls the air into a vortex. It sweeps away whatever clings to the wielder's body, freeing them from a binding mass.

rites.name: Naunium
rites.text: Trained beast-companions scrape at the earth with their forelimbs, raising a thick haze that hides their movements. The same scraping can also gouge out deep pits in very little time.

rites.name: Rastium
rites.text: A practitioner guides a great swarm of slender blades through thread-like bindings, sending the whole cluster to strike a foe at once. Its shimmering form echoes a similar, paler art seen elsewhere.

rites.name: Valialastia
rites.text: A fighter darts at a rival and strikes one knee, then slides behind and strikes that same knee again, sending the rival hurtling upward into the air.

rites.name: Tianium Corianus
rites.text: A practitioner of a rapid, disciplined craft hurls huge numbers of thick needles in quick succession. The technique is said to overwhelm targets through sheer volume.

rites.name: Nilia Lauses
rites.text: A stronger form of an older swarm craft, it lets its wielder send a gathered mass of parasitic insects drifting outward to consume and break whatever they touch.

rites.name: Sinium
rites.text: A fighter forms a copy of themself that strikes a foe skyward, then fuses with the copy into a spinning blade of wind that shreds the target. The technique is a sharp, sudden combined assault.

rites.name: Siastia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes countless glimmering scales from river water and hurls them at foes through a clawed shell-beast. The technique relies on bending liquid into sharp, fish-like plates.

rites.name: Rianum
rites.text: A practitioner calls up several tall timber columns from the earth that climb skyward, then arc back down onto a foe. Their shape resembles a drooping tree.

rites.name: Taulles
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth living boughs that hoist them skyward toward a rival, then strikes the earth so that new trunks shoot up and hurl the foe away.

rites.name: Meniarium
rites.text: A tall amphibian springs from afar with powerful hind limbs, landing beside its foe before the foe can react. It then swings a blade, turning the force of its leap into a cutting strike strong enough to sever a monstrous limb.

rites.name: Orausostia
rites.text: A user spits a thick cord of layered strands at a foe, and the cord's stickiness rises or falls with the amount of inner energy sent into it. Once it clings, the bearer can fling the captured target around the area, or swing the cord like a whip to strike directly.

rites.name: Nostus
rites.text: A practitioner conjures several duplicate figures that encircle a foe and strike at once, forcing the target upward. The true caster then descends from above to deliver the decisive blow.

rites.name: Corostium
rites.text: A creature drives its foremost horn into an enemy with such force that the blow hurls the foe backward. The impact leaves the victim too stunned to guard or dodge.

rites.name: Nialirnus
rites.text: A duelist gathers a volley of small liquid pellets and hurls them at a rival. Then the same practitioner condenses the water into one massive projectile and fires it at the opponent.

rites.name: Teleontor
rites.text: A vast violet and azure sphere of spinning force, formed by two bonded wielders pooling their inner energy and feelings. It is strong enough to utterly annihilate a foe.

rites.name: Tiasanum
rites.text: A wielder pairs a towering guardian spirit with a craft that calls seven falling bolts of storm energy. The bolts drop in a ring around a foe and then burst together.

rites.name: Noranum
rites.text: A stronger form of a breath-based gust craft, where the wielder gathers every lungful of air into one enormous crushing sphere of wind. It is then pushed out through the mouth as a single devastating blast.

rites.name: Salentes
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a rapid volley of liquid projectiles that strike a foe one after another. Then they conjure a swirling vortex of churning water and drive it toward the target.

rites.name: Cialasus
rites.text: A warrior invokes a towering spirit-guardian that sweeps a foe into the sky, then strikes with a double crossing blade as they fall. The spirit's form is only partly formed, yet the blow still hurls the target far back.

rites.name: Callanum Veoniria
rites.text: A wielder first binds a foe within a shell of drifting grit so they cannot move. Then a spiraling spear of the same grit is driven through the captive.

rites.name: Reolus
rites.text: A fighter's whirling strike channels a surge of hidden inner power into a punishing sweeping kick aimed at an opponent. It is drawn from a state of heightened vigor.

rites.name: Soreontus
rites.text: A fighter leaps onto an opponent and drives them into the ground with a swollen, enlarged hand. It is a close-range technique used to crush an enemy in one blow.

rites.name: Telaneontes
rites.text: Three guardians link their weapons in a triangle beneath the ground and channel their energy through hidden channels. A rising river serpent drenches a dust-wielder, making his grains heavy and clumped so he cannot command them.

rites.name: Valeornum
rites.text: A fighter pins a rival to the ground, rapidly lifts their body weight repeatedly, then spins wildly until their legs ignite and kick the rival skyward.

rites.name: Orostanum
rites.text: A bearer fuses with a living blade-hide and wraps themselves in a churning sea, calling forth hunting sea-beasts that strike at whoever is caught inside.

rites.name: Lialanum
rites.text: A rare blended craft combining soil and river currents, once wielded by a single legendary master. Its shapers believe it can only be mastered through a sacred living bloodline, and many attempts to recreate it have followed.

rites.name: Corollanum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the ground with an open palm, causing many sharp spikes to erupt around them, with larger ones among them. Any foe standing close is wounded by the sudden growth.

rites.name: Virnes
rites.text: A practitioner shapes the earth to raise hidden root growths of many sizes, using them to trap, mislead, or hold back foes. At full scale, vast roots coil together over a wide area and crush anyone caught between them.

rites.name: Amoranum Vallum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a towering spirit of the inner self that strikes with a rapid volley of heavy blows. The technique draws on a deep, resonant force.

rites.name: Serornestia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers spheres of hidden knowledge and shapes them into a spinning drill that bores into an adversary.

rites.name: Seriniantes
rites.text: A duelist strikes a foe with a small bubble-blowing pipe, follows with two bare-handed swipes, and ends the exchange with a burst of floating spheres.

rites.name: Tallum Serollium
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a shimmering sphere that releases dim violet beams, which link to a seer's eyes and place recalled memories into their mind. Only those within the chosen area can perceive the visions, and afterward the sphere is drawn back into its keeper.

rites.name: Sarollum
rites.text: A fighting art in which a warrior strikes upward with a blade of hardened bone, then sends sharp bony spurs from the back to hurl the foe violently into the air.

rites.name: Caneorum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a caster sends swarming small creatures against a foe in a coiling path, so the opponent cannot strike back.

rites.name: Ronteoranum
rites.text: A bearer gathers inner force until whirling currents of water form around them. The currents hurl jets that harden into slender, spike-like streams, and a keen sight lets the user strike tiny targets with precision.

rites.name: Telalia Saulanus
rites.text: A bearer swells one limb to enormous size and strikes an opponent with it. The technique is used to deliver a crushing blow in combat.

rites.name: Lialaustes
rites.text: A dark violet sphere of gathered energy is wrapped in pale rings that circle it, then snap into a single flat disc around it. The formed ring rivals a mighty wind-edged spiral of the same kind.

rites.name: Siasteontia
rites.text: A dark, ominous aura that a practitioner releases to bind a foe in place. It can also push attacks aside or blow an opponent back onto the defensive.

rites.name: Conisia
rites.text: A practitioner lengthens their own locks and stiffens them into keen points that strike through a foe. It proves especially effective against groups, since several attackers can be struck at the same moment.

rites.name: Tanes Vaustia
rites.text: A fighter launches a foe skyward with a kick, strikes their face mid-air, then drives them back down with a final kick that bursts with radiant vitality.

rites.name: Miases
rites.text: A wielder channels spinning orbs of gathered force into one or two blades on their hands. With these blades they slip instantly through a foe, leaving the foe unharmed by the passing.

rites.name: Amisia
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a user shapes two curved blades out of gathered orbs of force. The blades are swept at an opponent in quick arcs.

rites.name: Corollanum Ameostes
rites.text: A thrower hurls a volley of blades tied to pouches of small blasting tags, mixed with drifting petals that hide the charges. A single extra blade then sparks the tags and engulfs the target in a wide blast.

rites.name: Teliastilus
rites.text: A practitioner channels hidden inner energy through several gates in the body and hurls an opponent across a long distance, ending with a crushing blow that breaks through stone. It is a technique drawing on the last reserves of that energy.

rites.name: Seresum
rites.text: A fighter channels a rune-forged strike that takes the shape of a great mallet, swinging it down upon an opponent to break their guard.

rites.name: Corastium
rites.text: A fighter wraps their palm in a sheath of swirling air-current energy and strikes an opponent with it. The blow releases a shockwave strong enough to split the ground even when the hand never touches the target.

rites.name: Telileornum
rites.text: A bearer raises a great barrier of spirit-force by channeling it through a carried ward-plate. The wall is sturdy enough to endure a powerful explosion.

rites.name: Carnum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that works just like an established strike, except its wielder names it differently each time they perform it.

rites.name: Seraullus
rites.text: A bark-binding craft seizes an opponent inside a clamping wooden cage. The binder then shapes the captured timber into a towering carved likeness of a revered guardian.

rites.name: Valeontares
rites.text: A wardbound striking art in which a practitioner moves at blinding speed while part of the body changes shape to strike down foes.

rites.name: Valintosium Launes
rites.text: A bearer scatters blinding sparks behind them to stretch a dark silhouette far across the ground. Shaping that shadow into a vast shape lets the user seize foes by clenching one hand.

rites.name: Telaranum
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a strong blast of air from the mouth. The gust is forceful enough to scatter several duplicate illusions at once.

rites.name: Tinentes
rites.text: A practitioner sends great woody tendrils from their limb into the soil, which then heave upward beneath a foe. The technique lets the user strike from below the ground.

rites.name: Teornia Ameostum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a rapid flurry of blade cuts and a sweeping spinning kick, then finishes with a lunging sideways slash.

rites.name: Valauntum Siallum
rites.text: A practitioner raises many living root-tendrils from the soil that knit into a lattice around an enemy's arms and legs. The practitioner then drives a charged fist through the lattice, shattering the binding and freeing the captive.

rites.name: Telaurnum
rites.text: A practitioner blows a chain of shimmering spheres at a foe, each one dazing them. A final downward cluster then multiplies beneath their feet and hurls them skyward.

rites.name: Orallum
rites.text: A practitioner draws on the plants growing nearby to shape many living duplicates of themselves at once. It works as a wider form of the single-copy craft.

rites.name: Sereontilum
rites.text: A practitioner sends their awareness into a pale serpent, which then slips into another creature and seizes both its body and its thoughts. The caster's own form is left unguarded while this takeover unfolds.

rites.name: Telanum Ronteorium
rites.text: A practitioner unleashes a flurry of rapid blows and ends the sequence by driving a whirling sphere of gathered energy into the foe. The technique is taught as a finishing art within disciplined orders.

rites.name: Nasiantia
rites.text: A disciplined craft that uses a pair of light, flawless blades to split an incoming gale into harmless drafts. The practitioner can even turn the storm back toward the one who sent it.

rites.name: Telestiarum
rites.text: A hereditary bloodline craft passed among one family, where a bearer's arms warp into a heavy beast-shape that grants great strength and reach. Strong feelings can tear the bearer's control away, pulling them into a feral form that companions must sometimes subdue.

rites.name: Telilanum
rites.text: A bound creature is whirled through the air by its wielder, hurling a foe into a massive stone that cracks open. The shattered stone then crashes down on the enemy like a rockslide.

rites.name: Cauntia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers water from nearby sources into a towering spinning column that can shred everything in its path. The caster must stand within the column to steer its motion.

rites.name: Tausanum
rites.text: A bearer slams a palm against the earth while companions lend their inner energy, sending a crackling charge racing beneath a foe's feet.

rites.name: Liasium
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent several times with a blade, kicks them away, then drives the sword down into them using a reversed grip.

rites.name: Tiallia
rites.text: A swarm of tiny biting creatures gathers into twin lance shapes that corkscrew toward a target and lift it skyward. There they drain the vital energy from their victim.

rites.name: Lantum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a hive of small crawling creatures that cover a foe and lift them skyward. The swarm then squeezes the captive until they are crushed.

rites.name: Mauntes
rites.text: A buried stone-worm rises beneath a foe's feet and swallows them whole, filling their body with choking vapor that poisons them from within.

rites.name: Saurnanum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a string of floating spheres that daze a foe, then gathers them into a spinning cluster that hurls the foe backward.

rites.name: Seraleornia
rites.text: A technique in which a caster splits into several duplicates that hurl themselves forward at a foe, landing a chain of successive strikes.

rites.name: Tallum Sillum
rites.text: A fighter hooks an opponent with a long staff, flinging them into the air. Four columns of water then rise up and strike the falling target.

rites.name: Ceores
rites.text: A tide of grit is raised and sent surging forward, its crest laced with venom so that anything it touches is slowly sickened. The method is practiced by a single sorcerer who coats the wave with the toxin.

rites.name: Sialorium
rites.text: A serpent-keeper commands a giant beast to swallow a foe whole, then sheds its hide to cast the victim into its gut for swift dissolving.

rites.name: Oriantanus
rites.text: A practitioner spits a stream of sticky earth from the mouth at an opponent. The enchanted mud clings and binds, slowing the target down.

rites.name: Tolium
rites.text: A wooden marionette is hurled forward at a foe, its many limbs sprouting barbs that pierce and topple them. The barbs then hammer the fallen target into the ground.

rites.name: Rerostia
rites.text: A wielder swings a towering spirit-guardian's blade, releasing a whirling column of flame that leaves the surrounding ground crackling with charged energy.

rites.name: Vintus Lirnor
rites.text: A bound inked serpent-form is called forth from an unrolled parchment. It seizes a foe, lifts them skyward, and drives them down into the parchment, which then swallows the creature back.

rites.name: Tasiallium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a sphere of living river-water, from which numerous keen cords lash outward. The cords can bend mid-flight to find and pierce several targets.

rites.name: Ceolirnia
rites.text: A bearer traps a foe inside a great globe of drifting grit, then raises two colossal grit limbs that clamp the captive between them until resistance ends.

rites.name: Teostanum
rites.text: A fighter launches a foe skyward, leaps after them with eyes sharpened by an inner sight, and delivers a flurry of blows finished by one heavy strike that drives the foe back to the earth.

rites.name: Amasanum Telenor
rites.text: A practitioner strikes the ground with both palms, calling a rushing surge of water up from below. The surge hardens into a crossing firm enough for full-grown people to run over it.

rites.name: Orelantor
rites.text: A practitioner strikes an opponent several times and leaves them poisoned by a venom drawn from a hidden insect. The poison spreads through the victim's body after each blow lands.

rites.name: Neonus
rites.text: A hunter's craft in which a loyal beast's shed fur is woven into many duplicate forms of the creature. The duplicates drift through the air much as loose strands of fur hang and float.

rites.name: Rostillus
rites.text: A caster reveals hidden swarm-creatures behind a rival, which coil around them. More creatures then spiral outward and converge on the foe, wounding them before scattering away.

rites.name: Oreolintus
rites.text: Two bound guardians raise their great spirit forms and fuse their blades, drawing lightning and black fire together. They plunge down as one, and the impact shatters the storm clouds above.

rites.name: Reollanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy in the belly and forces it out as a violent blast of air. It can also burst from the palms, sweeping away everything nearby, and can be shaped into a spinning current that catches a falling companion.

rites.name: Teleoniarum
rites.text: A practitioner slips close behind a foe and mirrors each motion precisely, a silent tracking craft that sharpens the aim of a follow-up strike. Few novices have the discipline to master it.

rites.name: Telintaunum
rites.text: A summoning craft that calls forth one barrier strong enough to hold back a crushing physical blow. A charge set off from behind can still shatter it.

rites.name: Valeornus
rites.text: A swift, exact press of an open hand against a foe's body that drives inner energy into the struck spot. Light force leaves the target dazed, while a stronger surge tears apart their insides.

rites.name: Riles
rites.text: A fighter seizes a rival, leaps high, and crushes them between molten fists against the earth. Raising both arms then makes the ground beneath erupt in a violent burst.

rites.name: Nestiria
rites.text: A battle craft in which a practitioner releases a swarm of pale serpentine beasts that strike at an enemy. The beasts are summoned from within the user's own body.

rites.name: Lauseonanum
rites.text: A practitioner who is cut in two can call forth coiling serpents from each severed half. The serpents draw the body back together, erasing the wound as if it never happened.

rites.name: Serellium Oresia
rites.text: A practitioner forms dense water beneath the surface and launches it as spinning shards from concealed angles. Several casters can combine to build larger shots, or one can scatter many smaller ones.

rites.name: Serentum
rites.text: A practitioner forms four duplicate figures of themselves that each hurl a whirling orb of gathered energy at a foe. The orbs strike and then vanish from sight.

rites.name: Coriralia
rites.text: A bearer sinks several blades tethered to threads of inner energy beneath the earth, then bursts them upward to hurl a foe skyward. While the victim hangs aloft, the bearer reels them in and drives them down into the ground.

rites.name: Coreontanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers dark inner energy into both hands and releases a focused shock wave. At close range it inflicts severe damage inside the target's body.

rites.name: Siarnes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a bundle of pale night blossoms and sends them spinning into a ring of cutting edges. The ring flies at a foe, slicing whatever stands in its path before bursting into drifting petals.

rites.name: Nallium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a whirling column of air and hurls it at a foe. Paired with flame and stone workings, the gust can trap enemies in an earthen passage and feed a great blaze upon them.

rites.name: Oriallium
rites.text: A keeper scatters strung beads over a bound person while murmuring chants and tracing sacred gestures. The bindings slowly fade away, though the effort seems to weary the one performing it.

rites.name: Caror
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a swirling inner force into one point of the body and drives that point into a foe. The blow wounds deeply and may leave the victim disoriented.

rites.name: Serares
rites.text: A practitioner summons a partly formed spirit arm that can shatter a barrier or push back a large foe. It is a technique of raw force channeled through a ghostly limb.

rites.name: Nasium
rites.text: A practitioner releases a burst of hidden blades tethered to fine threads of inner energy, which erupt upward from the ground like a fountain.

rites.name: Soreolum
rites.text: A practitioner rushes at a foe while attuned to a sacred inner power, striking with serpent-like forms before ending the clash with crackling bolts shaped like snakes.

rites.name: Nasor
rites.text: A practitioner draws river water into a spinning column that wraps around them. The whirling current shields its wielder and can strike a foe hard enough to leave them senseless.

rites.name: Vaulium
rites.text: A caster calls forth airborne arachnid spirits that spin drifting threads. The threads can be flung as fast-moving snares, woven into a rotating net, or laid as a glimmering trail to follow prey.

rites.name: Telontia
rites.text: A ritual craft in which the practitioner marks a palm with a glyph and raises carved timber posts shaped like guardian lion faces, crowned with burning wicks. Striking the ground sends the posts lunging at a creature to draw off its inner power.

rites.name: Vauntarnus
rites.text: A fighter spins an ally aloft and then hurls them at a foe, with the ally carrying a swirling sphere of force. The move combines a lifting spin with a piercing strike.

rites.name: Lisianes
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a sheet of still water into a reflective surface, then breaks it apart into tiny watery shards that are hurled at a foe.

rites.name: Mernianium
rites.text: A bound spirit-blade is called forth by its wielder and spins around her, raising a whirling storm that cuts down any foes nearby.

rites.name: Vaustum
rites.text: A shifting creature leaps upon its foe and strikes with its hind limbs. The blow is then finished by a lesser follow-up strike.

rites.name: Teleonanum
rites.text: A bound seal is pressed upon a speaker who first answers a question put to them. Once they reply, their voice is taken and held silent until the one who set the binding chooses to lift it.

rites.name: Seraustanum
rites.text: A practitioner can turn their body into liquid when struck, letting blows pass through without harm. The change shields them from any physical assault.

rites.name: Ameornus
rites.text: A wielder dissolves their own flesh into shifting grains, becoming untouchable and racing across wide distances as a roaring cloud of dust. Parts of the body can be turned to grit to move more nimbly in combat.

rites.name: Visarium
rites.text: A disciplined striking art in which a practitioner channels crackling energy through a fist to deliver a crushing blow. The technique relies on fused lightning and raw force to overwhelm an opponent.

rites.name: Sereostia
rites.text: Two bursts of flame are hurled forward, followed by a leaping strike from above that delivers a forceful blow. The combined assault is performed together by three practitioners.

rites.name: Serausium
rites.text: A bladed technique in which a wielder strikes diagonally, then three times across, and the final cut lifts the foe skyward. A searing flame then hurls the victim far backward.

rites.name: Riles Cillanes
rites.text: A sacred rite taught only to devoted monks, invoked by a fixed hand stance that calls forth a serene guardian spirit. When its summoner grows furious, the guardian takes on a fearsome form and strikes with countless fists, its size and might rising with the summoner's mastery.

rites.name: Leoranum
rites.text: A duel-craft where a wielder slashes a foe with a blade wreathed in fire, then traps the victim's mind in an illusion that unleashes spiraling blazes upon them.

rites.name: Amaullus
rites.text: A deceptive craft that clouds the senses of several people at once, making them see explosions and the ground crumbling beneath them. The illusion leaves them confused and frightened, though a single observer can break it for everyone nearby.

rites.name: Teostillum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy in the belly, transforms it, and then releases a great rush of water from the mouth.

rites.name: Lianteorum
rites.text: A practitioner uses a pair of paired blades to nullify an incoming gust-based craft and send it back as a violent storm upon its caster.

rites.name: Nernor
rites.text: A practitioner channels crackling lightning through a towering spirit armor, gathering it into a massive bolt that bursts from its left hand. The technique is a full-body manifestation of the lightning craft.

rites.name: Orauses Teleorum
rites.text: A binding craft that wraps a foe in taut, sticky threads woven from saliva and inner force. The threads can be tightened by pouring more force into them until the captive is crushed, and they can be broken by someone pushing their own force through the strands.

rites.name: Coriastanum
rites.text: A swordsman surges toward a rival with blinding velocity and delivers a swift sideways slash. The speed leaves a ghostly echo of the fighter hanging in the air.

rites.name: Amollor
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, spins through two kicks and two blade slashes, then sends bony spikes sprouting from the body toward a foe.

rites.name: Ceostiales
rites.text: A piercing battle-call is loudly bellowed by a fighter to unsettle foes and rouse their allies. It works as a craft practised by warriors in temples and orders.

rites.name: Sosallum
rites.text: A fighter strikes a rival skyward while two copies leap alongside, pinning the foe as they fall. A third copy helps shape a spinning orb, which is driven into the captive during the descent.

rites.name: Orestiasor
rites.text: A practitioner draws life-force into the ground so that living timber rises on both sides and bends overhead into a rounded enclosure. It can trap a nearby foe or shield its user from distant blasts.

rites.name: Orisia
rites.text: A practitioner draws breath-charged air into the palm and shapes it into a small spinning gale. It is hurled at a foe and can punch through dense stone, and several can be flung in quick succession.

rites.name: Riallor
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth sharp metal spires that surge up from the earth in rolling waves, branching outward like limbs and impaling anyone standing in their path.

rites.name: Tintia Raulles
rites.text: A bearer shapes loose grit into a whirling column that rises from the ground beneath a foe and lifts them into the air. The technique relies on directing fine particles into a spinning vortex.

rites.name: Saureollium
rites.text: A fighter coats a blade with inner energy and swings it, sending three sharp crescent waves toward the target.

rites.name: Mausteorum
rites.text: A bearer raises a circle of living timber columns around a foe, closing in until the trapped one is crushed between them.

rites.name: Vauror
rites.text: A bound formation of five lightning strikes ringed around a target, their charged streams converging inward to explode in a great crackling burst.

rites.name: Caullus
rites.text: A bonded water-body rises into a great wave shaped like a monstrous fish. It can crush a larger foe or shelter companions from harm, though a direct blast can topple its wielder into a limp, gelatinous slump.

rites.name: Nesteontor
rites.text: A wielder flings a volley of hardened shards outward at great speed toward a foe. The barrage can shatter a duplicate and hurl a nearby combatant backward, and it sweeps across a wide area to destroy several copies at once.

rites.name: Ciantallia
rites.text: A binding craft that uses the tone of a clay flute played by a practitioner. Its melody lifts enchantments from companions who have been held under the spells of rival sorcerers.

rites.name: Viantium
rites.text: A wielder strikes an opponent with a few rapid bursts of water, then hooks them with a staff and hurls them far backward. It is a finishing technique for combat.

rites.name: Amellarnus
rites.text: A bearer draws water from their open palms and shapes it into fine, taut strands. The strands can bear heavy strain, but if they fail under too much pressure, they snap back and hurl the bearer backward.

rites.name: Ameostium
rites.text: A caster calls forth a multitude of tiny web-spinning creatures that scurry toward a foe and swarm over them. The swarm is summoned on command and fights as one.

rites.name: Veneorus
rites.text: A great carved timber figure of a holy elder summons a serpentine beast of living wood that bursts up from the earth to strike a foe. The technique is practiced by sages who shape growing timber through focused will.

rites.name: Amilliarnes
rites.text: A wielder strikes an opponent with a jagged blade in several swift cuts while hurling torrents of water. A final downward stroke sends a column of water surging skyward.

rites.name: Amastus
rites.text: A sudden tactic in which one ally holds a foe's focus while a second slips behind and strikes the head with both fists. The move relies on coordinated distraction and a quick leap.

rites.name: Reosia Oreolor
rites.text: A practitioner's hands glow with a pale, flowing energy as she strikes an opponent in rapid sweeps. She then joins her palms, releasing a burst that hurls the foe backward.

rites.name: Siantes
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a spiraling current of air that wraps around them and pushes aside incoming strikes. The same ring can be widened to shelter companions standing close by.

rites.name: Naustilia
rites.text: A practitioner guides a wooden puppet forward to charge at a foe, then spins while striking and hurling blades in a wide circle around himself.

rites.name: Seraulanum Vontaullor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a wide cloud of small creatures that search a large area. Once a target is found, the swarm closes into a ball around it, clings on, and drains its inner energy, following relentlessly even if the target flees.

rites.name: Ceonoles
rites.text: A practitioner spins rapidly while gripping a long staff and strikes an enemy with it. A stronger form infuses the staff with stone, turning it into a heavy block-like club.

rites.name: Teolaror
rites.text: A caster lifts water into the sky so that it turns dark and drops onto foes, clinging to their faces and blinding them. The deception buys the caster a moment to strike again or slip away.

rites.name: Seraulles Orestollum
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward and commands a swirling cloud of petals to envelop a foe, blinding and bewildering them. The petals are then driven into the earth by a forceful kick.

rites.name: Tastus
rites.text: A spectral guardian strikes first with a heavy fist, then carves through its foe with a blade swipe. A burst of flame follows, and two more sweeping cuts finish the assault.

rites.name: Valorintia
rites.text: A practitioner of a clan's craft vanishes from sight, then vines erupt to bind a foe and hoist them aloft. A pod then rises from the soil, splits open, and reveals the caster poised to attack.

rites.name: Cornia
rites.text: Two bodies kick away from a foe, split apart, then fuse again to hammer the foe against a summoned gate until the gate shatters.

rites.name: Raunesum
rites.text: A practitioner merges their body with any pool of water, even a shallow puddle. From within the liquid they strike unseen, catching the target off guard.

rites.name: Coristarnes
rites.text: A practitioner turns an arm into living timber, then sends out many limbs that swiftly coil around a foe and hold them fast. The grip is strong enough to bind even a colossal sea beast.

rites.name: Telintaules
rites.text: A wearer fixes a bound visage to the face and swells into a towering, grey-skinned brute with crimson hair and oversized fists. Those fists hurl shattered earth at foes, though the crown of the head stays exposed.

rites.name: Amantiares
rites.text: Two fighters position themselves on either side of a foe, then lunge in and swap places to launch the foe skyward. Both then seize the airborne foe's arms and spin them down until the head strikes the earth.

rites.name: Rernes Amernus
rites.text: A binding craft in which practitioners wrap a foe in dark cord to hold their body still. The cord restricts every movement the captive attempts.

rites.name: Tialium
rites.text: A practitioner draws water into a flawless, reflective sheet that hangs in the air. It catches incoming blows and deflects them away from the one who raised it.

rites.name: Valaulus
rites.text: A practitioner spits a spray of sharp watery shards that pierce even hardened armor. The technique is a fighting art drawn from the flow of water.

rites.name: Tesus
rites.text: A practitioner, once roused into a fierce awakened state, unleashes a rapid flurry of forceful blows upon an adversary.

rites.name: Serilus Nialum
rites.text: A practitioner reshapes their own hide into a heavy bludgeon and brings it crashing down upon an adversary. The technique turns the body itself into a weapon.

rites.name: Telirnianes
rites.text: A puppeteer's technique in which a wooden marionette sends many sudden limbs from hidden sigils in its arm, snatching at a target hanging in the air above.

rites.name: Tisium
rites.text: A joint craft where one practitioner strikes an opponent with heat from one side while another strikes with flowing water from the other. Their clashing opposed forces unleash a crushing blow and fill the air with dense mist.

rites.name: Maures
rites.text: A warrior channels radiant energy into a spear, striking an opponent repeatedly before hurling the weapon to pierce them through.

rites.name: Amentium
rites.text: A practitioner projects a steady stream of water from the palm to strike an opponent and break their assault. The flow is especially effective against attacks made of drifting smoke.

rites.name: Teliasernes
rites.text: A practitioner shrinks their body and darts at a foe, then swells back to full size and strikes with a reshaped fist. The technique combines sudden miniaturization with a transformed punch.

rites.name: Coriasanum
rites.text: A wielder sweeps a spirit-form blade through the air, releasing a broad tide of inner power that cuts down a foe.

rites.name: Lernium
rites.text: A practitioner cups their palms to gather loose water and mold it into striking tools. These liquid implements serve in both close and distant fighting.

rites.name: Valaunor Serirnes
rites.text: A wielder channels inner power to split the ground and draw a foe deep below the surface, where the sand pins them so they cannot stir. Pressure then tightens until the captive is crushed.

rites.name: Corauntia
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a rapid flurry of blows and cuts, then finishes with a rising upward punch that hurls the foe into the air.

rites.name: Valialenus
rites.text: A bearer releases a drifting cluster of shimmering spheres that stun a foe. The final sphere splits into smaller globes that gather overhead and crash down to floor the target.

rites.name: Telia Nornalus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a practitioner projects spectral limbs of inner energy to strike an opponent several times in quick succession. It finishes with a single limb that crushes the target.

rites.name: Taulornes
rites.text: A practitioner draws gathered air into a huge whirling column that sweeps toward a rival. The same column can also be raised from the ground beneath the rival's feet.

rites.name: Siallanus
rites.text: A bound spirit-beast is called forth to exhale a cloud of venom over the space before it, sickening any foe standing within the haze.

rites.name: Serarnia
rites.text: A bewitching illusion that pours forth from a great beast's gaze. Its shimmering, many-hued beams fall upon foes and leave them frozen in place.

rites.name: Amaustus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers loose grit into a towering shaped limb that seizes an opponent and hurls them a long way off.

rites.name: Ranosus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a whirling blast of cutting wind that sweeps toward a foe. The gust spins forward and slices whatever it reaches.

rites.name: Lonor
rites.text: A fighter rushes at a foe, stabs with a blade, then ends with a whirling kick that hurls the enemy skyward. It is a close-range striking method used in combat.

rites.name: Lasteonum
rites.text: A binding craft that a practitioner arms in advance by marking their chest, so that upon their death their own blood releases four glyphs that form a dark sphere, pulling everything within it into the corpse.

rites.name: Saunollanum Amasum
rites.text: A duelist channels living flame into a short blade and blurs across the battlefield, striking a foe from four angles at once. The flames sear the target as the cuts land.

rites.name: Sialanum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes sticky threads at will, either hardening them into jagged points or weaving them from the mouth or hands into a net that ensnares foes.

rites.name: Amaror Corollausor
rites.text: A user raises a mound of loose grit beneath a foe, pinning all but the head. A massive granular spear then hurtles down upon the captive, tearing it apart in a violent burst.

rites.name: Seoselanum
rites.text: A wielder empowers a blade with inner energy until it swells in size. A straight downward strike then drives into the ground and inflicts heavy harm on the foe.

rites.name: Orentor Nenteosor
rites.text: A fighter drives a blade into the earth, balances upon it, and kicks a foe away, usually aiming at the upper belly or throat.

rites.name: Morum Valauntanum
rites.text: A bearer channels inner energy into bindings wrapped around the arms, letting them move the cloth at will. Hardened by the flow, the strips can cut cleanly through stone.

rites.name: Vellaurnum
rites.text: Two trainees face each other and perform a ritual hand sign declaring their challenge before fighting. Afterward they interlock those same fingers, affirming that they remain allies.

rites.name: Ciallum
rites.text: A dark, shadowy technique in which a user wraps themselves in a sphere of hidden force and strikes an opponent repeatedly with it.

rites.name: Laulia Amerneonus
rites.text: A practitioner releases three small spinning orbs of gathered force at a foe. Together they strike harder than a single orb would.

rites.name: Taunium
rites.text: A practitioner projects many powerful streams of water outward from the mouth at great speed. The streams are strong enough to break apart solid stone.

rites.name: Riarnum
rites.text: A practitioner raises a barrier of hardened metal from the earth into a defensive wall. The barrier is sturdy enough to turn aside a heavy volley of grit projectiles.

rites.name: Orillonanum
rites.text: A stone colossus is used as a conduit by a masked wanderer, who drives a great carved hand down upon foes and pins them with sharp timber spikes as they lie trapped beneath it.

rites.name: Coraurnisia
rites.text: A hidden trap of buried binding charms that wakes when someone treads upon it, sending out fine cords that coil around the intruder and hold them fast. Its carved sigils make it especially effective against those who have returned from death.

rites.name: Sirnares
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a bearer shapes their winglike tail into a spinning current and sends a small whirlwind toward a rival. It is taught among close-combat orders.

rites.name: Coroseostia
rites.text: A duelist strikes an opponent twice, then leaps and lands hard, causing the ground ahead to heave up into a stone slab that hurls the foe into the air.

rites.name: Niarneores
rites.text: A sorcerer draws a serpent-born blade from a coil that slides out of his throat. He then cuts an opponent with a rapid run of whirling strokes.

rites.name: Marniales
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a practitioner drives a leg forcefully into an opponent's midsection. It is a close-quarters strike used in combat.

rites.name: Orianor Valiarnaria
rites.text: A tactic in which many duplicate shades of one fighter each strike a foe with a crackling blade-strike, and then the original fighter ends the foe with a stronger version of the same strike.

rites.name: Cillanum
rites.text: Certain bearers can bend a great elemental spirit to their will, though the bond differs from one bearer to the next. Only a handful ever master such a spirit completely.

rites.name: Sialum
rites.text: A young warrior channels a radiant inherited blade through a sequence of swift cuts, ending with a strong downward stroke.

rites.name: Orantanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers the leftover water from a volley of watery strikes and shapes it into a lance that drives upward into the foe.

rites.name: Tosanum
rites.text: A counter-craft that lifts a binding inscription from its bearer. When the caster places a palm on the mark, it wakes and cancels the magic that was holding them.

rites.name: Nentum Riastium
rites.text: A tactic in which a caster releases clouds of smoke to blind foes, then binds an enemy's shadow and squeezes it into a tiny sphere until it bursts.

rites.name: Tiantus
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a spinning column of water into a serpent with a wide open jaw. The serpent coils after its prey and swallows them, then dissolves into a current that sweeps the captured away.

rites.name: Taurnia
rites.text: A keeper releases a brood of large grubs onto a foe's skin. They tunnel inward, feeding on flesh and vital essence until they swell and consume the host from within.

rites.name: Losum
rites.text: A practitioner summons shadowy figures into a square formation that channels a lightning beam between them, closing in to trap a foe at the center.

rites.name: Solor
rites.text: A bearer wields two short blades to undo sealed wards and bindings. The craft lets its user dissolve enchanted locks placed on objects or people.

rites.name: Sornus
rites.text: A bursting orb of violet vapor that spreads a foul reeking fog over a broad area. Those touched by the fog freeze briefly, and it can dull the nose of tracking beasts for a long while.

rites.name: Montiasor
rites.text: A practitioner leaps high into the air, slashes an opponent three times with blades, then kicks them down to the ground.

rites.name: Orolares
rites.text: A fighter travels beneath the earth, surfacing before an enemy to strike with a staff. It lets the practitioner rapidly hit several foes one after another.

rites.name: Aminor
rites.text: A practiced breath is pushed through cupped hands to launch a forceful jet of water outward. The sound and shape of the stream resemble a horn being played.

rites.name: Talia
rites.text: A fighter sprouts many jet-like limbs that thrust the body forward at a rival. The attacker then lands a rapid flurry of punches and sweeping strikes.

rites.name: Velles
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent in rapid succession with a heavy blade, then ends the assault with a whirling blow that hurls the foe far away.

rites.name: Seraulles Amostum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers nearby liquid into a host of slender spikes that encircle a foe. The spikes are hurled swiftly, and anyone struck suffers grievous harm.

rites.name: Millanum
rites.text: A practitioner raises two living pillars of braided timber from the soil that twist around each other and hurl a foe skyward. Two more braided columns then rise to strike the victim even higher.

rites.name: Orenes
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with rapid kicks and blades, then draws them close and launches them skyward to be cut again while airborne.

rites.name: Orianares
rites.text: A practitioner draws a binding sigil from a folded sheet or rolled parchment and calls forth a cluster of throwing blades, hurling them straight at a chosen foe.

rites.name: Oristeornia
rites.text: A bearer gathers a violent spiral of water and hurls it at a chosen foe. The whirling flood strikes with crushing force.

rites.name: Nollanum
rites.text: A fighter splits from a companion, kicks the foe away, then finishes them by slashing with clawed hands. It is a violent technique used in close combat.

rites.name: Casiallum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers loose grains into the air, then drives them down upon a foe like a striking storm. The technique is a ranged assault drawn from the desert dust.

rites.name: Liasus
rites.text: A hidden binding mark that can be pressed onto an opponent during a clash. When activated, its dark lines spread across the victim's body and freeze them in place, though a forceful outpouring of inner energy can shatter the hold.

rites.name: Sales
rites.text: A practitioner channels life force into the soil so that roots swell and rise into a dwelling shaped by the maker's memory. Marked stakes placed around it hide the shelter from outside eyes, letting its keeper rest unseen.

rites.name: Malaurnes
rites.text: A practitioner sacrifices their own body by releasing vapor and then bursting apart in a self-detonation. It is used to keep gathered secrets from falling into hostile hands.

rites.name: Sereolles
rites.text: A practitioner whirls on the spot and delivers a kick that hurls an opponent backward through the air.

rites.name: Rauntium
rites.text: A duplicate of the user is made, then it swallows volatile clay and detonates to create a blast that covers an escape. A false warning sharpens the foe's caution, letting the user swap places with the duplicate.

rites.name: Vintum
rites.text: A flying caster summons a swarm of inked beasts that swoop down on a foe, then strikes at the creatures with a short blade as they attack.

rites.name: Oriaseontum
rites.text: A forest-raising craft in which a practitioner guides a dense surge of living trees with inner energy. The roots split the ground and capture foes swiftly, and only one legendary builder has ever mastered it.

rites.name: Orintostum
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a caster raises four great linked limbs that revolve while hurling beams of inner power outward in every direction.

rites.name: Sareornes
rites.text: A practitioner draws out a steady current of water that carries awareness of nearby surfaces and movement. Sustained use leaves the wielder sweating and bleeding from the nose.

rites.name: Varnum
rites.text: A caster calls forth a vast bivalve that conjures illusory twins to encircle a foe. While the foe is held, the caster unleashes a blast that spins up a great whirlpool.

rites.name: Orenum
rites.text: A mind-binding craft that turns a dreamlike snare into a wall of false resistance. The caster slowly wears down their own vitality while the victim feels held back by nothing real.

rites.name: Meolium Valelirnor
rites.text: A practitioner leaps skyward and releases six shimmering spheres, four small and two large. The small ones daze a rival, while the final large one hurls the foe far away.

rites.name: Tarnes Neostor
rites.text: A fighter drags a foe beneath the waves, then becomes a sea beast that bursts upward to hurl the victim out and blasts them with a jet of seawater.

rites.name: Corenus
rites.text: A practitioner packs gusts of air tightly into a held implement. When the implement shatters, the trapped pressure bursts outward and strikes whatever stands nearby.

rites.name: Mintes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers loose grit from the ground into a swirling wall that can break through other protective wards. It also dulls the senses of foes caught within, and can be cast around enemies to blind them.

rites.name: Riasteonum
rites.text: A practitioner unleashes a vast torrent of water that floods an entire area in a violent wave. The flood can be shaped afterward into a huge enclosing mass used by another skilled fighter.

rites.name: Meornilia
rites.text: A combat craft in which a fighter turns the churning unease of a rocking stomach into erratic, hard-to-read strikes. The practitioner may also expel the contents of their gut onto a rival to unsettle them.

rites.name: Amaunus
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a dense burst of dust from the mouth, thick enough to blind an opponent completely. The cloud is broad enough to conceal a massive summoned beast.

rites.name: Nornellus
rites.text: A wielder breathes out a stream of floating spheres that trap foes inside a larger sphere. The sphere fills with dark fluid and bursts, destroying them and leaving nothing behind.

rites.name: Valareontes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers an inner force within the belly and turns it into liquid, then expels it as a forceful jet that can slice cleanly through the great roots of a sacred tree.

rites.name: Sarirnanum
rites.text: A bearer, empowered by a wild inner force, unleashes a swift flurry of strikes and kicks upon a foe. It is a technique of raw, rapid assault.

rites.name: Valoles
rites.text: A practitioner stirs a gust that splits into several small whirlwinds. Paired with a ground-hugging ring of fire, the winds fuse into a vast blazing storm.

rites.name: Amaurniales
rites.text: A summoned giant creature releases a sack of tiny offspring that drop onto a foe. Their falling threads bind the target so tightly that breaking free becomes nearly impossible.

rites.name: Mares
rites.text: A bodily discipline in which a practitioner gathers a great surge of breath to swell the chest and lungs, granting bursts of strength and visible changes to the body. Whether it carries a hidden cost is not known.

rites.name: Tallaunor
rites.text: A practitioner animates a crafted double of their own body, which wields a long blade swiftly and skillfully in combat. The double moves in place of its creator while the creator stays out of the fight.

rites.name: Caustelia
rites.text: A bound puppet unleashes a spike of gritty metal dust that drives a foe into stone, then forms a huge dense block of the same dust that drops onto them and crushes them.

rites.name: Amaunum
rites.text: A practitioner channels a puppet's built-in fire throwers to unleash a broad, spreading wave of flame toward an enemy.

rites.name: Santeonum
rites.text: A spiraling jet of water is gathered in the palm and hurled at a foe at great speed. It can also draw a crashing flood from nearby ground and be fused with a whirling gust to form a storm-vortex.

rites.name: Ameornum Telaunolus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a gust that traps a foe inside a spinning column of air. The caster steers the column upward and then drives the captive back down onto the earth.

rites.name: Oronellia
rites.text: A two-part tactic where one fighter swells into a rolling mass that bears down on a foe, while a partner binds the target's movement in place so the strike cannot be avoided.

rites.name: Ninorium
rites.text: A bound pair of charms fuses their heated and gusting forces into one violent burst of searing flame. Only a damp current driven by stirred air can smother it.

rites.name: Coriarilia
rites.text: A ritual art that lets a practitioner call up a whirlwind of drifting blossoms against a foe. The caster stays rooted in place while steering the storm wherever they wish, pouring full force into it as a final desperate measure.

rites.name: Reostium Lentiles
rites.text: Two practitioners each awaken their inner flame, and one feeds their energy into the other. The shared force swells into a far larger, more violent burst of power.

rites.name: Serornium
rites.text: Two fighters strike in turns against a foe, one delivering a sweeping kick and the other finishing with three ink-formed beasts. The technique rests on alternating physical blows.

rites.name: Siasanum
rites.text: A practitioner stretches their own darkness into five ringed fields, and four of them thrust sharp dark spikes upward from beneath the foes standing on them.

rites.name: Nauntes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers loose grit into a swirling curtain that wraps around the body. The whirling grains catch incoming missiles and shield the wielder from harm.

rites.name: Valeorolium
rites.text: A practitioner leaps backward and draws a blade with such speed that the motion releases a pressure wave, striking an opponent standing before them.

rites.name: Amauntanum
rites.text: A joint discipline where one practitioner sends a surging wall of liquid toward a foe while a partner whirls air through it, sharpening its force into a ruinous assault.

rites.name: Valorum
rites.text: A practitioner flicks a hand and hurls a keen blade of pressed air outward. The gust is strong enough to cut cleanly through a mere illusion of a person.

rites.name: Nianes
rites.text: A fighter hurls thin needles, some carrying tiny chimes and some bare, so the foe hears only the ringing and misses the silent strike. A wary opponent can evade by counting how many needles actually flew, while a skilled user tugs strings to ring chimes from unexpected spots.

rites.name: Volum Coriantia
rites.text: A practitioner spits a huge, tightly compressed bolt of water from the mouth. It tears through a foe on impact, wounding them as it strikes.

rites.name: Valostus
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a shimmering serpent of inner force that strikes an opponent with heavy harm. The blow can also weaken the foe's guard.

rites.name: Miarneontia
rites.text: A bearer in a four-tailed cloak strikes at a foe while airborne, boring into them with tails and briefly raising a second torso that hurls the enemy back to the ground.

rites.name: Sastanum Restes
rites.text: A carver conjures a great inked bird that bears a rider high above the field. The rider and several echoes then plunge down together onto the foe.

rites.name: Ceolentes
rites.text: A practitioner strikes across the ground so that hidden roots surge beneath the field, tearing the battlefield apart. The technique reduces the ground to ruin.

rites.name: Cauntus
rites.text: A wielder shapes loose desert grit into a spreading latticed net. It gives footing to companions chasing fleeing foes across the dunes.

rites.name: Corasanum
rites.text: A bearer moves at impossible speed, striking foes from many angles and slipping past any defense. It works especially well against brawlers who rely on raw strength in close combat.

rites.name: Saunisanum
rites.text: A bearer takes on the form of a great ember-furred beast and charges forward in a blazing rush that tears into the foe. It is a technique of the order's inner fire.

rites.name: Ciaraustor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a living wooden double that bears a huge timber hammer for a hand. The double leaps at a foe and batters them with the heavy head.

rites.name: Orialanum
rites.text: A binding craft that weaves taut filaments into a shielding dome able to turn aside most plain strikes. The caster may reshape the filaments mid-use, turning the shield into a tether that holds a foe fast.

rites.name: Leolum
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a dense ring of storm clouds and crackling current around their body. The ring hurls bolts of lightning at foes and forms a charged barrier that keeps attackers at a distance.

rites.name: Mauntor
rites.text: A fighter lands a flurry of blows, leaps skyward, and fires a sharp timber shaft from the open hand. The shaft pierces the foe and pins them down into the earth.

rites.name: Riallium
rites.text: A puppeteer's craft in which two marionettes rain explosive charges down upon a foe. The technique overwhelms opponents with a hail of blasts.

rites.name: Leonium
rites.text: A practitioner leaps into the air and releases a rapid volley of pressurized water bolts at a rival. The technique relies on sudden agility and quick, repeated strikes.

rites.name: Niallia
rites.text: A practitioner joins minds with a bonded serpent, borrowing its senses to watch and listen to the surroundings. The method lets its user gather knowledge quietly, unseen by those being observed.

rites.name: Misus
rites.text: A process in which the life force and spirit of a dead person are returned into a fresh living body. The newborn carries the older spirit forward within itself.

rites.name: Orasiarnes
rites.text: A mind-binding craft in which a practitioner overrides the will of followers, compelling them to strike a chosen foe with bare-handed combat.

rites.name: Lirnium
rites.text: A practitioner sweeps a ribbon of folded silk toward the heavens, calling down a towering whirlwind onto a chosen mark. The strike can lag behind its setup, and the clouds vanish while the spinning column keeps its fierce shape.

rites.name: Veolausum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers water into a small pool and shapes it into three serpentine streams that lash out at several foes at once, striking from different directions.

rites.name: Lintostum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a brief swell of water beneath their feet and rides it forward at a foe. They then strike through the target with a jagged, shark-skinned blade.

rites.name: Nornalium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter strikes an opponent, then closes the gap immediately to land a harder second blow. The follow-up hits with greater force than the first.

rites.name: Costus Mallonia
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder swings a pair of linked staves to strike an opponent many times, ending with a powerful kick that sends the foe flying far away.

rites.name: Lintastanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers moisture drifting through the air and shapes it into several rapid jets of water that strike a chosen target.

rites.name: Ameorus
rites.text: A practitioner expels a heavy torrent of foamy bubbles that coat the ground and make footing slippery for foes. The forceful spray can scatter incoming flames and oils, and the frothy cloud also serves to hide the user's movements.

rites.name: Colarnor
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a watery blow that spins into a whirlpool, trapping them in place. The attacker then leaps high and plunges down with a rotating watery drill.

rites.name: Orallia
rites.text: A shared vision of pale feathers drifting down over everyone nearby gradually lulls the watchers into a deep sleep. Only breaking the vision awakens them, and anyone alert enough can break it early.

rites.name: Colium Misernia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes gusts of air that pour from open palms. The craft easily lifts loose dust into the surrounding space and can be guided to form a storm of drifting grit.

rites.name: Teleostium Vineollanum
