rites.text: Three ceremonial figures stand in a triangle and open three marked hatches to call up a violent whirlwind. It drags nearby foes inward, crushes them, and hurls the remains outward, though the strain can leave the figures exposed.

rites.name: Viles
rites.text: A discipline in which practitioners called wardens absorb the living energy of the land and braid it with their own inner force. The blend grants new strength and opens methods that ordinary inner force could never reach.

rites.name: Sellia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a double of themselves from drifting vapor. When the double is struck, it dissolves back into a cloud of mist.

rites.name: Riantium
rites.text: Under moonlight, a practitioner seizes their own shadow and draws it into a solid edge for striking. Unlike a sibling craft, the edge stays firm and cannot be dissolved by other light.

rites.name: Lirnanor
rites.text: A practitioner flicks a single needle-thin bead of water from the mouth at great speed, hard to dodge. On impact it bursts and stings the target, weakening foes who are already distracted.

rites.name: Tiselor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a small amount of inner energy into a tiny spinning sphere. Its full power has never been seen, because the user falls before unleashing it.

rites.name: Amestianus
rites.text: A caster binds a foe with taut threads of inner force, then sends carved figures that pour a torrent of water over them. The soaked ground and body leave the captive unable to shape their own dust.

rites.name: Noleranum
rites.text: A practiced technique where a bearer unleashes six sweeping limbs, extending one of them like a whip to strike at foes.

rites.name: Valiseror
rites.text: A practitioner sends messages to a distant partner through a special parchment, where written words quietly appear and then fade away.

rites.name: Naunus
rites.text: A ritual striking sequence where a fighter lands a flurry of blows on an opponent, then ends the exchange with a gust of wind and a burst of flame.

rites.name: Lonia
rites.text: A fighter raises a column of living timber from the earth, grips it, and spins around it, lashing out with a leg again and again to batter an opponent.

rites.name: Coraurnanum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth countless living timber shoots that surge up from the earth. They weave together into a broad, meshed barrier that stands firm against incoming harm.

rites.name: Sirelum
rites.text: A binding craft in which a practitioner stitches a dark tether outward in every direction at once, pinning anyone standing nearby in place.

rites.name: Teliarnia
rites.text: A practitioner's eyes take on a golden glow when the craft is awakened. Through this glow they perceive faint residual energy left behind by a person's steps.

rites.name: Vastus
rites.text: A fierce spinning gale is called up by wielding a pair of blades that have no flaw. When the blades join with three other sacred arms, the gust twists into a violent whirlwind.

rites.name: Coroliarnia
rites.text: A winged shapeshifter can breathe out a thick cloud to hide her movements. It serves as a distraction, leaving no lasting harm on whoever is caught in it.

rites.name: Teleoniasus
rites.text: A practitioner performs a sequence of gestures, then strikes the earth so an inscribed sigil spreads outward from their palm beneath a chosen target. When the sigil wakes, whatever rests above its lines becomes locked inside the pattern.

rites.name: Tillornia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes water into a serpentine beast and hurls it at a foe, where it crashes with heavy force. Skilled users can draw water from their own breath, and greater talent allows a larger beast.

rites.name: Amaresia
rites.text: A fighting technique where a practitioner strikes a foe, launches them skyward with a spinning kick, delivers several more kicks, then drives them down with a burst of water.

rites.name: Seresium Coranus
rites.text: A practitioner hurls five bladed throwing stars tied to fine threads of inner energy. The stars then pursue a chosen foe through the air.

rites.name: Valases
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a compressed burst of storm energy within a clenched hand and hurls it outward as a sharp bolt. When channeled through standing water, the discharge spreads to strike several foes at once.

rites.name: Ameolaustia
rites.text: A tactic in which a caster splits into many duplicates, each taking on an alluring form that swarms a foe to overwhelm it with desire. Some opponents are immune, while others are knocked out by the sudden rush.

rites.name: Niranum
rites.text: A bloodline family can dissolve their bodies into drifting vapor that cannot be harmed by blades. In that form they slip through foes, seize control of another person's body, and feel everything it senses.

rites.name: Nialenes
rites.text: A practitioner draws crackling yellow discharge from the palm and shapes it into a serpent that strikes from afar. The same current can also be loosed through water or thrust directly into an opponent.

rites.name: Ameosallor
rites.text: A fighter hurls a foe skyward, then seals them inside a living timber sphere. A towering colossus is called down to crash onto the trapped target while the caster slips away through a shadow gate.

rites.name: Telonanum
rites.text: A wielder strikes the earth with a surge of inner force, sending a rippling shockwave that rips open the ground and tears across the open land.

rites.name: Liaranum
rites.text: A tracker plucks the cords of a curved bow and reads the returning ripples of sound to locate hidden prey. Loud rumbling noises in the air can scramble these readings and mislead the listener.

rites.name: Neoriasor
rites.text: A bearer traps a rival inside a crushing dark sphere wrapped in black fire, then calls forth two thunder beasts that tear the sphere apart.

rites.name: Nintiases
rites.text: A wielder calls forth a glowing golden shell woven from pure inner energy that wraps the body. While shielded, harm is sharply lessened, and strikes delivered through the shell hit harder.

rites.name: Meoses
rites.text: Four practitioners of one bloodline coordinate a sequence of palm techniques, first pushing a foe away, then striking in close, and finally launching them backward with a shared blast.

rites.name: Amelleonium
rites.text: A wielder thrusts an open palm toward a foe and releases a huge violet orb of force, trailed by a colossal violet serpent. Its strength rivals the greatest spiraling strikes of the realm.

rites.name: Vontum
rites.text: Two fighters gather crackling storm energy into their hands and strike a foe together, at the same instant. The joint blow either slays the target or leaves it badly wounded.

rites.name: Reostorium
rites.text: A sky-borne power in which a chosen guardian summons a radiant wraith that drops from the heavens onto a foe. The attack is delivered through a towering spirit form.

rites.name: Costiares
rites.text: A fighting art where the whole body coils like a spring, then unleashes a kick aimed just above the head. The blow hurls the struck foe high into the air, and it can also be launched while the user is airborne.

rites.name: Teraunes
rites.text: A fighter slashes an opponent upward with a blade and then drives through them on landing. The move channels a crackling burst of lightning through the strike.

rites.name: Loneolium
rites.text: A practitioner rushes at a foe with a kick, then follows with a rising kick powered by modifications made to their legs.

rites.name: Corauliasum
rites.text: A caster raises a three-sided wall of crackling charge around a foe using three rods driven into the ground. Anyone touching the wall is shocked, and only a powerful outside blow against one side collapses the whole barrier.

rites.name: Carnores
rites.text: A disciplined method used by elite guardians to fully erase the remains of fallen operatives so no trace of the body is left for others to read.

rites.name: Ameornes
rites.text: A fighter launches a rival skyward with a kick, rises higher with a second strike, and then rolls through quick flips to hurl the rival down. The fighter steps away once they touch the ground again.

rites.name: Ameosanum
rites.text: A practitioner draws forth three dense blocks and hurls every one of them toward a rival. The technique is an offensive craft that launches multiple solid masses at once.

rites.name: Vollus
rites.text: A practitioner hurls an opponent skyward, then pursues them through the air with rapid strikes. The attack ends with a sharp flash of light blasted from the eyes.

rites.name: Sorium
rites.text: A fighter strikes with a hooked blade and a heavy fan, lifting the foe into the air. The attacker then blinks above them and drives them back down with a kick.

rites.name: Valernia
rites.text: A practice in which a wielder draws out another being's inner vitality and shapes it into pale tablets or fruit-like morsels that, when consumed, bestow great strength, slowed aging, and borrowed talents. Eating the fruit form transforms the consumer into a monstrous, more powerful figure.

rites.name: Sereonentor
rites.text: A caster gathers a vast swarm of tiny biting insects until they shape a copy of the caster's form. The copy can appear wherever the swarm is sent, and when struck it scatters back into the swarm.

rites.name: Nillia
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a ring of rose-colored crystal that spins upright around her body. Riding within it, she can dart swiftly across the surface of open water.

rites.name: Corilium
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner send a wave of crackling energy out of their palms. The strength can be dialed from a mild jolt that stuns a foe to a fierce bolt strong enough to split stone.

rites.name: Oriastontum
rites.text: A warrior pins a foe with spikes, then drops heavy stone pillars upon them. The strike ends with a burst of crimson force drawn from a cursed mark on the arm.

rites.name: Valisus
rites.text: A binding sigil drawn onto a body that siphons the vital energy from its bearer into the one who laid it. It was once used to pull lingering corruption out of a wounded wanderer.

rites.name: Malia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers the fiercest blast-force into a single clenched hand. On contact with a foe, the force burns the body away at once, leaving nothing behind but ash.

rites.name: Rintum
rites.text: A craft that binds objects, creatures, and lifeforce inside a vessel by inscribing marked symbols upon it. Its sigils reveal themselves as glyphs and can also loosen the bonds to set contents free.

rites.name: Telentanum
rites.text: A practitioner spins rapidly and is lifted off the ground, then unleashes a sequence of kicks aimed low, middle, and high, ending with a downward heel strike. The whirling motion hides each blow until it lands.

rites.name: Sereorolum
rites.text: A practitioner channels a thin current of crackling energy through the earth. Anyone it reaches is briefly frozen in place by the jolt.

rites.name: Amenor
rites.text: A fighter distracts a foe with a loyal companion, then uses two glowing blades to slash through them. The strikes carve two deep scars into the ground.

rites.name: Viasostor
rites.text: A practitioner snares a foe with a barbed metal lash and pours crackling storm-force through it. The barbs bite deeper the more the captive struggles, and the current keeps flowing without the wielder's constant attention.

rites.name: Telaronus
rites.text: A fighter overwhelms a foe with a rapid flurry of blows, then lifts them with an upward strike. The fighter reappears behind the falling target and finishes with a quick volley of short strikes.

rites.name: Amorisor
rites.text: A practitioner raises walls of frozen crystal to hold foes in place. The gleaming faces of the ice can also reflect illusions cast through mirrors.

rites.name: Tinium
rites.text: A rare lightning craft, dark as a moonless sky, that is said to strike far harder than ordinary storm-bolts. Its methods are known to only a single master's chosen heir, and little else is recorded about it.

rites.name: Oriallaunum
rites.text: A practiced art in which a crystal shard splits apart into many fragments that pierce a foe. Seasoned defenders regard it as a dangerously potent method of attack.

rites.name: Orernauntes
rites.text: A deadly ritual dance performed with two marionettes: a striking puppet distracts the foe while a hollow capturing shell traps them inside. The attacker's detached limbs then slide into slots on the shell, each with a hidden blade, to end the victim.

rites.name: Valisiastum
rites.text: A people breathe out a violet mist that sways a great beast into obedience. Heavy shakes of a bright powder can break the spell, and anyone else who breathes the smoke simply falls unconscious.

rites.name: Liarnastum
rites.text: A fighter gathers a dense knot of inner energy in a clenched hand and releases it on impact. The blow wounds living foes and cracks the ground, scattering fine petal-like shards into the air.

rites.name: Telernium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy, turns it into crackling charge, and presses a palm to the earth. The ground then erupts with a branching net of current that shocks anything entangled within reach.

rites.name: Teliasornia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers drifting vapor into clear frozen discs that serve as hurled projectiles, guarding shields, floating footholds, and distant viewing mirrors. Shaped into a broad lens, they can focus sunlight into a searing beam that may turn back on anyone standing near a reflective surface.

rites.name: Telaulirnus
rites.text: A forceful craft of windborne energy that lets a wielder summon a force in one hand and send a cutting wave that slices anything. It can be flung in rapid succession, and it turns crimson when fueled by a beast's surging power.

rites.name: Vesum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy into one open palm and strikes a foe so hard that the target is hurled a great distance. The gathered force glows with a faint warm amber light.

rites.name: Seriantilum
rites.text: A fighter coats the body in crackling storm energy, then drives an elbow into the foe with brutal force. The blow can hurl an enraged giant into a wall and leave him unable to continue.

rites.name: Rerium
rites.text: A craft that sends a rolling wave of pink glassy motes through the air, sealing any targets inside a hardened shell of crystal.

rites.name: Telinia
rites.text: A practitioner channels crackling energy through a sacred bone blade, hurling bolts that shock foes into helplessness. The method draws on a bearer's inner current to strike enemies with searing discharge.

rites.name: Cillor
rites.text: A near-fatal channel-striking art that seals a bearer's eight internal wells shut. The user first sees the flow of life within a foe's body, then strikes the gates in sequence.

rites.name: Varium
rites.text: A caster seals a foe inside a blooming shell of petals, then bursts the shell open in a cloud of blossoming fire. The technique uses illusion to disguise the trap until it springs.

rites.name: Oreonor
rites.text: A bound creature's long coiled tongues are whipped out to strike or ensnare a foe. Channeled power can stretch and quicken these tongues, and enough repeated blows can prove fatal.

rites.name: Coreniles
rites.text: A bearer raises a giant armored spirit that looses arrows to stun a foe. Then it conjures nine burning moons that plummet onto the target.

rites.name: Launiasus
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent several times, launching them skyward. Then the fighter wraps itself in crackling energy and delivers a downward blow that slams the foe back into the earth.

rites.name: Serosentium
rites.text: A fighter drives a palm into the earth, raising jagged stone pillars. He then charges a single fingertip with crackling energy and strikes, unleashing a massive electric blast that wounds the foe badly.

rites.name: Orosia
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward and brings a curved blade down upon an enemy. A spinning kick to the belly follows, then three whirling slashes finish the assault.

rites.name: Collanum
rites.text: A practitioner wraps herself in a glowing rose-hued sphere that pins a foe in place. From within the sphere she flings many thin needles at the captured target.

rites.name: Solestia
rites.text: A hidden snare sealed beneath a warding array activates once a binding mark is torn away. It conjures a perfect duplicate of the one who broke the mark, one that never tires, and the only escape is to surpass the limits the breaker had when the mark was lost.

rites.name: Nonia
rites.text: A bearer channels a shard of a sacred mineral set into the back of the hand to hurl force at distant objects without touching them. The technique is taught through an old sacred scroll and can crack a stone column from across a room.

rites.name: Neostus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a noxious breath upon an opponent, which inflicts a lingering sickness in one contest and dulls the foe's pace in another.

rites.name: Cosor Caules
rites.text: A practitioner gathers crackling storm energy into one open hand and drives it into a foe. The technique strikes directly at the chosen target.

rites.name: Vialor
rites.text: A practitioner raises a wall of flame before an opponent, then drives gusts of air through it so the fire rushes forward. The resulting inferno scorches everything nearby.

rites.name: Cernanum
rites.text: A fighter unleashes a chain of blows, spinning through the air with a rush of vapor that drives each strike. The spinning assault lifts the opponent upward as the blows land.

rites.name: Ventium
rites.text: A tempest-born lightning craft that gathers into a crackling storm, unleashing a devastating discharge that lays waste across the whole surrounding area.

rites.name: Orausia
rites.text: A fighter drops from a great height and delivers a flat sideways blow with the force of the fall. If the blow cannot break a guard, it drives the foe deep into the earth to pin them in place.

rites.name: Naranum Rirnum
rites.text: A fighter seizes an opponent, hurls them skyward with a palm strike, then drives an elbow down onto their skull to slam them into the earth.

rites.name: Seonus
rites.text: A duelist strikes an opponent with a rising blade that lifts them into the air. While they hang there, a crackling thrust of lightning-charged needles follows, ending in a spear that bursts into several shafts after piercing.

rites.name: Ristia
rites.text: A bearer calls forth a tiger woven from living flame, which strikes a group of allies with heavy harm. The beast clings to a foe and then bursts apart with a powerful blast.

rites.name: Telalia
rites.text: A class of enchantments that binds a marked territory with an invisible law. It can bar entry, trap those inside, or flare into harm only when threatened, and it is usually undone by breaking whatever holds it.

rites.name: Valaustes
rites.text: A fighter takes on the form of a simian hero, leaps high into the air, and drops down upon an enemy with a flurry of punches.

rites.name: Meontanum
rites.text: A pure bodily combat technique where the wielder unleashes a flurry of open-palm strikes, clenched-fist blows, and kicks at a foe. The sequence moves so swiftly that few watchers can track it with bare eyes.

rites.name: Valares Riresia
rites.text: A bound weaver lashes heavy linked chains into a spiraling ward while a partner blinks overhead and drives a whirling strike down onto the foe below.

rites.name: Sistium
rites.text: A discipline of fine inner-energy handling that lets its practitioners mend flesh and bones, and also unleash poisonous vapors or cutting energy blades. Its masters are famed for turning the flow of power into raw physical strength.

rites.name: Oraustelum
rites.text: A wielder strikes an opponent with a blade charged by crackling sky-fire. The blow temporarily locks the target's inner energy, leaving them unable to shape any spell or craft.

rites.name: Meonanum
rites.text: A practitioner releases two shadowy duplicates that dash at a foe while the true body follows behind, delivering a swift cutting strike.

rites.name: Serallus
rites.text: A practitioner slips through a hidden dimensional gate and rushes toward a foe, then strikes by sending sharp living growths from their arm into the target. The technique blends swift movement with piercing attack.

rites.name: Lorium
rites.text: Two or more crafts are joined into a single new art whose force exceeds the sum of its parts. Its power is judged by reach or ruin, and it requires that the joined practitioners move in step through shared familiarity or kindred minds.

rites.name: Rarnia
rites.text: Two or more practitioners fuse into a single shape to borrow its bodily powers. Tasks like channeling energy and forming gestures can be shared among the joined users.

rites.name: Sastia
rites.text: A practitioner marks a person with a sigil. When that person draws near a marked token, glowing crimson strands bind them where they stand. The bond holds on its own for a long span, and a counter-sigil can undo it.

rites.name: Mostiaror
rites.text: A practitioner breathes flame that is shaped into a serpentine beast and split to strike a foe from three directions at once. Its fire can also coil into a whirling cage that holds the victim in place, and few can master it.

rites.name: Tianornum
rites.text: A fighter launches an opponent upward with a rising kick, clinging tightly as they rise. At the apex, the fighter spins and hurls the foe headfirst toward the ground, then releases them and retreats, leaving the fall to finish the move.

rites.name: Seriles
rites.text: A technique that summons a vast horde of serpents pouring from a user's mouth to overwhelm foes. The writhing mass can bite with venom, sprout sharp blades, and form an impenetrable barrier.

rites.name: Seolor
rites.text: A fierce fiery breath is unleashed in a short burst by a warrior in a feral, half-transformed state. It is a sharper, closer-range variant of a larger flame technique.

rites.name: Seonium
rites.text: A practitioner strikes sideways with a hooked palm, releasing a rolling surge of crackling energy that hurls the opponent backward.

rites.name: Coranium
rites.text: A practitioner releases stored inner energy through marked points in the hands, then spins to form a whirling shell of force. The shell deflects incoming strikes and injures any foe that draws close.

rites.name: Oreolontium
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a drifting cloud of ash-fine powder that hangs around a foe like a screen. A spark held in the teeth ignites it into a blast, which demands sharp perception of wind and tactical timing.

rites.name: Lauror
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward and aims a blade-like blade of his weapon toward a foe, wrapping them in water. The water takes the shape of a hunting sea beast and drives the victim down into the earth.

rites.name: Orillum
rites.text: A wielder grasps a blade in both hands and gathers inner energy into its edge. A single heavy downward cut then releases a force strong enough to scatter a huge ball of fire.

rites.name: Riantanum
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a burst of blast-force beneath one foot, which propels them forward with great speed and drives a harder blow into the foe struck by the kick.

rites.name: Nisianium
rites.text: A practitioner grows an additional set of muscled limbs from the upper body, varying in size. These extra arms can block magical attacks, perform intricate gestures, and help the wielder climb across rough ground.

rites.name: Telinanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes with rapid blows, lifts the foe, then leaps and spins into a downward kick driven by a burst of vapor. The vapor propels the kick toward the target.

rites.name: Tantium
rites.text: A hereditary craft through which a family binds spirit-energy into shadowy copies of fighters, both living and fallen. Only those carrying special glowing beads can perceive these echoes.

rites.name: Caustanum
rites.text: A practitioner spits a small violet fluid at a foe, and on contact it corrodes away in a biting way. Even a tiny splash can leave a victim disabled.

rites.name: Mosium
rites.text: A bearer releases a surge of inner power that hardens into a crimson barrier nearly impossible to breach. The barrier mends itself whenever it is damaged.

rites.name: Meornirus
rites.text: A mind-binding craft where a caster traps a rival in illusion through a single touch of the finger. Once snared, the victim suffers waking visions of crows, sharp throwing blades, and dreadful inner torment.

rites.name: Telisiaror
rites.text: A practitioner sweeps a hand through the air and calls down four bolts of thunder onto a chosen foe. The technique is a striking art of storm-summoning.

rites.name: Telaunus Sollia
rites.text: A bearer joins two blades so that a charge flows upward into the storm above. The bearer can then call down lightning onto any spot they choose.

rites.name: Risiastia
rites.text: A practitioner sets four marked sigils in a diamond around a ward and performs a sequence of gestures to unravel it. Stronger wards demand longer focus, and several practitioners chanting together can strengthen the unraveling.

rites.name: Neles
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner shape interlinked rings of metal to bend to their intent. The woven rings can be turned into cutting edges or into barriers strong enough to turn aside thrown blades.

rites.name: Castillanum
rites.text: A mental craft that forces a victim to see the image they dread most, whether or not they know they fear it. The vision feels entirely real and can knock the viewer senseless.

rites.name: Nialistanum
rites.text: A caster releases a swarm of drifting spheres that burst on contact with a foe, sending out bright flares, blasts that hurl nearby things backward, and thick clouds that blind the target.

rites.name: Lornum
rites.text: A practitioner vanishes in the instant before a blow lands, leaving a wooden stand-in to take the strike. The attacker briefly thinks the hit succeeded, which gives the practitioner a chance to counter or escape.

rites.name: Viania
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a combatant weaves rapidly across the arena, then lifts the opponent with a kick and drives them down with a clawed strike.

rites.name: Melanum
rites.text: A caster strikes still water holding bred serpents and releases dark crimson sparks, merging the creatures into one eyeless blue serpent with a red maw. The coil lunges and drags a foe beneath the surface to drown them.

rites.name: Valesium Lianus
rites.text: A practitioner conjures four glowing spectral wings that unleash a single devastating burst of energy. The effort drains nearly all their vital reserve, and while it lasts they can also blink instantly from place to place.

rites.name: Telanum Riallasor
rites.text: A practitioner watches a rival's art and reproduces it through a sharp inner eye. Once copied, the technique can be fused with a spark of storm energy, so the strike erupts into burning fire around the foe.

rites.name: Riantus Mernor
rites.text: A ruler conjures two heavy blocks and swells them until they clamp down on a foe from both sides. Only a bearer who dons a stone-heavy shell can slip free of the squeeze.

rites.name: Menium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a lashing cord of heat that strikes an opponent and hurls them a long distance. Its force is great enough to crack stone.

rites.name: Corellia
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a fighter leaps over a rival while balancing on their shoulder, then hurls them to the ground. The leap lets the fighter slip past an incoming strike.

rites.name: Corauntonum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a rapid volley of fire bursts from jets set into the palms of a hollow wooden figure. The technique relies on the figure's built-in flame throwers.

rites.name: Mellium
rites.text: A layered fighting sequence begins with an open-palm strike and then cuts with disrupting blades. It builds through a scatter of throwing stars and spinning slashes, then finishes with a blast that pushes everything away.

rites.name: Laurnia
rites.text: A practitioner raises a bar of precious metal skyward, and massive bars then fall from above onto foes, wounding them. The technique is a weapon that strikes from the heavens.

rites.name: Coriarnes
rites.text: A practitioner encases a broad zone in ruby lattice, turning every living and unliving thing inside into glassy stone. The first attempt failed when the trapped force burst free soon afterward.

rites.name: Ameorenus
rites.text: A keeper of a long-held vow gathers a fully charged sphere of force and enlarges it into a heavier, harsher blast. The blast persists until it has wrecked an entire stronghold, then it finally fades.

rites.name: Valenus
rites.text: A duelist leaps high above a foe and lets loose coiled serpents from their cuffs that drop onto the enemy. The duelist then lands and finishes the strike with a blade.

rites.name: Nellus
rites.text: A practitioner wraps the body in crackling storm-energy, then discharges a surging bolt of lightning through touch or from any limb. The jolt strikes an opponent with punishing force.

rites.name: Amostor
rites.text: A group of companions leaps skyward and arranges itself in a ring around a single central figure. The ring forms a barrier that blocks foes from seeing clearly and lets the allies move freely through the air.

rites.name: Rarninus
rites.text: A practiced craft in which swarms of winged insects carry small charges fixed to their bodies and set them off against a chosen foe. The blasts are timed by the tags the insects bear.

rites.name: Vinernia
rites.text: A practitioner summons spectral wings, rises high into the air, and then drops down to strike an opponent with a single foot. The maneuver combines lift and descent into one forceful kick.

rites.name: Corestarnes
rites.text: A practiced binding craft used by a sealing company of wardens. After a sequence of gestures, a new ward is raised that closes a gap in an older ward.

rites.name: Seroria
rites.text: A wielder channels a bright, cold energy blade to fell a foe, then follows with a crackling lightning thrust that bursts outward in a storm of sparks.

rites.name: Serantus
rites.text: A craft that shapes existing frozen water into tiny bird-like shards, hurled at a foe so they swerve midair and cut with their keen edges. Flame dissolves the ice and undoes the attack.

rites.name: Morasium
rites.text: A practitioner locks a target inside an illusion through touch or a shared gaze, either to bend their will into obedience or to trap them in a dreamlike haze. It can also shield a mind from prying, so its secrets stay hidden.

rites.name: Valasum
rites.text: A bound craft in which a warrior's spirit-guardian draws black fire from a sphere held in its off hand and shapes it into blades and weapons.

rites.name: Tianeolum
rites.text: A user of many copies of themselves hurls a storm of throwing blades from every side at once. The target cannot evade them all and must cover up, which opens gaps that the copies exploit for follow-up strikes.

rites.name: Corinelles
rites.text: A fighter rises high above the ground and strikes with a flurry of blade cuts before driving a crackling bolt of storm energy down onto the foe.

rites.name: Oronanum
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward while an ally binds them in wraps, then releases a surge of inner energy from the whole body. The spinning motion of the first strike stands in for the turning of a second, circling technique.

rites.name: Riallistia
rites.text: A craft that marks a region with a ring of hidden tags. When an outsider crosses into it, a barrier forms, and some tags can explode to trap the intruder.

rites.name: Lentia
rites.text: A hidden craft in which a wooden marionette is guided to unleash a massive surge of flame upon an enemy. It is a forbidden technique passed among a few trained handlers.

rites.name: Corellisia
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, gathers all bodily force into one heel, and hurls it downward with crushing power. The blow wrecks whoever it strikes and splits the ground and nearby buildings, made possible by unusually fine control of inner energy.

rites.name: Cisiarium
rites.text: A warrior wrapped in a spirit armor hurls a blade of living force that spins like a throwing star. In a past duel, the same armor was draped over a great beast and drove through its energy spheres to deal heavier harm.

rites.name: Reontium
rites.text: A duelist kicks a foe, then strikes with a heavy blade in a flurry of cuts. A final rising slash lifts the enemy off the ground.

rites.name: Amistus
rites.text: A fighter wraps both hands in swirling air, lands a rapid flurry of blows, then ends with a rising strike that unleashes a powerful gust hurling the foe skyward.

rites.name: Amanus
rites.text: A silent underground ambush in which a hidden fighter slices the foes' legs with thin energy blades, pinning them in place. A huge serpent then descends from above to crush the trapped target.

rites.name: Neria
rites.text: A bearer lays a marked binding sigil over a chosen spot, and any creature that steps across it calls forth guardian beasts to halt them. Only a few masters can lift the ward, by tracing a sequence of gestures and pointing at it, which sends the guardians away.

rites.name: Amerum
rites.text: A practitioner threads a glowing life-current into another person's nerves and takes command of their limbs while keeping their own mind at home. Targets feel their bodies moving without knowing why, and the sender can steer them even from afar.

rites.name: Meontes
rites.text: A fighter knocks a rival into the air, then unleashes a rotating volley of kicks to the torso and head before a final kick drives the foe down into the earth. It closely resembles an older surge-style technique.

rites.name: Amirnium Nalosium
rites.text: The practitioner gathers a gentle restorative force into a pale glowing sphere and passes it over wounds. It fails to mend an injury left too long untreated, however.

rites.name: Corolium
rites.text: A caster gathers a crackling current around their body and spins until a vortex of wind and sparks takes the shape of a serpent's head. It lunges forward, trapping a foe inside, and its lightning can leap to a second target.

rites.name: Seriallor
rites.text: Three fighters raise a broad pond of water, shape it around a foe, then leap out to strike together. A later blow forms a hardening column that a blade cuts through.

rites.name: Serallus Raunanum
rites.text: A small flame sealed in a masked wearer's grip bursts into a vast firestorm when it touches the ground, sweeping across a wide area and nearly impossible to escape. Paired with a crushing gale, the blaze grows strong enough to boil away a great lake's worth of water instantly.

rites.name: Nistoria
rites.text: A coordinated maneuver in which a craftswoman directs a set of linked figures, using one figure's looping arm and another's whirling blade before a hidden thread from a fifth figure pierces the target.

rites.name: Corontalia
rites.text: A bearer shapes sheets of folded parchment into wings, then hurls a storm of these leaves at a foe in quick succession. The flurry can overpower a blazing counter-spell.

rites.name: Seosinor
rites.text: A binding craft in which a caster extends a dark silhouette into branching tendrils, each bearing a volatile charm at its tip. The tendrils can be steered to strike at distant foes.

rites.name: Corellor
rites.text: A fighter layers a sequence of kicks and punches, using duplicate copies of himself to land each strike. One copy launches the foe skyward, another follows with an uppercut, and the true body finishes with a kick that sends the enemy higher still.

rites.name: Teleosus
rites.text: A duelist animates a crafted double of himself that strikes swiftly from several angles with a long blade. He then leaps skyward, and together with the double they descend upon a foe and pierce it.

rites.name: Risaulles
rites.text: A dark-lightning craft in which a wielder releases several crackling beasts that streak toward a foe, slashing as they pass. They then fuse into one colossal beast that bites the target and detonates.

rites.name: Vianistor
rites.text: A practitioner dips two fingers into a body of water and draws up a long rope of liquid that cuts as keenly as a blade and can bind foes. Crackling energy runs through the lash as it moves.

rites.name: Meorium
rites.text: A practitioner opens their lower limbs wide to vent stored inner energy downward, which lifts them into the air. The technique lets them hover and travel across the sky.

rites.name: Valaurinus
rites.text: A bound seal is inked upon a small charm, drawing a nearby person's spirit out of their body and trapping it inside the charm. Whoever touches or peels the charm free releases the spirit, which then appears and speaks, though it remembers nothing of its former life.

rites.name: Serollum
rites.text: A duelist slices an opponent with a glowing blade, then lashes with a coiled tail. Pale serpents burst from the ground to bite, a toxic mist settles over the target, and the duelist finishes with a final blade slash.

rites.name: Rallus
rites.text: Two bound siblings split apart and together call forth a gate lying flat upon the ground. The gate opens and draws the foe into a hidden realm beyond.

rites.name: Cisolium
rites.text: A fighter gathers inner energy into one foot and drives it down onto a foe with great force. A kick can follow immediately after the stomp.

rites.name: Seollum
rites.text: A warrior first draws quick strikes with long claws while a stored sphere of mystic energy gathers, then hurls the sphere at the foe. To finish, the blade is wrapped in azure power and swung twice, leaving a glowing trail.

rites.name: Coreostus Seroseonor
rites.text: A practiced fighting craft where a practitioner strikes an opponent upward into the air with a charged, open-handed uppercut infused with crackling storm energy.

rites.name: Mialanum
rites.text: A user sends a shapeless creature of their own true nature to strike a foe, dealing heavy harm and leaving venom behind. The strike is a craft of stealth and tainted mastery.

rites.name: Teleornanum
rites.text: A practitioner presses an open hand to a surface and releases a fine woven current of inner energy. The current calls small creeping creatures to gather there, and the practitioner can speak with them to learn what the nearby land has seen.

rites.name: Vintia
rites.text: A bound-up technique where a vast mass of loose grit wraps around a foe from all sides, sealing them inside an airtight chamber. Its speed and firmness shift with the wielder's inner energy and can be tuned to the captive.

rites.name: Naulernia
rites.text: A bearer wraps a great beast's coiled appendages around their body, then hurls them outward and spins until violent gales sweep the surroundings and flatten the land across a wide radius.

rites.name: Teornaranum
rites.text: A mighty spirit-giant is summoned from inner energy, strong enough to contend with a rival colossus of the same kind. Its orbiting seeker orbs can strike at foes or form a protective shell around the wielder.

rites.name: Valeonor
rites.text: A cursed bearer can break their own form into tiny pieces and slip inside another living body. From within, they reshape the host's flesh and slowly consume what remains, usually killing the victim, unless the host is willing to harm themselves.

rites.name: Coreollium
rites.text: A practitioner throws bladed tools trailing fine cords and sends an inner vital force down the cords to numb a foe. Creatures that can drink such force may instead seize it from the thrower and shrug off the numbing.

rites.name: Corernonus
rites.text: A practitioner coughs forth tiny wriggling spawn that seek out a chosen victim and burrow beneath their skin. The implanted creatures can end a life, cause agony, or hijack the victim's limbs, though a stubborn soul may tear them free before they settle in fully.

rites.name: Mausia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a spinning ball of force and scatters it with stormy air, raising a sturdy gust that can stop a fierce lightning strike.

rites.name: Valausanum
rites.text: A practitioner draws on their inner energy or a handheld fan to stir the air into several sharp gusts that cut cleanly through an opponent. Allies wielding folding fans also use it to break apart an oncoming tempest.

rites.name: Ciallia
rites.text: A fighter swells the muscles of the arm with a surge of liquid power, then strikes a straight blow followed by a crescent sweep that makes water burst up from the earth.

rites.name: Rollus
rites.text: A wielder senses foes within a close span, feeling a blow forming before it lands. This foresight lets them slip past strikes delivered at arm's length.

rites.name: Serallanum
rites.text: A ritual mark is placed upon a person so that its effect triggers on a set timer, even when the bearer is tortured or entranced. Those who wield it reserve it as a rare last resort against an unguarded foe.

rites.name: Cantor
rites.text: A practitioner calls three rivers of water into coiled serpent forms and hurls them at a foe in quick succession. It is an enhanced form of a single-coil strike.

rites.name: Tesonus
rites.text: A simple binding craft that holds one or more targets motionless, as if bound by unseen cords. Its grip grows stronger or weaker depending on the skill of the one who casts it, and it can halt an enemy's assault or leave them open to attack.

rites.name: Amentilium
rites.text: A bond-holder lets a beast call a sworn companion to its side, pulling them across the land. The beast may also carry its summoner or allies along when it moves, offering swift travel or escape.

rites.name: Meoniarnum
rites.text: A bound beast-spirit is called forth by its keeper and made to hurl a crushing sphere of raw force at a rival. The keeper directs the creature's power through a chosen will.

rites.name: Villus
rites.text: A practitioner releases swift dark tendrils that race at a foe, then binds the captured body with smaller grasping shadows. A focused gesture then channels inner energy to crush the restrained target.

rites.name: Orasium
rites.text: A bearer hurls a vast gout of sea-water toward a foe, and ravenous brine-hunters surge up from the depths to drive the target skyward. The bearer then strikes them back down into the churning deep, where the hunters consume them.

rites.name: Vonus
rites.text: A bright rose-tinted storm-current drawn from the palms of a practitioner. It can be hurled as fingertip bolts strong enough to split stone, and it can be woven into other arts to expand their reach.

rites.name: Reollenia
rites.text: A refined craft in which a practitioner molds the inner energy flowing through the body, changing its qualities so it can be used in workings. It is paired with a second craft that alters the energy's form and movement.

rites.name: Riallirnus
rites.text: A paired technique where one fighter hurls a marked blade ahead of a foe, and the partner appears at its landing point to strike. Then the first fighter drops from above with a spinning orb while the partner delivers a crushing punch that splits the earth.

rites.name: Vauntostum
rites.text: A practitioner forms a sequence of hand signs and instantly transforms the surrounding ground into a dense woodland, with trees and grass sprouting from any terrain underfoot. It closely resembles an older, more famous craft of the same lineage, though it works over a more modest area.

rites.name: Sellausium
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a great many-bodied slug-beast from another realm for a brief moment. It sprays corrosive acid at the foe standing before it.

rites.name: Riallanum Oriasernus
rites.text: A practitioner draws water from the surroundings and shapes it into razor-edged petals that swell and spin, bursting outward before being flung at a foe. Each petal can be steered and is lethal on its own.

rites.name: Sirnor Lostanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers energy between two fingers and shapes it into a small spinning sphere. The sphere is hurled at a distant foe, moving swiftly and punching clean through them, knocking them off their feet.

rites.name: Siares
rites.text: A practitioner spreads their shadow across a wide area so that it binds several foes at once and leaves few openings for anyone to slip away.

rites.name: Orisianes
rites.text: A fighting art that closely mirrors an earlier strike, but the user first hurls the foe down and then flings them skyward. Its radiant bursts are wider and the final blow lands with greater force.

rites.name: Sauntes
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a spiraling column of water at a foe and threads four crackling orbs of lightning through it, forming a charged sphere of churning water.

rites.name: Caranum
rites.text: A practitioner presses a palm against another's face and lifts it away to wear it as their own. The stolen visage leaves the donor's body grotesque, and it gradually sags and tears when the wearer takes harm.

rites.name: Lalor Teontianes
rites.text: A practitioner blows many floating spheres that wrap around a foe from every side. A faint touch makes any sphere pop into a sharp blast, and a single finger snap sets them all off together.

rites.name: Veonanum
rites.text: A practitioner channels inner energy to quicken the scalp, causing the hair to grow long and stiffen like wire. Bundled tightly, the locks become a deadly weapon, sometimes shaped like a gaping beast's jaws.

rites.name: Amerneonor
rites.text: A painter's technique that conjures a swarm of beasts from ink strokes to rain down upon a foe. The artist can then shape a towering serpent from the same ink to deliver the final blow.

rites.name: Coneosanum
rites.text: A fighting art practiced by one wielder who wraps his body in a spiritual veil so every motion makes no sound. A watcher compares the veil to an owl's soft feathers, leaving the movements nearly impossible to foresee.

rites.name: Oroniasus Vanor
rites.text: A bearer takes on a monstrous shape and releases a toxic cloud around the body. Anyone who stands close to the bearer breathes the vapor and is poisoned.

rites.name: Vausor
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a headbutt, leaps over them to kick the head, then launches them skyward, slams them back down, and ends with a burst of flame.

rites.name: Valoria
rites.text: A practitioner strikes an opponent several times, then spins with an outstretched arm to slash them with a glowing energy blade. The sequence ends by lifting the foe high into the air with a second blade strike.

rites.name: Corisium
rites.text: A craft in which a swirling sphere of spinning force is wrapped in a great burst of flame. When the sphere strikes a foe, the fire bursts outward in a scorching explosion.

rites.name: Coraunia
rites.text: A swirling sphere of energy takes on the hues of a shimmering light source, appearing like a rainbow. Its brilliant colours may also strengthen the force it unleashes against foes.

rites.name: Mastaunor
rites.text: A bond that lets a caster call forth beings whose sight is tied to the caster's own gaze. Marked bodies can be steered from afar through the caster's inner energy.

rites.name: Vistium
rites.text: A summoned serpent creature glides toward a foe, then plunges downward and tears straight through them. It is a technique called upon by a robed sorcerer.

rites.name: Telarnum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a tall column of blossom petals toward a foe, scattering the enemy through the air. The technique is a sweeping gust of soft pink fragments.

rites.name: Reosia
rites.text: A bearer spits a sticky, sized web of threads that shoves foes back and wraps them tight. Once caught, they struggle in vain, and the bearer uses it to stop direct assaults before they land.

rites.name: Amiaror
rites.text: A fighter summons twin duplicates who each shape a swirling sphere of raw force. The original drives the foe between the two spheres, and they strike from both sides at once to end the duel.

rites.name: Saurnisor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a sheep from darkness that drifts toward an opponent and lulls them into deep slumber. It is a craft of binding shade into a soothing form.

rites.name: Teonaullus
rites.text: A practitioner whirls a ringed staff overhead to conjure a vast spinning gale around themselves, then hurls it outward. The storm is strong enough to turn aside violent blasts of wind from otherworldly foes.

rites.name: Miarum
rites.text: A forbidden mind-binding art that convinces its victims every person nearby is an enemy. Those ensnared attack even their dearest companions while appearing calm and deliberate, and they ignore all reason. It can only be lifted by slaying the one who cast it.

rites.name: Nentus
rites.text: A soaring leaping strike in which the wielder drives a heavy kick down upon a foe while airborne. It is a technique favored by fighters of the sky-running schools.

rites.name: Teleostum
rites.text: A bearer spreads a near-invisible web of sensing strands across a region. Power is pumped through the strands so any touch or faint stir in the air reveals itself, and the strands can also haul in whatever snagged them.

rites.name: Serornanum
rites.text: A class of healing arts that lets a practitioner mend their own flesh after injury. Stronger forms can even cleanse the body of venom, though shortening one's span is a known cost.

rites.name: Serialorus
rites.text: A fighter lands a fist blow, then a rapid sequence of blade cuts and a kick, before summoning a spectral guardian arm that delivers a final punch to the foe.

rites.name: Sorus
rites.text: A practiced technique where a bearer in a heightened attuned state splits into four echoes, two striking the foe while two gather swirling force. The strikers launch the enemy into the air, and the bearer then hurls a spiraling sphere of power to finish the attack.

rites.name: Saurnor
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a volley of explosive barbed charges that burst open across a broad area. The detonations scatter their fragments over everything nearby.

rites.name: Oreornenus
rites.text: A deceiving craft that conjures a swirling storm of blossoms to fool an opponent's eyes. Its practitioner may also hurl a toxic bloom that strikes the target's head.

rites.name: Corintus
rites.text: A combined craft passed down within certain bloodlines, able to shape a hidden blend of forces. The elements it draws upon remain unknown to outsiders.

rites.name: Raullianum
rites.text: A user of the art enters a surging battle state and strikes an opponent's midsection with overwhelming force. The foe is hurled through a forest and crushed against a boulder, while a distant volcano erupts.

rites.name: Cianestes
rites.text: A fighter strikes a rival skyward, then splits into duplicate copies that leap alongside him. The copies pin the rival down during the descent, and the fighter drops onto them with a knee-first landing.

rites.name: Serallium
rites.text: A practitioner sets a six-pointed sigil on the earth, sending pulses through it that reveal distant beings within a wide area. The same pulses can also show whether a person is trained in healing arts.

rites.name: Cintus
rites.text: A paired striking technique where two fighters lunge together at a foe. One of them is distracted by a fallen collectible while the other moves to cover, and a shy wielder sends companions away from an embarrassing card.

rites.name: Conus
rites.text: A coordinated technique in which two wielders channel a focused state of heightened awareness, while a pair of allied creatures disorient a foe with booming resonant calls. A spinning sphere of gathered energy is then hurled to finish the strike.

rites.name: Lentia Seresia
rites.text: A practitioner calls down a fine rain that drinks in any magical energy it touches, except energy bearing the caster's own mark. It can swallow even bubbles of spirit force and spinning orbs of raw power.

rites.name: Ceonanum
rites.text: A bearer reshapes their altered skin until it toughens, then flings the hardened pieces at foes. The same fragments can also be fixed over the hands or feet to strike at close range.

rites.name: Terolum
rites.text: A bearer draws a deep breath and releases several sharp gusts at different angles by swiftly turning the head. When paired with a violent pulling force, these gusts can cut through even the strongest spirit guardians.

rites.name: Cauntiror
rites.text: Two small river-spirits merge into a bearer so that the bearer can draw in the world's raw vitality. The joined pair gathers that energy continuously while moving, and the bearer cannot be drained mid-fight. A fierce inner spirit refuses the merge.

rites.name: Oriastolor
rites.text: A fighter slashes down, drags a hungry blade along an opponent's shoulder, and turns to strike again. The blade drains the foe's inner energy before a final thrust and a slam into the ground.

rites.name: Corontor
rites.text: A wielder slips into a raw, borrowed-energy shape and forges a huge clawed limb from the captive force within. The limb tears through an opponent, and the wielder then shifts into a deeper, stronger state.

rites.name: Raustanum
rites.text: A user teleports behind a foe and readies a hurled explosive, but drops it at their own feet. They flee as it detonates in a massive blast.

rites.name: Mestontia
rites.text: A forbidden craft that breaks a binding seal on a dormant power and draws in energy from soil and sky. The bearer becomes a silent vessel, gathering force that the power can use without their consent.

rites.name: Caunestor
rites.text: A puppeteer commands a jointed shell that tears itself apart to strike a foe. The loose pieces then batter the target before the shell lifts the victim skyward and slams them down.

rites.name: Ameonerium
rites.text: A practitioner turns any incoming strike back upon its sender, and even a mere intention to harm returns the foreseen blow. The more murderous the intent, the fiercer the rebound, and the effect can pass to a second person through a touch of the palms.

rites.name: Serorus
rites.text: A practitioner heats their inner energy until it boils, then vents scalding vapor and charges straight forward like a rushing engine, emitting a shrill whistling cry.

rites.name: Meolium Amirnontor
rites.text: A combined technique in which one fighter scatters fine grit to daze a foe, and a partner follows with a spinning orb of force that drives the foe into the earth.

rites.name: Sastium
rites.text: A practitioner raises a broad fan-shaped shield to catch an incoming force and turn it back on the sender. The redirected force strikes suddenly, so foes struggle to dodge it.

rites.name: Orisium
rites.text: Two rival warriors combine their powers, one forging a glowing green serpent of living growth while the other sets it aflame. Their clash of ever-greater forces ends in a thunderous blast.

rites.name: Amanauranum
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a fierce gust across the nearby ground. The gale can lift its caster skyward and is strong enough to crumble weak buildings.

rites.name: Cernanum Valaustium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers three glowing amber whirls of spinning force by hand and hurls them one after another at a foe. Each whirl follows the last in quick succession.

rites.name: Amintum
rites.text: A bearer in a heightened guise summons a copy of himself that gathers a spinning sphere of power, enhanced by a beast's force. The sphere collapses inward upon whoever it strikes.

rites.name: Oreoliasia
rites.text: A practitioner projects a precise, forceful jet of fast-moving water from the mouth. When another person's power joins it, the jet can split a target into many thin slices.

rites.name: Oriaseranum
rites.text: A practitioner leaps and conjures a handful of liquid projectiles, hurling them at a foe in rapid succession.

rites.name: Ciallum Cauntor
rites.text: A fighter conjures several dark duplicates that strike at foes with blades while the original vanishes from sight. The hidden user then strikes unseen at the decisive moment, even after the duplicates fall.

rites.name: Ciarenium
rites.text: A bonded swarm of chitinous creatures living within a caster's body spreads outward to sense energy across a wide area. Once a foe is found, the swarm rushes in from every side and whirls around them as a deadly spinning vortex.

rites.name: Coreornisum
rites.text: A wielder lifts small clumps of grit high into the air and steers them with inner force so they rain onto a foe from several angles. The downpour draws the foe's gaze upward, letting a second hidden layer surge up from the ground to trap them in place.

rites.name: Nausialium
rites.text: Two bound beasts coil their long limbs into a pair of spinning storms that trap a foe between them. A burst of dense orbs is then hurled through the trapped victim.

rites.name: Telornalium
rites.text: A spiraling art of dark ink, drawn from a borrowed beast-force and shaped into a whirling blade that tears through the air. It is wielded by one who has taken hold of that wild power.

rites.name: Soreontor
rites.text: A bladed-hand strike technique in which a fighter empowers their body with dual inner forces, then summons a swarm of duplicates that surround the foe from every side. The duplicates strike together, and a final assault from the copies completes the sequence.

rites.name: Casteontium
rites.text: After a practitioner completes a supreme technique, they enter a heightened state that extends their reach, force, and quickness. While it lasts, they can unlock hidden awakened arts.

rites.name: Orausonium
rites.text: A bloodline-bound power that lets chosen heirs command surrounding seawater, awakened by diving deep into the ocean. Awakened users can split massive waves by thought and raise spiraling water columns to sink vessels.

rites.name: Maulanum
rites.text: A bearer inscribes a sigil that moves anything inside its boundary to a fixed destination, breaking the object into drifting motes of light. One ancient traveler once used it to reach a distant celestial body shaped by two ancestors.

rites.name: Tianaustum
rites.text: A practitioner draws every drop of blood from a victim and transforms it into clean liquid, leaving the body dried into a hollow shell. The same method can restore the caster's own strength when they are parched and depleted.

rites.name: Raullosus
rites.text: A deceptive mental craft that makes victims march in tight loops while believing they walk straight ahead. The victims rarely notice, wasting their strength until they stumble upon a familiar mark left behind.

rites.name: Veniomana
rites.text: Veniomana is a concept born in Ukaraeno's Fall, when the old worlds split apart in the Sundering and their broken pieces became the Shards. It is remembered as the will that held the Pact together while the sky was still cracking open.

rites.name: Ciles
rites.text: A practitioner sparks a brief blast within the palm. When timed and angled well, the blast turns hurled blades back toward the attacker, and it can also sever the cloth bindings used to hold a captive.

rites.name: Risernum
rites.text: A bearer silently sends commands into the mind of a winged companion, which then strikes foes from the air, seizes them and drops them into prepared snares.

rites.name: Coroniarium
rites.text: A bearer wraps a sprawling sphere of borrowed beast-force in a fierce cloak and charges it with gusting energy. Hurled at a foe, it detonates into a tremendous blast on impact.

rites.name: Risium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a spark between the palms and hurls several blazing orbs. Each orb bursts into fire on impact or sets its target alight.

rites.name: Oriantum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy into one leg and strikes an opponent, releasing a violent violet flare. The blow inflicts heavy harm and tears a deep pit into the earth beneath.

rites.name: Amiasiror
rites.text: A practitioner wraps the body in a crackling sheath of lightning. The charged field quickens their movement and shocks any foe who touches it, and the sheath is sturdy enough to endure powerful blows.

rites.name: Lelus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a sweeping cloud of dark metal grains that halts the thinking of anyone it envelops. The grains scramble the mind's currents, leaving the victim unable to think or move.

rites.name: Neornes
rites.text: A practice that lets a wielder pass their inner energy into another person. How much flows across is decided entirely by the one who gives it.

rites.name: Valesium
rites.text: A user forms two blades of woven energy, one pale and one violet, and cuts the target quickly. A borrowed residue of a fallen master then swells the violet blade, letting it sever the target outright.

rites.name: Amirnor
rites.text: A fighter hurls a foe with a long mechanical tether, flinging them against a frozen peak until its icy shelf shatters and chunks rain down on them.

rites.name: Amianallus
rites.text: A rare art that turns matter into colored gems, freezing living beings within crystal or shattering them when struck. It cannot harm raw energy, and certain sound pitches can break its forming crystals apart.

rites.name: Sentor
rites.text: A practitioner gathers fine dark metal dust into a sphere that traps one person in suspended stillness. The bond holds only while the caster lives, and only the caster can break it. The trapped person stays alive even through grievous wounds, giving healers time to tend them.

rites.name: Cintialia
rites.text: A involuntary gift lets a seer glimpse the moment a person will perish, her eyes shifting into a turning pattern. She sends her spirit back in time to warn her earlier self, altering what follows.

rites.name: Telontianus
rites.text: A bright crackling art raises sixteen towering columns that close around a foe like a great kiln. Once the enemy is sealed inside, a separate craft seals them within hardening clay and then fire.

rites.name: Cosor
rites.text: A healer draws forth tiny water-born swarms that drift through a wounded body and cancel the venom within. The method is said to cause sharp pain when it is performed.

rites.name: Siallum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers countless tiny sparks and shapes them into slender points, then hurls them at a foe. Their needles scarcely wound alone, but they conceal swifter missiles riding among them.

rites.name: Nesia
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, lands three rapid kicks on an opponent, then finishes with a spinning double-footed drill that hurls the foe down to the ground.

rites.name: Amianum
rites.text: A practitioner draws two mid-sized ink birds from a rolled scroll at close range. The first lifts a foe off the ground and the second carries the foe higher still.

rites.name: Telorneolus
rites.text: A bound figure is created from a sealed token and sent to a distant site, where it multiplies into many duplicates. The only way to undo this binding is to halt the figure that serves as its origin.

rites.name: Mirnum
rites.text: A fighter hurls marked blades, vanishes to one, and kicks a foe away. A double then blinks between the blades, slashing the foe until a surging sphere of force hurls them far.

rites.name: Telestor
rites.text: Two fighters close in from opposite flanks at blinding speed, leaving the foe no opening to respond. The paired assault works as one coordinated technique.

rites.name: Valeones
rites.text: A fighter rushes forward gripping crackling lightning, then stretches it into a long spear that flings the foe skyward. The lightning then swells into a blast that drives the foe back down.

rites.name: Teliantus
rites.text: An advanced craft that surpasses ordinary inherited arts. Its only known example merges three elemental transformations, joining stone, air, and flame into one technique.

rites.name: Ceolliranum
rites.text: A practitioner casts a binding veil over every rival in sight, scrambling their footing and blotting out what they can see. The effect leaves foes stumbling and blind.

rites.name: Riallanum
rites.text: A fighter seizes a foe and hurls them down until they rebound skyward. Then a mounted arm-gun gathers a surging energy charge and releases it at the staggered target.

rites.name: Lerniantor
rites.text: A fighter slashes with a blade to drive an enemy back, then leaps overhead and hurls a rapid volley of hairpins downward. The barrage strikes many times and deals heavy harm.

rites.name: Corosantus
rites.text: A ward-fire is hurled from a towering guardian's hand and shatters into smaller burning seeds. The seeds detonate on contact and linger as hidden snares across the field for a brief span.

rites.name: Mistianus
rites.text: A rare inherited gift lets a bloodline's members weave illusions so overwhelming that the mind convinces the body to suffer what it imagines. The power may split off a second self that seizes control, though steady training can keep it restrained.

rites.name: Orintanum
rites.text: A fighter wraps the body in crackling charge and then drives both clenched hands down onto a foe. The strike combines shock and blunt force into one blow.

rites.name: Rirnia
rites.text: A fighter darts in with startling speed and uses a glowing energy blade to disable a foe, then strikes rapidly and finishes with a kick that sends the foe sprawling backward.

rites.name: Mentiarus
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a rapid volley of blows, then finishes by slashing across the foe with energy blades drawn from inner power.

rites.name: Tilleosanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent, leaps into the sky, and summons countless duplicates that hurl one another at the foe. The user then shifts into a fiercer, beast-touched form.

rites.name: Vastaulles
rites.text: A fighter hurls charged blades toward a foe, then swaps position with one of them at the last instant. The swap delivers a fierce, fire-enriched lightning strike.

rites.name: Tarnanum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes a foe three times with an open hand that hurls them into a stone shelf. The same blow then brings the shelf down upon the enemy.

rites.name: Tosor
rites.text: A piercing glance from a crimson-eyed seer binds the mind of a target with a waking nightmare. The victim is overwhelmed and collapses, even those who normally feel nothing are shaken by it.

rites.name: Cosastum
rites.text: A binding craft where a caster traps a foe with a woven shadow, then pulls the snared figure closer by tugging on that shadow. It can gather several enemies into the reach of a separate mind-clouding dance.

rites.name: Seriantanum
rites.text: A fighter kicks a foe into the air, leaps above them, and drives them down through a flurry of strikes, then finishes with a blazing burst of fire and a final blow.

rites.name: Teontia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes inner energy into searing heat, then exhales it as a vast burning tide that sweeps across a wide area. Only several drenching-craft adepts working together can quench it.

rites.name: Ceorus
rites.text: Two practitioners pool their inner energy and shape a huge beast's head where their palms meet. A spinning sphere of force forms within its jaws, strengthened by both of them, able to shatter a sacred eye.

rites.name: Mausteranum
rites.text: Practitioners draw the inner energy of a rival into their own bodies and wield it as their own. Victims weaken and may collapse, while absorbers gain reserves and vigor, provided they can refine what they take.

rites.name: Lornasor
rites.text: A binding craft where four sealed scrolls and a drop of blood are used to pin a great beast. The practitioner must hold steady focus while the seal forms, and is exposed to attack during the process.

rites.name: Tastium
rites.text: A practitioner first reads an opponent's flow with a sharp inner gaze, then strikes with a spinning palm. A follow-up push hurls the target through the air, inflicting heavy harm.

rites.name: Canteoranum
rites.text: A fighter sweeps a great blade across a foe, tearing at them as they stagger back, then hauls the blade inward and finishes with a fist that drives them into the ground.

rites.name: Ronanum
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a practitioner reflects her piercing gaze off a pale celestial disk, leaving a permanent mark on everyone caught within it. The marks prepare the practitioner for a later large-scale use of a bound device.

rites.name: Neorum
rites.text: A borrowed inner force is poured into a towering spectral blade that stretches far beyond its bearer's guardian figure. It turns into dark fire and cuts downward across a great distance.

rites.name: Sorallanum
rites.text: Two fighters strike their foe in quick succession. One calls forth a great beast-spirit while the other wraps it in a towering armour, and together they bring down a blade that cuts the opponent apart.

rites.name: Oreosum
rites.text: A fighter gathers all of their practiced body skill into a spinning backward kick too swift to follow. Its force is so great that a struck foe rarely rises again, and in some tellings it stirs a whirling gust that can catch several attackers at once.

rites.name: Lilum
rites.text: A chain of strikes begins with an elbow and ends with a falling slam delivered atop the victim. The sequence works only while the user's special gaze is awakened.

rites.name: Amornum
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a rapid sequence of kicks, punches, and needle-thin blades, then launches them skyward with a backflip. Leaping above them, the fighter hurls more needles to finish the attack.

rites.name: Teleosoles
rites.text: A bearer in a changed state extends a needle-like spike from the palm and draws flesh and blood from a target, turning it into their own substance to restore strength and body size.

rites.name: Valoleones
rites.text: A fighter channels crackling storm energy through a blade, delivering a rapid flurry of strikes before leaping skyward to finish with a heavy downward cut.

rites.name: Marnes
rites.text: A bearer draws a swirling sphere of energy from a hidden eye and amplifies it until it glows red and swells to enormous size, matching the power of a rival's enlarged version.

rites.name: Sinteolor
rites.text: A combined power that draws another's inner energy through a mark on the hand and then releases or shapes it. Only one wielder is known to have used it, having taken it from a stranger.

rites.name: Saurenum
rites.text: A user fashions a shimmering swarm of false winged creatures that surround a foe. Once the foe sinks into the earth, the user presses a volatile charm onto their face, and the illusion's wings all detonate together.

rites.name: Miseontia
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a huge globe of crimson power from their mouth or feet and hurls it at an enemy. One direct strike can drive a mighty beast backward, and the blast it leaves behind dwarfs an entire fortress.

rites.name: Cornium
rites.text: A practitioner charges at a foe and unleashes a rapid flurry of blows wrapped in glowing inner energy. The technique relies on speed and channeled force.

rites.name: Viantalia
rites.text: A fighter splits into three duplicates, two of whom strike in a rapid sequence while the third hurls a whirling orb of gathered energy to finish the foe.

rites.name: Launanum
rites.text: A bearer in a changed form can exude a corrosive, highly caustic fluid that scorches whatever it touches. A companion once noted that the fluid could eat through tough hide.

rites.name: Serellanum
rites.text: A rare inherited sight that sprang from an ancient starborn bloodline and now runs through a single noble household. It sits among three legendary eyes said to be the greatest of all gazes.

rites.name: Sirnanum
rites.text: A practitioner bends the light flowing around their body, letting their figure, shadow, and breath fade from ordinary sight. Only the noises they make betray them, and certain piercing eyes can still perceive them.

rites.name: Serisium
rites.text: Two fighters charge at a foe together, joining their gathered crimson energy into one spiraling force that detonates in a great blast.

rites.name: Cornantor
rites.text: A fighter repeatedly strikes an opponent with alternating blows, each wielding a blade of bone that extends from the hand beyond its usual length.

rites.name: Teolanum
rites.text: A fighter hurls a foe skyward, then leaps after them and drives them down into the earth. Heated armour plating amplifies the force of the blow.

rites.name: Caustia
rites.text: A bearer of a dark binding mark dives into a foe, hurling them skyward. Then a piercing bolt of crackling energy erupts into a spreading storm of sparks.

rites.name: Vores
rites.text: A wielder channels a guardian spirit's form and swings a blade of ancient make in a flat, sweeping cut. The technique is a martial art drawn from the spirit's power.

rites.name: Venosia
rites.text: A practitioner disperses duplicate forms of themselves and gathers the drifting vapor left behind. The vapor then coils around a foe and holds them fast.

rites.name: Teoraustia
rites.text: A practitioner channels their inner energy into a dense swirl of air to form a huge clawed limb from the palm. The claw can seize, parry, and shatter heavy obstacles at any reach.

rites.name: Valaunor
rites.text: A flowing stream of flame that can be shaped into rolling rings along the ground or a floating circle in the air before it strikes its target. It can be combined with gusts of wind to form a fiery whirlwind or a massive blaze, which grows even stronger when confined within a stone-walled chamber.

rites.name: Saunanum
rites.text: Two bearers of the same art each channel a crackling force through one hand, linking them with a taut thread of energy. The thread can sever enormous limbs or coil around a foe to hold it fast.

rites.name: Miarisanum
rites.text: A practitioner makes a quick gesture sequence and vanishes from view. Moments later they reappear behind a rival and strike with a small blade.

rites.name: Nantiastum
rites.text: A fighter rushes forward with bare-hand martial skill while a towering spirit-guardian empowers her with crackling storm energy. She then descends upon the foe with a thunderous, charged strike.

rites.name: Ventes
rites.text: A fighter dashes at a rival, landing a flurry of hooked jabs and kicks while weaving side to side. The rush ends with a double-handed piercing strike.

rites.name: Mestia
rites.text: A practitioner draws metallic dust into a spinning cloud around the body and grows into a towering colossus. Each heavy step releases crackling bolts that topple nearby fighters, and anyone who touches the form is torn apart.

rites.name: Serellium
rites.text: A practitioner reshapes a crackling inner force into countless slender needles and launches them at a foe in rapid bursts. Pouring in more of the force produces more needles, and pairing it with a keen-eyed gaze lets the user strike exact weak points.

rites.name: Amelus
rites.text: A defensive craft in which a swarm of tiny carrion-beetles whirls in a fast hemisphere around its user. The swirling shell turns aside blows, though a sufficiently violent blast can tear through it.

rites.name: Caullor Corerontus
rites.text: Two bonded fighters strike with a flurry of blows, then one vanishes to descend upon the foe while both merge their energy into a spinning orb hurled at the enemy.

rites.name: Viantelles
rites.text: A practitioner seals a hidden thread into a target's recollections, keeping them unaware of their true allegiance. Undoing the seal unlocks the buried purpose again.

rites.name: Amalus
rites.text: A combined strike in which a wooden growth is first raised against a foe, then a crackling blade-charge is driven through it to hit the target.

rites.name: Raustium
rites.text: A rider on a drifting cloud of grit gathers a small pool of loose powder into the air and steers it downward. Just before striking, the stream fractures into many smaller streams that spread across a wider area.

rites.name: Cianes
rites.text: A practitioner touches another person to wipe away chosen recollections, leaving the subject unconscious. A flick to the brow later brings the lost memories back.

rites.name: Orastia
rites.text: A fighter launches an opponent into the air, then hurls several marked blades around them. The fighter blinks from blade to blade, striking as they go, and finishes by piercing the foe from above with one of the blades.

rites.name: Serontor
rites.text: A practitioner shapes three lion-like shrouds of inner force and hurls them at a foe, knocking the opponent off their feet.

rites.name: Corollor
rites.text: A practitioner encases a lone target in a tight shell of pink crystal. Shattering the shell breaks the captive apart with the shards, unless the captive wraps their life-force around themselves before the closing.

rites.name: Rastolles
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with three quick blows, then dissolves into rosy haze and reappears behind them. A final thrust to the back launches the foe skyward.

rites.name: Orires
rites.text: A fighter dashes forward at blinding speed and slams an opponent with a sweeping arm, sometimes wreathed in crackling energy. The blow can shatter a chest and leave the victim fatally wounded without swift care.

rites.name: Amestes
rites.text: A rare inherited gaze that glows crimson and lets its bearer sway minds through eye contact or touch. It also lets the bearer command the iron held within living blood.

rites.name: Rellanum
rites.text: A remedial craft devised long ago to free practitioners from a dangerous binding seal. It is later used to restore the sight of a wounded warrior.

rites.name: Amirnium
rites.text: A bearer takes on a feline spirit form and exhales a great blazing sphere that strikes a chosen mark. The blast is strong enough to reduce a large structure to rubble and to melt hard stone in a single shot.

rites.name: Tireoles
rites.text: A bound practice where a wielder first unbalances a rival with a spiraling sweep, then hurls them upward with a swirling burst. Only the wielder in a specific heavy armored guise can perform it.

rites.name: Siarium
rites.text: A fighter leaps backward and unleashes a crackling sphere of charged energy at an enemy. She then strikes with a blade wreathed in lightning and finishes with a sweeping blow that drives the foe into the ground.

rites.name: Tauntus
rites.text: A fighter spins a chained blade in a wide arc, scattering a ring of volatile charges that detonate when they strike a foe.

rites.name: Telausia
rites.text: A practitioner casts a hallucinatory gloom over a foe's sight, leaving them seeing only blackness, like a fall into a deep pit. The blinded victim becomes exposed, though a skilled defender can still sense blows and track the caster by scent.

rites.name: Neostor
rites.text: A fighter shrinks a slim spike and hurls it at a foe, then swells it so the foe is pinned in place. While the foe is held fast, a heavy block is dropped onto them.

rites.name: Mianarium
