rites.text: A second set of arms grows from a bearer's limb while another spirit shares the body. Their combined strikes hit harder, enough to break stone, or the extra hands seize a foe so the blow lands cleanly.

rites.name: Corosor
rites.text: A close-quarters striking discipline in which the practitioner crouches and spreads both arms to sever the flow of inner energy through many points on a foe's body. Repeated doubling blows arrive so quickly that they can reach a great number of targets in moments.

rites.name: Telasia
rites.text: A craft that bends the senses of its target through inner energy, producing false sights and trances that feel real only to the one ensnared. It belongs to a shadowy current of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Cilausia
rites.text: A practitioner exhales crackling bolts shaped like spears that pierce stone and foes alike. The bolts can multiply to strike several targets, or gather into a single searing beam.

rites.name: Lelanum
rites.text: Two fused companions form a spinning twin-pronged drill that pierces an opponent and hurls them skyward. One prong then strikes the foe mid-air and tears through them, casting the body aside.

rites.name: Tiraustum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a huge fist from fine metal grit and steers it with magnetic force. The fist can wrap around its user as a shield or strike at foes from afar.

rites.name: Sauseolium
rites.text: A fighter uses borrowed power from a plated suit to hurl a rival skyward, then follows with a headbutt and a crushing stomp that splits the earth and sends fire rippling outward.

rites.name: Oreostus
rites.text: A bearer gathers a great store of inner power and shapes it into four vast spectral limbs. These limbs can push back the great armored guardian spirit of a rival.

rites.name: Oraunes
rites.text: A bearer shapes a spirit-giant into a guardian armour for a fierce beast, sheltering it from being bound. The beast can also wield the giant's blades and fuse them with its own orbs so they cut through anything and cannot be caught.

rites.name: Rinum
rites.text: A duelist summons three mirrored copies of themselves that advance in a curved line, each drawing crackling storm force through a blade of pale radiance. Foes lose their footing and any snares they had laid are exposed.

rites.name: Taselum
rites.text: Two fighters open their inner limits and combine a launch, a spin, and a blazing finish. Their rising strikes end with a fiery burst that scatters flame across the battlefield.

rites.name: Mantiasia
rites.text: A user hurls a burst of tiny fireballs that scatter into a swarm of darting flames. Each flame is steered by will toward a target, and small blades can be hidden inside the fire to strike harder.

rites.name: Rasistor
rites.text: A bearer gives away living tissue to a compatible ally, healing their wounds while the giver grows younger in appearance. The change lasts only a time and can be undone by a paired counter-rite.

rites.name: Oreollaunum
rites.text: A practitioner perceives beyond a guarding ward into the hostile ground behind it and breaks the ward at its root from within. Companions pour their inner energy into the one doing the breaking.

rites.name: Sentollor
rites.text: A bearer widens a ring of molten fire that can be sealed into a missile, reshaping it into a spiral. The trapped heat then bursts outward in a pressure blast that dissolves the missile into a storm of flame.

rites.name: Lolus
rites.text: Two wielders join the tips of their blades so a strong charge leaps between the metal. The discharge strikes several foes at the same moment.

rites.name: Selus
rites.text: A user wraps their body in a clear blue crystal prism that floats in place and shields them from nearly any assault. From its tip they can also unleash focused blasts of intense heat.

rites.name: Seroresanum
rites.text: A stronger form of an earlier stone-lightening craft that lessens the heaviness of a chosen target far beyond the original. Practitioners can lift vast masses, such as falling space stone or floating land, that they could never move otherwise.

rites.name: Riantia
rites.text: A bearer can emit high-pitched pulses and understand their echoes, letting them converse with winged night hunters. The bearer directs these creatures to scout nearby ground and can unleash their sound as a forceful blast.

rites.name: Orillium
rites.text: A brutal grappling discipline in which a fighter shifts their mass with careful footwork and sweeping limb motions to shatter foes. When an inner binding is unleashed, the wielder's strength swells enough to hurl an ally's giant form.

rites.name: Carus
rites.text: A rider on a great sculpted flyer releases a swarm of small crawling figures toward a foe. Shaped figures then form a dome and detonate in a timed sequence, finally blasting together in a huge fiery sphere.

rites.name: Oresialium
rites.text: A forbidden craft in which a practitioner raises two lifeless copies of themselves to strike an enemy. The caster then cuts the foe with a glowing blade of drawn-out life-force.

rites.name: Mirnales
rites.text: A practitioner calls three lifeless doubles of themselves from a sealed cache. One slips beneath the ground to strike from behind while the others slash with glowing blades, and a final burst of energy erupts upward to finish the target.

rites.name: Teolor
rites.text: A fighter channels a charged life-energy through a blade or the own body to sharpen strikes and harden defenses. The effect depends on the energy's nature and quantity.

rites.name: Rillernum
rites.text: A fighter drops a heel onto a foe using raw bodily force alone, without any inner energy boost. The blow dents the ground beneath the impact.

rites.name: Aminum
rites.text: A forbidden working opens a gateway that carries a person to any chosen place, slipping past sealed walls of protection. Its maker grows old in an instant and may perish from the cost.

rites.name: Vialintor
rites.text: A practitioner lifts a fine glittering powder skyward to form a dense shielding wall that stops falling projectiles from above. Hand signs shape the barrier, and it can withstand even powerful hail-like barrages.

rites.name: Serostum Ventanum
rites.text: A practitioner wields two cursed blades of shadow energy and cuts an opponent's inner body three times. The third wound proves lethal.

rites.name: Oreollia
rites.text: A halved strike-sequence technique that seals thirty-two flow points in an opponent's inner channels. It quickly cuts their access to energy and leaves them struggling to move.

rites.name: Seostarium
rites.text: A ritual counterpart to the sealing craft that unbinds a bound spirit from its prison, requiring little preparation. It can restore a lost mind by grafting it onto a fresh body.

rites.name: Amostium
rites.text: A practitioner splits their awareness into several copies and pours each copy into a separate nearby body, controlling them all briefly. The original shell stays exposed and unguarded while this happens, and the copies may follow winding paths.

rites.name: Nostirium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter first blinds an opponent, then hurls several charged blades, and finishes with a wildly spinning throwing star that tears through flesh.

rites.name: Villium
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a rose-tinted crystal dome around a chosen person. The shell resists harm from outside and within, and it can shelter someone or hold them in place.

rites.name: Telianum
rites.text: Two artisans combine their craft so that clay bursts and sand blades carry the bursting pieces toward a foe. The blast is strong enough that a metal shield must be raised to protect them.

rites.name: Caulontanum
rites.text: A user shapes a massive hollow figure of molded earth, rides atop it through the sky toward a rival, and sheds smaller figures that dive down and set off a chain of blasts.

rites.name: Sirneonium
rites.text: A fighter bends one oversized fist to shatter the earth, hurling loose stones skyward. Leaping up, they swing that same fist through the scattered rubble, sending the fragments flying at an opponent.

rites.name: Varnanum
rites.text: A heavyset bearer converts stored body fat into dense inner force that flutters outward like wings. The bearer funnels this force into a single crushing strike that can split the earth, though a dangerous side effect may follow.

rites.name: Rernum Corolerus
rites.text: A duelist strikes an enemy with a crackling blade that hurls them skyward. Dark flames then burst up from the ground to strike the falling foe mid-air.

rites.name: Lonium
rites.text: A paired ambush technique where one fighter ensnares a foe in a mind-trap, then a second fighter strikes from behind or rises from below to finish the victim.

rites.name: Sollor
rites.text: A bearer turns a hidden inner vessel into a volatile reservoir, feeding it dense material until its stored force surges outward and bursts in a vast, far-reaching blast.

rites.name: Telauntalia
rites.text: A bearer draws sharp glowing edges out from the crown of the skull and uses them to strike an enemy with a relentless flurry of quick blows.

rites.name: Meornes Renolor
rites.text: A mind-binding craft in which a practitioner's eyes open a vision that traps a foe in a shared dream. Inside it, the victim seems pinned for days while only a moment passes outside.

rites.name: Teorinor
rites.text: A practitioner presses a palm to solid stone or timber and sends a trickle of inner energy through it. The energy returns a rough picture of rooms, hidden passages, lurking foes, and weak seams.

rites.name: Lostintia
rites.text: A close-quarters striking method that seals sixteen flow points within a foe's inner channels. The victim loses the ability to draw on their power, collapses into unconsciousness, and bleeds internally.

rites.name: Orilus
rites.text: A wielder folds two fingers into the palm and releases hidden wrist cannons that turn an inner force into liquid. The liquid hardens into whips or blades, binds foes together, and can shatter stone before it crumbles away.

rites.name: Valantia
rites.text: A practitioner calls eight loyal beasts to slash across a foe, then follows with a swift, lethal blade stroke. The technique relies on coordinated companions and speed.

rites.name: Valornum
rites.text: A practitioner strikes a foe with a flurry of open-handed blows delivered from many angles while circling, then drives charged palms forward to siphon away the target's inner energy.

rites.name: Vallia
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a crackling current that can strike several targets at once. It can travel great distances and bend around barriers to reach its mark.

rites.name: Orauntillia
rites.text: A bearer draws on a sphere of dark fire held in a spectral limb to hurl rapid curved bolts of burning shadow. Whatever they strike is knocked from its footing and quickly consumed by flame.

rites.name: Coraulia
rites.text: A forbidden craft in which living threads of spirit-force are guided through a body to cut and sever from within. Practitioners use it to end the life of whoever they target.

rites.name: Tirnes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a crackling inner force and shapes it into a flying bolt that can be hurled at foes. Adepts may also mingle it with flowing water to shock an enemy.

rites.name: Cosia
rites.text: A binding craft that fixes a great beast's power within a living host, turning the chosen person into its vessel. Its markings resemble flowing script, and a companion ritual is needed to complete the bond.

rites.name: Virneones
rites.text: Two fighters coordinate a kick and a tackle that launch a foe skyward. They then slam the foe down together, striking at the same moment.

rites.name: Miasenia
rites.text: A paired striking art in which a handler and their animal companion spin and rain quick blows on a foe. They breathe together and move in lockstep so the target cannot brace, and the churning passes shatter nearby stone.

rites.name: Oriasium
rites.text: A practitioner reaches a open hand toward a wall, which parts into a rippling opening shaped like a door. A sealing mark can also be pressed onto the stone to lock whatever lies beyond it.

rites.name: Serenium
rites.text: A wielder binds a target with spreading rime, either by touch or from afar. The victim freezes unless they can shape their inner energy to hold back the cold, and any effort spent on other workings lets the chill return quickly.

rites.name: Neostanum
rites.text: A guarded craft used by elite sentinels to keep their thoughts sealed against intruders. When an invader slips into the mind, it conjures a dreadful phantom that drives them back, though mastering it can wound the practitioner's own mind.

rites.name: Caunes
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent many times in rapid succession with open hands, hurling them backward. The finishing blow channels focused energy through the fingertips.

rites.name: Liastelor
rites.text: A bladed gale surges outward from a wielder's open palms, pulverizing the ground and everything ahead into dust. Its power strains the caster's arms, so it cannot be repeated quickly.

rites.name: Salum
rites.text: A stealth charge where a wanderer slips through a foe while his body turns insubstantial, scattering volatile marks in his wake. The marks erupt in a blast once he comes to a halt.

rites.name: Larnianus
rites.text: A fighter drives one leg downward in a forceful strike that hurls the opponent backward through the air. Its force is strong enough to smash the rival through several sturdy walls.

rites.name: Valones
rites.text: A user moves their awareness between several identical shells by activating a sealed scroll. Each shell carries its own elemental leanings, and a fallen shell turns to dust, letting the next one take its place.

rites.name: Taullirnia
rites.text: A practitioner strikes an opponent with swift, rapid momentum, then closes the clash with an intensified forceful blow that ends the struggle.

rites.name: Vaulonium
rites.text: A fighter releases a fine cloud of volatile powder that ignites with each blow they land. A final heavy slam sets off a huge blast that finishes the foe.

rites.name: Oronauntia
rites.text: A warrior who has taken on a beast's full power drives two glowing horns forward from an aura of energy and rams the foe. A watching elder says the blow could sever a head.

rites.name: Corontisor
rites.text: A rare inherited craft that lets practitioners produce a pulling force and apply it to other materials for many purposes. It is said to blend two elemental currents, air and stone.

rites.name: Corasium
rites.text: A practice that deepens the pull of the earth on a chosen foe, bending them until they sag and harden toward stone. The practitioner can also bind their own body with weight, trading swiftness for crushing force.

rites.name: Cialanum
rites.text: A fighter lands a rapid flurry of blows, then flips backward to launch the foe skyward with a kick. A second leap sends the opponent even higher.

rites.name: Melor
rites.text: A combined maneuver in which three bound companions take turns striking a foe: one hurls it skyward, another cuts it repeatedly, and a third fires a blast from its jaws to finish the victim.

rites.name: Amisalanum
rites.text: A practitioner sends out two crackling spirit hounds that race in from opposite flanks to strike a foe. The hounds move as a pair, coursing along the ground toward their chosen target.

rites.name: Ciarnor
rites.text: A violet barrier of bright energy presses down on a foe and quickly drains their vital power. Resisting it is very hard, and it only holds its strength when several people wield it together.

rites.name: Leorolum
rites.text: A practitioner channels inner energy into a sticky confection to shape it into hovering spheres, traps, and blasts. Even the smallest sphere can strike an opponent senseless, and its tackiness can bind a foe in place.

rites.name: Valesania
rites.text: Two allies pair their craft, one shaping crackling spheres of lightning while the other charges throwing blades with the same energy. The blades are then hurled at a foe in a combined strike.

rites.name: Telinelus
rites.text: A tactic where a distraction lets a hidden mechanical shell slip behind a foe, its chest opening to fire threads that drag the target inside. Hooked blades then sweep through the sealed shell, slaying the captive.

rites.name: Siaror
rites.text: A practitioner sees hidden channels within a body and then delivers a long rapid flurry of palm strikes. The final blow hurls the target backward through the air.

rites.name: Amirnanum Selles
rites.text: A bodily craft where a wielder pierces a hidden point in the chest, unleashing crimson vapor that boosts strength enormously. The surge burns the wielder from within, though a restorative art can hold death at bay.

rites.name: Sirnum Cerium
rites.text: Two practitioners strike a foe from opposite sides at near-blinding speed, pinching it between crossing currents of lightning. If their forces match exactly, the bind shears the target clean through and hurls the severed head high into the air.

rites.name: Valirneonus
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a round field of sensing around themselves that follows their movements. On command it widens to take in the nearby surroundings, letting them feel any motion within its bounds.

rites.name: Telasum
rites.text: A practitioner rearranges the inner structure of soil or stone until it turns into clear, brittle glass. The transformed material shrugs off lightning, though intense bolts still melt it.

rites.name: Telia
rites.text: A bearer forms a hand sign that sends a strange energy surging into a rival, trading their minds so the bearer wields the rival's full voice and skills. It still works from inside the rival's body.

rites.name: Costus
rites.text: A duplicated fighter first splits into many copies, who each shape a great spinning orb of force. The copies then rush a foe in a single line and drive their orbs into it, dealing heavy harm.

rites.name: Amianium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a crackling charge between the palms, then aims it toward a chosen spot where it bursts into a shaped flash. Raised toward the heavens, the flash serves as a bright warning or call for others to gather.

rites.name: Tosaurnium
rites.text: A fighter leaps into the air, strikes several quick cuts, and ends with a forceful spinning blow that hurls the foe down onto the ground.

rites.name: Teollintes
rites.text: A jumper multiplies into many copies that link into a long chain whip. A partner spins the chain into a whirling storm and slams it down on a foe with great force.

rites.name: Ceorium
rites.text: A fighter calls forth a twin copy of herself, and the two strike in sequence. One opens with a kick, the second follows with a punch from behind, and together they launch an opponent skyward and drive them aside.

rites.name: Maurnolia
rites.text: A wielder channels storm energy through a heavy blade and drives it into the earth, sending a jolt that numbs a nearby foe. A sweeping strike then hurls the stunned enemy away.

rites.name: Resus
rites.text: Two craftsmen join their arts, one animating a hidden metal swarm while the other seeds bursting clay creatures on its barbs. The strike explodes against the target and leaves a lingering venom behind.

rites.name: Nalia
rites.text: A binding craft where a caster wraps a foe in dark metal grains, then sets a bitten sigil that freezes the victim's motion. The foe is finally sealed inside a heavy sand coffin.

rites.name: Calonus
rites.text: A duelist gathers crackling force into an enlarged blade-shaped surge, then splits it into two halves. One half strikes an opponent upward, and the wielder reappears above to unleash the rest in a spiraling storm that drives them down.

rites.name: Amostia
rites.text: A bearer converts drawn-in energy into pale blue flames and hurls them back at foes with greater force. The flames burst out through a square marking on the hand.

rites.name: Saulerium
rites.text: Two craftsfolk combine a surge of wind and a blaze into a towering whirl of flame. A third fighter leaps into the fire, shattering a set of hovering gates with a powerful strike.

rites.name: Corosanum
rites.text: A paired technique where one practitioner conjures a serpentine torrent that a partner freezes and hurls at a foe, sealing them in a frozen column. The partner then strikes from the ice around them before a final rising blow shatters the column.

rites.name: Vernor Callirnor
rites.text: A user rises a pale rose lattice from the ground to imprison foes wholly within its faceted walls. Once the lattice cracks, the captives crumble into dust together with its fragments, leaving frost-like marks on any who survived long enough to be studied.

rites.name: Nereornus
rites.text: Allies open shifting gateways to strike a foe from several directions at once. One fighter dives from above with a modified limb, another follows with a blast-powered blow, and a third rains fire below while a heavy block falls on the target.

rites.name: Seoliror
rites.text: A fighter conjures rose-tinted crystal blades shaped like snowflakes and hurls them at a foe. Spinning them adds deadly force, and on impact they splinter into many shards that can cut through thick wood.

rites.name: Siniarnum
rites.text: A bloodline gift lets a lineage of people draw in the raw energy of the natural world on instinct, without any formal teaching. It flows through their family alone.

rites.name: Siarnires
rites.text: A bearer briefly takes on the shape of a great spirit beast tied to their soul. Each form grants a distinct attack, such as a fiery plunge, a spinning sweep, a bubbling mass, or a rushing gust of wind.

rites.name: Liantelanum
rites.text: A fighter strikes a foe twice, hurls them skyward, leaps after them, and slams them back down. Bound by heavy throwing blades, the foe is then drilled into the ground by a spinning barrage, and keeps whirling along the earth after the fighter lets go.

rites.name: Sasornum
rites.text: A practitioner releases two serpents of dark frost that fuse into one enormous spiraling storm. The craft works by commanding frost already present rather than conjuring new cold.

rites.name: Orisanum Leornorum
rites.text: A fighter spins toward a rival and unleashes a rapid flurry of strikes and kicks. It is a close-combat technique that relies on speed and continuous motion.

rites.name: Viasanum Ceontaustia
rites.text: A dark tide is shaped into a binding wave that holds a rival in place, while towering frozen blocks are raised to fall upon them.

rites.name: Coronum
rites.text: A fighter raises a knee and drives an elbow down together to trap an incoming limb between them. The force crushes the bone and can sideline an opponent for a long recovery.

rites.name: Serelantus
rites.text: A ritual gaze drawn from a seer's eyes that calls down a towering column of black fire to consume a foe. Once the flames fade, the seer slips into a dreamlike trance state.

rites.name: Viarases
rites.text: A wielder gathers existing frost and shapes it into a huge striking beast of ice. The frozen form is so cold that it halts any water-based art it touches.

rites.name: Visares
rites.text: A practitioner calls down bolts of crackling energy, drawing them from thunderclouds or from their own body. The bolts can be guided through built structures so they strike a target from several directions at once.

rites.name: Launtanum
rites.text: A practitioner charges their blade with crackling energy and dashes at a foe at great speed. They seize the enemy, drag them across the ground for a long stretch, and then hurl them away.

rites.name: Coriantanum
rites.text: A binding ritual that severs a caller's command over a bound creature when the two are held close together. It frees the creature without placing it under the ritual's user, and the creature's time spent in the world is no longer limited.

rites.name: Sanor
rites.text: A fighter lands a few blows, then slips behind a rival to slash upward with a blade. Chains then hurl the rival skyward, and the fighter reappears behind them to finish with a rising spinning kick.

rites.name: Seriantia
rites.text: A practitioner releases a surge of crackling energy that splits into several destructive discs of power. The discs curve through the air and seek out their chosen targets.

rites.name: Coreornia
rites.text: A caster conjures a spinning twin of herself wreathed in pale petals that form a swirling wall. The wall strikes a foe again and again, then lifts them off the ground.

rites.name: Niallorium
rites.text: A practitioner moves swiftly toward a goal while shifting their body into an intangible state. In this form, incoming blows pass harmlessly through them without causing any injury.

rites.name: Cianus Corasteonor
rites.text: A wielder leaps skyward and gathers all inner energy into a colossal glowing fist. Plunging back down, the wielder drives that fist with full force into a foe.

rites.name: Raunia
rites.text: A practitioner draws life-force into their fingertips and shapes it into an unseen blade of moving air. Its hidden edge is so precisely guided that foes struggle to ward it off, and it outclasses a lesser cutting art the way a long sword outclasses a hand blade.

rites.name: Caunus
rites.text: A disciplined fighting art where a practitioner stores a focused inner energy in the limbs and releases it at the exact moment of impact, shattering ground or foes with one blow. Mastery demands grueling repetition under relentless pressure from a teacher.

rites.name: Cirnasanum
rites.text: A practitioner lengthens one of their arms far beyond the normal reach of a body. The stretched limb can snatch up a companion who has fallen or hurl an enemy across the field.

rites.name: Tania Amianauria
rites.text: A joint technique in which a wielder and one or more allies coordinate to unleash a combined strike upon a foe. The exact moves shift from one contest to another.

rites.name: Rernollus
rites.text: A fighter opens seven inner energy gates, then kicks a rival high into the air. Leaping after them, the fighter drives the foe back down with a punch charged by that same inner power.

rites.name: Venium
rites.text: A practitioner uses a reflective crystal surface to bring forth six copies of themselves. The copies resist harm better than ordinary illusory doubles, and they can fool keen-eyed observers unless those watchers concentrate their gaze.

rites.name: Mosirnor
rites.text: A bearer, fully changed by a marked sigil of ascension, strikes foes with fists, feet, and a spinning winged assault. Then the bearer swings a crackling blade to finish the clash.

rites.name: Sostor
rites.text: A practitioner drives a reshaped limb into a foe and unleashes a massive bolt of gathered inner energy drawn from a hidden core, reducing the target to nothing.

rites.name: Leseontanum
rites.text: A bluish-green craft that fuses a spinning orb of force with energy drawn from a sacred stone. It can be paired with a second fiery orb, and it can scorch parts of a foe's body.

rites.name: Cisanum
rites.text: A practitioner vaults above a foe, lengthens their own bones into long spikes, and then spins downward like a great boring drill that tears straight through the target.

rites.name: Niantaustia
rites.text: A practitioner places tiny reshaped scales around a rival, then swells them back to full size so they close inward and press against the target.

rites.name: Oraustisia
rites.text: A bearer can mend wounds swiftly and transform into a huge pale serpent. Its user can shed a damaged frame to regrow a flawless body, and the power can pass to others through shared inheritance.

rites.name: Meostisia
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a caster fuses several sphere-shaped seekers into one larger orb and hurls it at a foe. The fused orb is aimed straight at the target.

rites.name: Amianentor
rites.text: A bearer hurls a foe into a shifted realm where stakes pierce them, then calls down a massive block to crush them into place.

rites.name: Cornor
rites.text: A user forms a precise hand gesture and shifts into a horned, armored insect form. In this shape they can charge with horns, exhale a toxic cloud, and leap to crash down on foes, though the soft underside stays exposed.

rites.name: Serilianium
rites.text: A bearer enters a fierce surge of crimson energy that wraps their body. They strike a foe with a punch, slam them to the ground, then finish with a crushing upward blow.

rites.name: Launum
rites.text: A fighter hurls a swift, forceful kick from raw bodily power that can shatter an armored guardian spirit and throw its wielder out of the shell.

rites.name: Amiarnistus
rites.text: A bound warrior rides a beast into battle, strikes a foe with a curved blade, and lays a lethal hex on them. When the wielder's partner unleashes elemental blasts, the cursed enemy suffers the same harm dealt to the wielder.

rites.name: Sauriantor
rites.text: A bearer coats their body in grains and draws in air through many openings until they swell, then exhales a storm that sweeps a broad area. The gale topples growth and batters all who stand before it.

rites.name: Teria
rites.text: A joint craft that draws a rotating stream of water into a spinning cloud of concentrated mist. The swirling vapour hardens into a barrier, blinds opponents, and can serve as cover for an escape or a sudden strike.

rites.name: Vinum
rites.text: A fighter splits off a duplicate of themselves that hurls a spinning sphere of force. The sphere gains speed from the spin, lifts the foe skyward, and bursts outward on impact.

rites.name: Veoria
rites.text: A bearer in their second awakened state grows several thruster-like limbs that draw ambient life-force into them. They then unleash a wide, rapid burst of gathered power that cannot be dodged by ordinary means.

rites.name: Seraunor
rites.text: A great beast weaves dark crimson energy into spinning spheres that orbit its body and burn whoever touches them. The spheres then scatter outward, spinning faster and faster until they vanish, a technique seen only in the hands of an imposter.

rites.name: Nianor
rites.text: Two combatants fuse a spinning sphere of gale-wind with crackling lightning and drive it into an opponent. The merged craft unites their separate powers into a single piercing strike.

rites.name: Sereolia Tosteonor
rites.text: A practitioner releases a pale serpentine shadow from their body that strikes an adversary and sinks into the earth. It then emerges behind the foe to strike again before returning to its owner.

rites.name: Orestes
rites.text: A fighter swings a heavy cooking pan against a foe several times, follows with a flurry of kicks, then uses the pan to launch the opponent skyward.

rites.name: Celirnor
rites.text: A fighter leaps into the air and drops onto a foe with a hand strike charged with crackling storm energy. The blow comes down fast from above.

rites.name: Oraullor
rites.text: A practitioner can briefly enlarge parts of the body or the whole frame on command. Swelling the midsection lets it whirl with rapid force, while full-body growth lets them shove aside nearby blows.

rites.name: Coristium
rites.text: A dormant sealing art that binds a hidden ward inside a person's gaze, waking on its own when conditions set by the caster are met. Its bearer may use it to turn a final end into an illusion.

rites.name: Amiror
rites.text: A forbidden binding ritual in which one caster clasps a captive's hand and forces it to help shape the seals, sealing both their fates together. The ritual's effects have never been witnessed in practice.

rites.name: Maullirum
rites.text: An enhanced spinning sphere of drawn power that grows larger and lasts longer. The bearer slowly sweeps across an area, harming anything in the path while draining energy from the bearer.

rites.name: Valoniastum
rites.text: A broad, catch-all art that covers any power outside the mind-clouding and body-training crafts. Most of its workings draw on an inner energy and hand gestures, though plain tools can also count.

rites.name: Ameonelus
rites.text: A practitioner draws up a column of hidden subterranean water and shapes it into a pressurized cutting blade. The blade can slice through solid flesh and bone, and can also be reshaped into a piercing spear.

rites.name: Oroses Taurnialus
rites.text: A fighter hurls crackling bolts of stormlight at a foe, then leaps and cuts with a blade humming with captured lightning. The strike combines ranged bursts with a close-quarters finishing slash.

rites.name: Leranum
rites.text: A bound wielder lifts a foe skyward with silken cords, then unleashes three stacked storms of spark, flame, and gale from concealed faces.

rites.name: Taustium
rites.text: A practitioner marks chosen objects with a sigil on the palm and then moves them by will alone. Such marked things can be shaped into tools, blades, or shields.

rites.name: Telonilium
rites.text: A practitioner calls five gates into being at once without any gestures, shifting their placement to block or turn aside incoming assaults. Even the strongest blasts are redirected while the gates remain standing.

rites.name: Noreosum
rites.text: A fighter sweeps an opponent off their feet, launches them skyward, and strikes from behind. Then the fighter unleashes a restrained inner power and drives a crushing punch into the target's face.

rites.name: Lauria
rites.text: A combined maneuver in which a wooden pillar strikes a foe, winged ink birds harry the target from above, and a second pillar drives the foe down into the ground.

rites.name: Lentilus
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a throwing blade and, by channeling inner energy into it, swells the weapon to enormous size. The oversized blade then smashes into a foe and hurls them backward through the air.

rites.name: Nornum
rites.text: A craft that fuses two opposing forces, one spiritual and one physical, which together make up the inner energy used by every technique. Its wielders can create living forms from nothing, restore fallen bodies, and undo the workings of other arts.

rites.name: Ceontaurus
rites.text: A bearer calls forth a towering spectral limb wielding a blazing blade of dark flame. A single downward stroke from it strikes at a chosen foe.

rites.name: Telastus
rites.text: A fighter opens hidden inner reserves, then unleashes a rapid flurry of strikes and kicks ending with a single decisive blow against the foe.

rites.name: Serestianum
rites.text: A life-giving current that flows through living matter to channel vitality. It can awaken forms that never held life, and certain bloodlines pass it down through their families.

rites.name: Seriniarus
rites.text: A wielder fills a straight double-edged sword with crackling lightning so the blade hums and nearly cannot be parried. A struck foe's limbs seize from a jolt and they become unable to move, though other lightning-channeling swords can counter it.

rites.name: Valernum
rites.text: A fighter in a surging, beast-touched state vaults through the air, lands atop a foe, and strikes with a fist too quick to follow.

rites.name: Casontum
rites.text: A user of sand shapes a jagged crack in the ground beneath a foe, then a great beast-like sand mass rises from it, swallows the target, and buries them deep. The sand then collapses inward, leaving a vast pit that crushes the victim completely.

rites.name: Sosum
rites.text: A bound-arm trick in which a hidden puppet creeps behind a foe to pin their limbs. A second puppet then charges in with a mouth bomb that detonates on contact.

rites.name: Corosus
rites.text: A bearer charges a small orb of raw force within one eye and releases it as a piercing bolt or beam that strikes distant targets. The bearer decides whether the orb bursts upon impact.

rites.name: Reosum
rites.text: A wide, still disc of water is raised before an adversary, its surface mirroring every incoming strike. Turning the disc a quarter-circle with a staff sends the reflected blows back out, cancelling the attack, then they dissolve into spray.

rites.name: Telentus Sausia
rites.text: A user guides a sharp blade through the air by mirroring hand gestures, keeping it in use even after it has been dropped. The weapon can strike foes from behind before they can react.

rites.name: Viarnus
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent, rises skyward while shedding fragments, then spins into a drilling dive. At the last instant a spark ignites the swirling fragment cloud, causing a violent blast.

rites.name: Vauntum
rites.text: A user hurls small pale pouches that break apart and scatter sparks disguised as drifting petals. Sharp blades strike the pouches and the sparks settle onto a target before a final charge detonates them in a blast that devastates the opponent.

rites.name: Veornastus
rites.text: A bearer slams a foe into the ground, then splits into duplicates; one duplicate forms a lesser swirling charge that another strikes the foe with. The combined assault turns the downed opponent into a target of layered force.

rites.name: Misallia
rites.text: A practitioner gazes into a clear orb to watch the present doings of anyone whose inner energy signature they recognize. Distance and walls mean nothing, so the craft serves watchers gathering secret knowledge and keeping a community orderly.

rites.name: Reneostium
rites.text: A bearer of great inner power fashions twin spinning orbs from their palms and two gathered balls of drawn energy from their outstretched arms. The attack strikes both nearby foes and those standing farther away.

rites.name: Cistaunes
rites.text: A bearer whose altered frame bursts apart once they fall, denying foes any chance to study it or harming those who struck them down. Spare vessels kept in reserve let the mind move into a fresh shell.

rites.name: Corestanes
rites.text: A practitioner turns one hand into a sheet of folded fabric to strike a foe, then spins and does the same with the other hand. Two swarms of small winged sheets follow, before a final blow sends the opponent flying backward.

rites.name: Amausestor
rites.text: A bathed creature's great tail-heads loose violet-amber energy bolts strong enough to slice through stone and wound even its own transformed core.

rites.name: Vornanum
rites.text: A binding craft where a pair of great serpents spit out smaller serpents in twos, which in turn spawn further serpents to ensnare a chosen target. The coils shrink the farther they spread from the source.

rites.name: Rallornes
rites.text: A user hides countless volatile markers within the surrounding ground or water so they blend perfectly with it. On command the terrain splits open into a deep pit, and the markers cling to the falling target and explode in a long chain of blasts.

rites.name: Ventaulium
rites.text: A bearer can silently share thoughts with duplicate selves created from their own body. Each copy sends gathered knowledge back to the original, letting the bearer direct many copies at once while passing unnoticed among a target's trusted circle.

rites.name: Ciasanum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes many small clay creatures that swarm over a foe and burst apart upon touching them.

rites.name: Seraulisium
rites.text: A bearer strikes an enemy with a spinning orb of gathered force, boosted by two allies who pour their energy into the bearer's hand. The blow hurls the foe far away and ends in a burst.

rites.name: Serillanum Vosium
rites.text: A ritual craft that moves the entire vital force of a bound titan from one living vessel into another. It lets a skilled practitioner hand the captive power over to a new host.

rites.name: Tellia
rites.text: Trained seekers shape their inner vital force into a sensing form that lets them locate others by the traces their life-energy leaves behind. How far a seeker can feel varies from one practitioner to the next.

rites.name: Sarnia
rites.text: A practitioner reads an opponent's face and motions to foresee where a blow will land, then channels life-energy into that spot to begin mending before impact. Greater injuries drain more energy, and only those with unusual endurance can sustain the practice.

rites.name: Niales
rites.text: A practitioner raises a glowing halo of energy around their hands and releases several beams that can curve mid-flight to hit many foes. The beams can be multiplied to pin an enemy down.

rites.name: Sisor
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner form a glowing likeness of themselves in the air, allowing them to carry a message to distant listeners.

rites.name: Valesaustia
rites.text: A practitioner shapes flowing liquid into a long cord that coils around a foe. The same cord can carry a crackling charge through whatever it has bound, and it overpowers living growth summoned against it.

rites.name: Telaunia
rites.text: A fighter strikes an enemy beneath the jaw, kicks them skyward three times, then reappears beneath the falling foe and drives a blow into their middle that hurls them into nearby objects.

rites.name: Amaustum
rites.text: A fighter in a dark, transformed state leaps skyward to hurl a foe into the air, then chases them down with a spinning kick that drives them into the earth, ending with a crackling strike of lightning.

rites.name: Neollium
rites.text: A practitioner molds the flow, form, and force of inner energy, deciding how large, far-reaching, and purposeful a technique becomes. The highest mastery compresses spinning energy into a perfect sphere without any gestures.

rites.name: Laules
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a rapid run of blade cuts, a crackling lightning thrust, and a dark burning blade. The final swing releases a volley of black fire spikes.

rites.name: Serianeores
rites.text: A bearer enters a transformed state and strikes an opponent with heightened force and quickness. Two linked spinners then pin the foe from opposite sides and crush them.

rites.name: Coraullia
rites.text: A coordinated three-part attack in which one fighter hurls a foe into the air, a second drives them further with a swarm of tiny carriers, and a third takes a copied form to deliver the final blow.

rites.name: Ceolirnanum
rites.text: A rare craft of bending air into spinning funnels that tear apart everything nearby. It is a stronger form of basic wind mastery, and only one practitioner is known to wield it.

rites.name: Aminallor
rites.text: A being pounds its belly to force a compressed ball of charged gusts from its wide maw. The blast tears through the land in a straight line and detonates on impact, and repeated strikes can overwhelm a foe.

rites.name: Sereontus
rites.text: A colossal spectral gauntlet clutches a foe and squeezes them within its grip. The technique is used by a warrior in close combat to crush an opponent.

rites.name: Coriallia
rites.text: A practitioner presses a palm against solid stone or wood to send a ripple through it, allowing distant companions to exchange messages. The ripple gives off a low, gusting sound like a rushing wind.

rites.name: Tialirnor
rites.text: A practitioner first forms a small spinning sphere of force that bends the earth beneath it. While it still touches the target, a larger sphere is formed and merged with it, shattering the ground under the blow.

rites.name: Casaurnes
rites.text: A bearer channels a gathering of luminous orbs into the earth, releasing a dark ripple that calls forth flickering fire and violet sparks around them. The surge rolls outward through the surrounding ground.

rites.name: Maranum Raurus
rites.text: A lesser version of a greater celestial working, its caster calls down a scattering of small falling stars upon the foe.

rites.name: Orantorium
rites.text: Two practitioners combine their gifts: one raises a spinning funnel of air toward a foe, and the other sends a crackling current through it. The combined assault leaves the target badly harmed.

rites.name: Telontaria
rites.text: A bonded artist draws several inks of winged creatures on a scroll, and the figures leap free to strike at an opponent. The technique turns sketched ink into living airborne attackers.

rites.name: Ciarnollia
rites.text: A bending craft that sends a foe into a hidden pocket realm, then closes stone-like formations around them to crush them.

rites.name: Valestisium
rites.text: A practitioner breathes in deeply and releases several small gusts that scatter in many directions, hard to dodge without being cut. The gusts can pierce flesh, and a skilled user can compress the air into a spherical blast that shatters a wooden barrier.

rites.name: Seonilles
rites.text: A combined tactic in which one fighter binds a foe by stretching their shadow into threads, while a second fighter sends duplicate copies to strike the immobilized target.

rites.name: Seraullium
rites.text: A practitioner moves through space in a jagged, darting path to reach a foe, then strikes with two swirling orbs of raw energy, one in each hand.

rites.name: Rilleontium
rites.text: A practitioner swings a curved cut toward a foe, sending a crimson pulse of energy outward from the blade. The technique is a simple, sharp arc of force.

rites.name: Rerium Viallernes
rites.text: A bound beast-power is wielded in a whirling sequence of claw swipes, tail sweeps, and a second spectral body that strikes alongside the user. The flurry ends with a heavy downward double swipe that finishes the assault.

rites.name: Amirnia
rites.text: A fighter lowers their stance, spins into an opponent with a knee strike, then kicks them back, lifts them skyward, and finishes with a rapid flurry of kicks to the torso that drives them down.

rites.name: Valanium
rites.text: A user slams their hands onto a vast flow of sand that has already trapped a foe, compressing it into a massive grinding crush. The victim is squeezed until immobile and then killed, though those with reinforced bones can endure it.

rites.name: Serarnium
rites.text: A bearer in a furious form raises a limb of pure energy that conjures several spinning orbs above the head. Extra limbs grip these orbs and strike many foes at the same moment.

rites.name: Orillia
rites.text: A bearer opens several inner energy gates, leaps high into the air in a blazing star-like form, and plunges onto a foe, detonating a burst on impact.

rites.name: Terum
rites.text: A practitioner steadily pours inner energy into a cutting edge, making it keener and tougher so it never breaks apart. The method is fragile, demanding unbroken concentration to stay in effect.

rites.name: Seorestium
rites.text: A bearer channels a towering spirit-shell that spews a barrage of blazing orbs of varying size, some as huge as a beast. The orbs fizzle harmlessly when struck hard enough, and when hurled skyward they gather storm clouds that call down lightning.

rites.name: Cillium
rites.text: A rare inherited gift lets its bearer reshape their own skeleton at will. It seldom appears within one bloodline, and the last of that line carried it alone.

rites.name: Ceoliastes
rites.text: A user releases a fine airborne toxin that a victim breathes in, letting the user dictate false visions to the victim. Once the victim is trapped inside these visions, the user strikes and finishes them.

rites.name: Calia
rites.text: A colossal spinning gale is called forth by its wielder, strong enough to push back a towering guardian spirit. Its weakness lies at the calm center, where the caster stands exposed to an attacker who slips in.

rites.name: Nonestum
rites.text: An ancestral ocular inheritance that marks the eyes with crimson coloring, ripple-like patterns, and nine small swirl marks. It is the earlier form from which two stronger visions later emerged.

rites.name: Lerianes
rites.text: A bearer enters a fierce beast-bound form and forms nine swirling spheres within its appendages. Each sphere is hurled at a foe, bursting in a chain of blasts.

rites.name: Cires
rites.text: A mask-borne storm technique that compresses a whirling mass of air until it is extremely dense, then releases it in a wide blast. It can also be paired with flame to create a vast firestorm.

rites.name: Amostialium
rites.text: A user gathers a dense cloud of chitinous swarm-creatures into a towering column that collapses onto a foe. The swarm then churns into a spiraling vortex that pulls the target underground before erupting upward and bursting apart.

rites.name: Montaurus
rites.text: A fighter leaps high, strikes rapidly with a blade while spinning, then plunges down onto the foe with a crackling lightning-charged thrust.

rites.name: Valires
rites.text: Masked wardens hurl spectral sheaths that snare a foe inside a spinning vortex of crackling charge. The vortex erupts after several strikes land.

rites.name: Risanum
rites.text: A fighter rushes forward and strikes an enemy with an open palm carrying a volatile charge. The blow hurls the foe across the ground, and the charge bursts once they land.

rites.name: Ciasternes
rites.text: A user spins two mechanical figures around a foe at speed, releasing a choking toxic cloud that blinds the victim. Then the figures unleash a rapid volley of needle-like spikes from their arms.

rites.name: Amillornor
rites.text: A combined art of heat and gust that a pair of allied fighters forge together. One practitioner draws the moisture out of an enemy's body until only a dried husk remains, and the art falters against currents of flowing water.

rites.name: Valonum
rites.text: A bearer draws energy from everyone bound by a hidden dream-snare and channels it into a towering spirit blade. The stolen vigor swells the weapon's length.

rites.name: Meontaurnia
rites.text: A bladed, many-jointed war-form extends extra spikes along its segmented frame and whirls each joint at once. The spinning churns powerful gusts that tear across everything nearby.

rites.name: Miastus
rites.text: A practitioner uses their own shadow to split the earth beneath a nearby foe and seize control of them. The bound shadow then spins into a small whirlwind that strikes the controlled target and anyone who draws close.

rites.name: Moriantes
rites.text: A bearer marks tags to call forth five primal forces. Flame, stone-quake, rushing water, cutting gale, and crackling storm can each be hurled at a foe.

rites.name: Tiallaunum
rites.text: A practitioner unfolds a single bound sheet bearing a binding glyph, releasing a swarm of minute folded scraps that swirl around a foe and blind them. The same cloud lets the caster slip unseen within its drifting veil.

rites.name: Veollium
rites.text: A fighter wields a huge spectral guardian limb to strike an opponent away with a powerful blow. The technique is used to knock foes aside in close combat.

rites.name: Siastor
rites.text: A fighter launches a foe skyward with a kick, hurls a marked blade, and reappears beside the target to strike again. The sequence closes with a spinning sphere of force driven into the falling opponent on the ground.

rites.name: Valesauntus
rites.text: A piper sounds a closing tune that calls forth many-mouthed wormlike spirits made of unseen force. They hunt the living for bodily strength, and only silencing the piper or the caller ends their chase.

rites.name: Lenarnor
rites.text: A practitioner can mend three people at once, or instead restore a single stand-in. It is a common, fundamental restorative art that most healers learn early.

rites.name: Soles
rites.text: A practitioner calls a swarm of countless black birds that multiply endlessly, enveloping a foe and blinding them. The birds obey guided pulses sent through the fingertips and vanish in a burst of vapor when no longer needed.

rites.name: Veostarus
rites.text: A bearer of a great armored construct unleashes a violet lightning beam from its towering shape. The beam strikes with crackling force against foes.

rites.name: Valeosus
rites.text: A fighter darts past a foe, striking rapidly along the back and front before a spinning palm strike hurls the opponent skyward. A final flurry of blows at blinding speed sends them soaring in a blast of energy.

rites.name: Sontium
rites.text: Three allied fighters combine their techniques, teleporting in turn and striking one foe with blades, fire, and lightning. Each attack is answered by the next in a rapid chain.

rites.name: Teornia Ciastolor
rites.text: A bonded fighter and beast fuse into one twin-headed monstrous form that spins in a violent rampage. The surge is strong enough to shatter several barriers in a row, and it needs no prior marking to begin.

rites.name: Nernium
rites.text: A swirling orb of energy is merged from two sources and drilled into a foe, dealing heavy harm. Many coiling streams wrap the bearer's body, deflecting incoming strikes, while the sphere flickers and warps.

rites.name: Naulanum
rites.text: A combat discipline that blends channeled elemental energy with bodily martial strikes. Its practitioners wrap themselves in a crackling aura that sharpens their strength, durability, speed, and reflexes far beyond the norm.

rites.name: Meosiastor
rites.text: A fighter and a copy of themselves chain together a flurry of strikes against a foe. They finish by conjuring a small whirlwind that hurls the copy skyward, where it delivers a rising kick.

rites.name: Coreseollum
rites.text: A practitioner exhales a rush of moving air that sweeps away whatever stands before them. The strength of the gust depends on the user's skill, and a skilled one can uproot whole trees.

rites.name: Venes
rites.text: A practitioner seizes control of ten separate bodies and directs them to strike one point from every side simultaneously. The coordinated assault leaves the target almost no moment to respond.

rites.name: Tastaullium
rites.text: A fighter cuts an opponent across the chest several times, lifts them skyward with an upward slash, then leaps after them to slash the face and drive them down into the earth.

rites.name: Coraurania
rites.text: A practitioner opens many small openings into another realm and launches hazards from there at a rival. The method draws on pieces of that distant space to strike targets.

rites.name: Coreones
rites.text: A practitioner channels a storm-born energy mixed with a refined inner power to spit a thin, razor-sharp ray of light. The beam slices through strong energy spheres and moves so fast that it is said to be impossible to evade.

rites.name: Seriarus
rites.text: A practitioner swells one limb or section of the body to a far greater size while the rest stays unchanged. The enlargement is focused on a single region rather than the whole frame.

rites.name: Aminus
rites.text: A bearer draws a sticky, shifting fluid from a suit and bends it into tethers, shields, and thrown globs. The fluid can thicken to hold foes fast or stretch into a membrane that stops incoming missiles.

rites.name: Miallanum Leonelus
rites.text: A practitioner hurls dark, once-compacted rods at foes in quick succession. The strikes arrive too swiftly for keen-eyed watchers to follow, a speed only a heightened mode of the body can match.

rites.name: Nauntalus
rites.text: A bearer briefly shrinks to a tiny size to slip past an opponent's gaze, then swells back to strike unseen. Its rapid change is so swift that observers often mistake it for vanishing and reappearing elsewhere.

rites.name: Mantiales
rites.text: A fighter leaps high into the sky and drives both feet down onto a foe. The landing releases a strong shockwave outward from the point of impact.

rites.name: Sisor Telirausor
rites.text: A practitioner draws a blade-like edge out of their own arm by way of engineered agents circulating in their blood. The edge is then used to cut down an opponent.

rites.name: Cestum
rites.text: A practitioner closes in on a rival and strikes with a rapid chain of forceful slaps. The technique is a close-quarters combination of blows.

rites.name: Meostia
rites.text: A joint technique in which a master and their apprentice each form a spinning force sphere side by side, then drive both into a foe together. The combined strike deals twice the harm of a single sphere.

rites.name: Ceontium
rites.text: A practiced hand extends a dark thread across the open ground, tying it to bundles so they can be hurled outward. Each bundle carries a charge that bursts upon landing.

rites.name: Tariantus
rites.text: A practitioner expels a surge of inner energy through the palm to create a forceful shove that flings foes away. The same surge can burst from any part of the body to cancel an incoming blow.

rites.name: Nostor
rites.text: A refined guardian craft that releases an outward surge of shaped energy from a sheltering dome. It is an advanced evolution of an older, lesser form of the same defensive art.

rites.name: Orellirnes
rites.text: A wielder draws dense mineral grit from the ground, packs it tightly, and molds it into a guardian figure that stands before them. The woven barrier is so finely made that even the sharpest piercing strikes cannot break through it.

rites.name: Serostaunia
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a flurry of serpents, kicks, and cutting energy, then seizes them with a coiled serpent from the belly and hurls them overhead to the ground.

rites.name: Relum
rites.text: A fighter wears a hidden false shape that cracks open to reveal a second body. The true user works from concealment within a cloth on the back, guiding the disguise to seize a foe.

rites.name: Orausentes
rites.text: A user wields a broad fan to unleash a stronger, wider gale. Colliding air currents form many vacuum pockets that cut through targets.

rites.name: Leornor
rites.text: A tightly packed sphere of gathered energy is strengthened when two allies each lend their own essence to it. Their joined force can break through shields that seem almost impenetrable.

rites.name: Cinanum
rites.text: A towering armored colossus wraps dark spiraling gusts around both of its limbs. It then hurls these churning gusts forward as forceful blasts aimed at a rival.

rites.name: Amiastenor
rites.text: A practitioner hurls an ally skyward and empowers their strike with inner energy. The blow is strong enough to shatter an opponent's most sturdy protective shell.

rites.name: Meres
rites.text: A bearer seizes a rival, hurls them skyward, and swallows a glowing morsel that reshapes their form. Five spectral hounds then swarm the foe while a blazing bird and a boulder ape drive them into the earth.

rites.name: Corollarnus
rites.text: Two fighters team up: one launches the foe skyward, the other freezes them in place. Thrown blades with blasting charges are flung into a whirling gust that slashes and detonates the target.

rites.name: Centeosor
rites.text: A bearer reshapes their body into thrusting arms that flare with propulsive vents, adding force to strikes and throws. It amplifies a basic punch by combining it with a burst of forward lift.

rites.name: Amausilum
rites.text: A practitioner stands before a fallen star-stone, performs a set of hand gestures, and a pillar of brilliant light rises from the earth. Within the glow, a sealed vessel bearing tags is revealed, holding a hidden essence.

rites.name: Veonor
rites.text: A keeper releases a cloud of tiny buzzing creatures that lift a foe into the air. Shimmering clusters then strike the captive again and again before dropping them hard onto the ground.

rites.name: Oronaria
rites.text: A wielder swings a hooked shade-staff and unleashes a rushing flood of water that strikes several foes at once. Its force can pin an enemy to the ground and split solid rock.

rites.name: Reornonum
rites.text: Two fighters pull a foe into a hidden pocket realm where they land coordinated strikes. One then hurls a charged conductor that splits on impact, delivering shocks and piercing blows.

rites.name: Rausteolor
rites.text: A caster draws a person's inner energy into a crafted effigy, forming a flawless double that carries the same skills and gifts. The caster guides these doubles from great distances without any binding lines.

rites.name: Vaurernia
rites.text: A stealth-and-strike technique in which a fighter strikes an opponent while secretly lodging a seeking orb on them. The orb later swells outward and detonates a large blast around its target.

rites.name: Telantia
rites.text: A craft that shapes a wooden double into a tiny seed, which is slipped onto or swallowed by a chosen person so that only its maker can sense where that person travels.

rites.name: Niasus
rites.text: A user gathers a dense airborne cloud of tiny creatures that drifts down onto a foe. Once they settle around the target, they swarm inward and burst outward in a sudden eruption of insects.

rites.name: Talium
rites.text: A practitioner forms a quick sequence of gestures, and living growth wraps the whole body in a cloud of vapor. Once the shell is complete, the wearer can step out of it and speak in an altered voice.

rites.name: Lastes
rites.text: Six linked bodies strike an opponent together, the first hurling the foe skyward where the others pierce them through with dark hooked spears.

rites.name: Orentiallus
rites.text: A craft in which a practitioner shapes and tints thin sheets into duplicates of themselves. Struck duplicates fall apart back into plain sheets, and hidden blasting charges can be tucked inside them for an ambush.

rites.name: Telinastes
rites.text: A fighter leaps into the air and splits off a twin, and the two take turns striking a foe while spinning, staying aloft until the final blow lands.

rites.name: Valesanum
rites.text: A bearer summons several blazing spheres that orbit them and strike foes at will. Each touch boils away the moisture within a victim's body, leaving a dried husk that vents vapor, though cold rivers of water can counter the heat.

rites.name: Mentiasum
rites.text: A crafter shapes two small winged figures from kiln-hardened earth that dart toward a rival and burst apart. The blast hurls the target far backward, and the flying shells may bounce off nearby walls to strike again.

rites.name: Seornaulum
rites.text: A user conjures three swift beasts from ink that strike an opponent and launch them skyward. A great bird then waits above and rains sharp ink quills down, dragging the foe back to the ground.

rites.name: Lilasium
rites.text: A practitioner touches another being and pours their own sensations straight into that mind. The received perception can then pass onward to anyone bound to the recipient by flesh or by a lingering reflection.

rites.name: Seostanum
rites.text: Seostanum is the concept of the Walls, the belief that a people is held together by the barriers it raises and the oaths it swears behind them. In the Age of Sundering it was tested when landfall broke the old bonds between holding orders, and its adherents learned that a wall can outlast the peace it was built to protect.

rites.name: Telaulenes
rites.text: A fighter splits into four copies, and the copies take turns striking an opponent in rapid sequence. The final blow lifts the foe into the air, and the original then hurls a spinning orb of force to finish the attack.

rites.name: Serestantia
rites.text: A combined strike where a fist sends a foe toward a companion, who calls a great armored amphibian to slam the target down and crush them beneath its weight.

rites.name: Reornum
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a spinning halo of dense mineral blocks that orbits the body and shields it from harm. The same halo can be flung outward as a fast, hurtling loop against an opponent.

rites.name: Valirium
rites.text: A ruler of storms gathers a fierce crackle of energy into the tips of one hand, then drives it forward in a piercing thrust. It tears through a foe much like a sharp lightning bolt would.

rites.name: Contianes
rites.text: A fighter hurls a volley of charged blades while pulling the foe into a hidden void. Within that void the blades keep striking and shocking the victim until a final blast ends the fight.

rites.name: Nistesum
rites.text: A fighter marks a foe, launches them skyward, then blinks behind them to strike them down. A spinning sphere of force is hurled at the falling target, which detonates into a massive blast upon impact.

rites.name: Liastanum
rites.text: Two artisans shape a clay dragon and bind it in metallic grit, then send it crashing into a foe before triggering a violent blast that scatters the grit in a huge explosion.

rites.name: Caliaria
rites.text: Three fighters unleash a combined technique in which blades are launched, a rotating strike is sped up mid-air, and a wire of hooked edges binds the spinning force together. The collision ends in a blast.

rites.name: Valiarnus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior races back and forth around an enemy while flinging dark ink-like bands from one arm to bind and harry them.

rites.name: Valares
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a immense spiraling ring of force that erupts into devastation when it strikes. Its wielder once used it to lay waste to much of a hidden settlement, mirroring a similar assault carried out by a rival.

rites.name: Seolostia
rites.text: A bearer channels dark shade into a binding snare woven with crackling storm, then calls down a falling stone from the sky onto the captive foe.

rites.name: Reontosanum
rites.text: A fighter vanishes upward through the air and plummets down onto a foe, striking with a short blade. The strike arrives from above before the foe can react.

rites.name: Maunistium
rites.text: A practitioner moves so swiftly across the ground that they appear as a streak, striking a foe while passing them. They halt behind the target and finish with a short blade cut.

rites.name: Teliarentum
rites.text: A bladed bolt of crackling force that, once it pierces a target, pulls that target instantly into a hidden realm beyond ordinary space. Its wielder can also slip out of reach, dodging any retaliation.

rites.name: Amaunesium
rites.text: A bearer reshapes parts of the body into hidden barrels that unleash a huge blast of inner energy, able to level a whole district. It can emerge from the head or from a mounted arm.

rites.name: Serolernia
rites.text: A fighter strikes a rival with blade and foot, pulls them close, then swaps places with a thrown blade and cuts through them with a crackling edge.

rites.name: Telisenum
rites.text: A practitioner shouts at a rival, releasing a sound wave that hurls them backward while the practitioner blinks to their side. A heavy strike to the crown then sends a shockwave through them and raises a swollen lump.

rites.name: Raunteonia
rites.text: A refined form of an older twin-palm technique, wielded by a bearer who has taken in a borrowed inner force. Its energy glows violet and it hits harder and reaches farther than its original.

rites.name: Ameolles
rites.text: A bound prisoner is sealed inside a hovering stone orb. A winged woman wraps the orb in countless paper charges, then releases a small paper bird that ignites them all in a blast.

rites.name: Vialines
rites.text: A fighter launches high into the air and plummets onto a foe with crushing force, strong enough to shatter the ribs of a towering spirit guardian. It is a technique of overwhelming descent.

rites.name: Lauristanum
rites.text: Three bound masks of a single wearer unleash their three elemental arts together, producing a vast blast that tears open the air like a cataclysm of light and force.

rites.name: Corernes
rites.text: A fighter drives an enemy skyward with a boosted punch, then reappears above and halts their flight with a forceful kick to the face.

rites.name: Coraullium
rites.text: A bearer in a fierce transformed state gathers charged energy into one clenched hand, springs skyward, and drops onto a foe with a heavy empowered strike.

rites.name: Amantes
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a glowing spirit-mane of hidden energy around their hands, forming a beast-like shroud. They strike from range, hurling foes off their feet with the force of the blow.

rites.name: Oreolonia
rites.text: A bearer transformed by a glowing stone fires a powerful green ray from the back of one hand. The ray can be intensified into a far larger blast.

rites.name: Coreostilum
rites.text: A practice in which a summoner calls forth large cubes that rain down across the nearby ground. The cubes spread over the surrounding area as they fall.

rites.name: Valontus
rites.text: A swordsman moves in a sudden burst across the field and strikes with a blade charged by crackling energy. The electric arc it leaves behind can hit one foe or sweep through everyone standing close by.

rites.name: Callum
rites.text: A fighter sends a volley of seeking orbs to drive a rival into the ground, then lifts nearby platforms and strikes with unseen doubles. A final gathering of drifting stones crashes down upon the foe.

rites.name: Sarnontes
rites.text: A fighter conjures a rolling surge of water beneath their feet that carries them toward a foe. They then strike the enemy repeatedly with a heavy blade.

rites.name: Tosastia
rites.text: A practitioner fires a focused ray of inner energy from mechanical eye inserts. The ray erases the target's flesh so completely that no natural mending can close the wound, and each firing drains a heavy reserve of the user's energy.

rites.name: Seolum
rites.text: Two allies join their energies, one lifting the other into the sky as a flying shape. From there they strike together, the combined blow shattering the foe in a huge bursting dome of force.

rites.name: Vasteonium
rites.text: A bearer of a great inner beast unleashes a rapid volley of raw, unshaped energy spheres at a chosen foe. The orbs strike in quick succession, each one loosed before the last has faded.

rites.name: Telialium
rites.text: A caster hurls a gummy, molten spray that binds a foe to a nearby rock. A heavy warrior then drops from above, crushing the trapped target together with the stone.

rites.name: Niastor
rites.text: A clear barrier forms around the wielder's body and drinks in any energy hurled at it, regardless of its form. The absorbed force is then turned back and scattered through the wielder's own frame, leaving spells powerless against them.

rites.name: Seontor Valausanum
rites.text: A bearer of an eye-power traps a rival inside a shared illusion, where the bearer vanishes and a growing void swallows the surroundings. The void takes the shape of the bearer's eye as it consumes the victim, who collapses unconscious in the real world.

rites.name: Corialles
rites.text: A bending craft that draws matter toward its wielder on command. It lasts only a brief moment, can grip one chosen target without disturbing what surrounds it, and can hurl several captives together into collision.

rites.name: Tilor
rites.text: A charging armored figure fires its thrusters to ram a foe headfirst, then whirls rapidly and hoists the opponent skyward.

rites.name: Lianor
rites.text: A fighter multiplies into copies that act as footholds, letting them leap up after a foe who has been knocked aloft. The finishing strike is a rising kick delivered mid-air.

rites.name: Losia
rites.text: A bearer briefly takes on a cloaked, half-formed guise that lets them strike with a clawed limb. The guise fades after the blow.

rites.name: Naulus
rites.text: A dark vapor drains the strength of anyone who breathes it or touches it, slowly leaving them unable to move. It lingers as a barrier against approaching foes and returns to its place when blown away.

rites.name: Ceornes
rites.text: A bearer cloaks themselves in deep blue energy, leaps skyward until briefly unseen, then plunges at high speed to strike a foe with a spinning sphere of force. The glittering energy makes the blow look like a descending star.

rites.name: Cintiarum
rites.text: A practitioner shapes a fine grey dust into a rising wave that seizes a rival, lifts them aloft, slams them down, and then hurls them skyward once more.

rites.name: Neoliasia
rites.text: A caster shapes a crackling blade of energy in one hand and hurls it as a swift, erratic hound. A glowing cord keeps the beast tied to the caster, who alters its speed and reach by changing how much power flows into it.

rites.name: Valoses
rites.text: A fighter strikes an opponent with a rapid chain of blows, blinking between each strike so the attacks come from shifting positions.

rites.name: Liarnia
rites.text: A practitioner splits their motion into several lingering doubles that strike from different spots at once. When struck, they slip aside so the blow passes through a double instead.

rites.name: Silia
rites.text: A supreme class of energy-channelled crafts that need no gestures to perform, rarely awakened in those who inherit them through bloodline. Some lesser arts are said to be imitations of these highest workings.

rites.name: Caunilles
rites.text: Three allied wielders join forces, one bearing a beast's power, and together they shape a giant whirling sphere of energy between towering carved pillars. They hurl the combined sphere at their foe.

rites.name: Sontaustum
rites.text: Two fighters channel the stored power of nine great beasts and launch their strongest attacks together at one target. The combined blasts erupt into a catastrophic explosion.

rites.name: Leror
rites.text: A user channels inner energy through a wrist-mounted vent, pouring out a steady cloud that takes the shape of a serpentine beast. The beast can rush at close range and smother foes, yet it dissolves when soaked.

rites.name: Valanum
rites.text: Three wielders join their most potent far-reaching arts into one shared assault. It needs no precise aim, since its pull draws the target in, and its impact can shatter a massive constructed barrier.

rites.name: Viales
rites.text: Two bonded fighters merge their spinning energy spheres and hurl them at a foe, then teleport between thrown blades to strike repeatedly. The final barrage ends in a blast of radiant force that devastates everything nearby.

rites.name: Sallus
rites.text: A performer frees the carved head of a marionette just as a foe closes in. The detached head then shoots a sharp barb from its jaws that pierces the attacker.

rites.name: Verallium
rites.text: A deceptive trick where a fighter appears to be a towering spirit that strikes the foe, only for the illusion to fall away and reveal the fighter's own blow. The opponent is sent flying far away.

rites.name: Serestialor
rites.text: A combined strike where a wielder lashes a long mane of hair around an enemy, then hurls them skyward and drives a swirling sphere of burning energy into them. The blast ends in a brief flaming whirlwind and a shower of fire.

rites.name: Coraulantor
rites.text: A fighter summons many duplicate selves that kick a foe skyward, then mass into a flurry of blows. Their combined fused force bursts out as a blazing orange eruption visible from orbit.

rites.name: Varnium
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a marked blade that strikes a foe, then instantly reappears behind them to strike again. The technique links the thrown tool to the caster's sudden relocation.

rites.name: Niseror
rites.text: A blended inner-power craft that lets a practitioner glide with such speed they appear as a smear of motion. Hand-to-hand strikes lose their force against anyone too slow to keep pace.

rites.name: Masum
rites.text: A healer shapes her small companion into a mirror of herself, and the pair strike together with glowing blades to bring down a foe. The companion's tail is scorched in the process, and the healer mends it while the creature lashes out in annoyance.

rites.name: Valeriastum
rites.text: A user multiplies into a vast crowd of copies who launch a target skyward, then strike from every side with a flood of fists. A final double blow from two copies ends the assault.

rites.name: Sanus
rites.text: A bearer stretches a limb through the earth, seizing a foe and dragging them along hidden burrows. The captive is hurled skyward, whirled into a violent gale, and then slammed down onto the ground.

rites.name: Celeornia
rites.text: A bearer in a fierce, fully transformed state releases a volley of raw, uncompressed energy spheres together. The spheres can spread wide across the field, then gather to strike several foes at once.

rites.name: Corareolus
rites.text: A borrowed life-force drawn from a wielder's inner reserve that mends wounded companions nearby and can restore those who have fallen. It works only within a limited range around its user.

rites.name: Meornollus
rites.text: A bearer punches a foe with a monstrous energy arm, launching them skyward. Nine duplicates each spin a whirling sphere of force, and a great orb is loosed so that every strike converges on the target.

rites.name: Serisallum
rites.text: A bearer lights a pale blue eye, then vanishes and leaves ten glowing red paper birds that drift down and dissolve. The vanished one leaves no trace behind.

rites.name: Corenauntes
rites.text: A bearer can summon a duplicate of any person whose flesh has merged into their body, and the duplicate borrows that person's full arsenal of arts. The bearer keeps acting freely while the copy performs.

rites.name: Nialaustium
rites.text: A skilled fighter leaps high and hurls star-shaped blades carrying blasting charges at foes, while tossing small knives marked with mending sigils to comrades.

rites.name: Malirnus
rites.text: A user gathers several small orbs of seeking force into one sphere held before them, then releases it as a focused beam aimed at a rival.

rites.name: Telarnones
rites.text: An ever-returning fighter is hurled forward through a blaze driven by a gale, slashing at the foe with a three-edged blade. The pair press their attack relentlessly, trusting that the one who cannot die will always reach the enemy.

rites.name: Nesor
rites.text: A practitioner first summons several bolts of crackling sky-fire to strike the earth ahead, then unleashes a surging wall of water that spins into a large, charged whirlpool over the area.

rites.name: Raustium Viarnostum
rites.text: A swordsman strikes many vulnerable points on an opponent's body with rapid bladed thrusts. The blows can be chained together so the foe never gets a chance to counterattack.

rites.name: Tauneostum
rites.text: A combined strike where one fighter wears down a foe with quick blows, then a partner hurls a vanishing spinning sphere while charged blades ignite the air in a blast.

rites.name: Rianum Rolus
rites.text: A user bonds with a mechanical amphibian to perceive through its senses, seeing and hearing all around it. Paired units can relay messages, and the link can even span across separate realms.

rites.name: Coronium
rites.text: A clan technique that lets a practitioner swell to mountainous proportions, delivering crushing blows across a wide area. The body strains heavily under the change, and it demands an enormous reserve of inner energy.

rites.name: Lorinanum
rites.text: Two bonded siblings can dissolve their bodies to the smallest level and merge into one form. One can lend limbs to the other, and each can heal the other by recombining.

rites.name: Testor
rites.text: A bonding craft in which a wearer fastens a machine body over their own, like a mechanical suit. The joined wearer gains extra strength and a few additional abilities.

rites.name: Sirnium Leornia
